## <a id="syntax"></a>13 <strong>The HTML syntax</strong>[](#syntax)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This section only describes the rules for resources labeled with an <a id="syntax&#58;html&#45;mime&#45;type"></a>[HTML MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#html-mime-type)&#46; Rules for XML resources are discussed in the section below entitled &#34;<a id="syntax&#58;the&#45;xhtml&#45;syntax"></a>[The XML syntax](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#the-xhtml-syntax)&#34;&#46;

### <a id="writing"></a>13&#46;1 Writing HTML documents[](#writing)

<em>This section only applies to documents&#44; authoring tools&#44; and markup generators&#46; In particular&#44; it does not apply to conformance checkers&#59; conformance checkers must use the requirements given in the next section &#40;&#34;parsing HTML documents&#34;&#41;&#46;</em>

Documents must consist of the following parts&#44; in the given order&#58;

1.  Optionally&#44; a single U&#43;FEFF BYTE ORDER MARK &#40;BOM&#41; character&#46;
2.  Any number of <a id="writing&#58;syntax&#45;comments"></a>[comments](#syntax-comments) and <a id="writing&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
3.  A <a id="writing&#58;syntax&#45;doctype"></a>[DOCTYPE](#syntax-doctype)&#46;
4.  Any number of <a id="writing&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;2"></a>[comments](#syntax-comments) and <a id="writing&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
5.  The <a id="writing&#58;document&#45;element"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#44; in the form of an <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> <a id="writing&#58;syntax&#45;elements"></a>[element](#syntax-elements)&#46;
6.  Any number of <a id="writing&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;3"></a>[comments](#syntax-comments) and <a id="writing&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

The various types of content mentioned above are described in the next few sections&#46;

In addition&#44; there are some restrictions on how <a id="writing&#58;character&#45;encoding&#45;declaration"></a>[character encoding declarations](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#character-encoding-declaration) are to be serialized&#44; as discussed in the section on that topic&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

<a id="writing&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;4"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) before the <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; at the start of the <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element and before the <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#44; will be dropped when the document is parsed&#59; <a id="writing&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;5"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) <em>after</em> the <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element will be parsed as if it were at the end of the <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#46; Thus&#44; <a id="writing&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;6"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) around the <a id="writing&#58;document&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) does not roundtrip&#46;

It is suggested that newlines be inserted after the DOCTYPE&#44; after any comments that are before the document element&#44; after the <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#39;s start tag &#40;if it is not <a id="writing&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[omitted](#syntax-tag-omission)&#41;&#44; and after any comments that are inside the <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element but before the <a id="writing&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#46;

Many strings in the HTML syntax &#40;e&#46;g&#46; the names of elements and their attributes&#41; are case&#45;insensitive&#44; but only for <a id="writing&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII upper alphas](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha) and <a id="writing&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII lower alphas](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-alpha)&#46; For convenience&#44; in this section this is just referred to as &#34;case&#45;insensitive&#34;&#46;

#### <a id="the&#45;doctype"></a>13&#46;1&#46;1 The DOCTYPE[](#the-doctype)

A <a id="syntax&#45;doctype"></a><strong>DOCTYPE</strong> is a required preamble&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

DOCTYPEs are required for legacy reasons&#46; When omitted&#44; browsers tend to use a different rendering mode that is incompatible with some specifications&#46; Including the DOCTYPE in a document ensures that the browser makes a best&#45;effort attempt at following the relevant specifications&#46;

A DOCTYPE must consist of the following components&#44; in this order&#58;

1.  A string that is an <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<code>&#60;&#33;DOCTYPE</code>&#34;&#46;
2.  One or more <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
3.  A string that is an <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<code>html</code>&#34;&#46;
4.  Optionally&#44; a <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;doctype&#45;legacy&#45;string"></a>[DOCTYPE legacy string](#doctype-legacy-string)&#46;
5.  Zero or more <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
6.  A U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN character &#40;&#62;&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In other words&#44; <code>&#60;&#33;DOCTYPE html&#62;</code>&#44; case&#45;insensitively&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

For the purposes of HTML generators that cannot output HTML markup with the short DOCTYPE &#34;<code>&#60;&#33;DOCTYPE html&#62;</code>&#34;&#44; a <a id="doctype&#45;legacy&#45;string"></a><strong>DOCTYPE legacy string</strong> may be inserted into the DOCTYPE &#40;in the position defined above&#41;&#46; This string must consist of&#58;

1.  One or more <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
2.  A string that is an <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;3"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<code>SYSTEM</code>&#34;&#46;
3.  One or more <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;4"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
4.  A U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK or U&#43;0027 APOSTROPHE character &#40;the <em>quote mark</em>&#41;&#46;
5.  The literal string &#34;<a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;about&#58;legacy&#45;compat"></a><code>[about&#58;legacy&#45;compat](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#about:legacy-compat)</code>&#34;&#46;
6.  A matching U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK or U&#43;0027 APOSTROPHE character &#40;i&#46;e&#46; the same character as in the earlier step labeled <em>quote mark</em>&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In other words&#44; <code>&#60;&#33;DOCTYPE html SYSTEM &#34;about&#58;legacy&#45;compat&#34;&#62;</code> or <code>&#60;&#33;DOCTYPE html SYSTEM &#39;about&#58;legacy&#45;compat&#39;&#62;</code>&#44; case&#45;insensitively except for the part in single or double quotes&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;doctype&#58;doctype&#45;legacy&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[DOCTYPE legacy string](#doctype-legacy-string) should not be used unless the document is generated from a system that cannot output the shorter string&#46;

#### <a id="elements&#45;2"></a>13&#46;1&#46;2 Elements[](#elements-2)

There are six different kinds of <a id="syntax&#45;elements"></a><strong>elements</strong>&#58; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;void&#45;elements"></a>[void elements](#void-elements)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[the <code>template</code> element](#the-template-element-2)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;raw&#45;text&#45;elements"></a>[raw text elements](#raw-text-elements)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;escapable&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;elements"></a>[escapable raw text elements](#escapable-raw-text-elements)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;foreign&#45;elements"></a>[foreign elements](#foreign-elements)&#44; and <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;normal&#45;elements"></a>[normal elements](#normal-elements)&#46;

<strong><a id="void&#45;elements"></a><strong>Void elements</strong></strong>

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element"></a><code>[area](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-area-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;base&#45;element"></a><code>[base](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-base-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;br&#45;element"></a><code>[br](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-br-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element"></a><code>[col](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-col-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element"></a><code>[embed](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-embed-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-source-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element"></a><code>[track](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-track-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;wbr&#45;element"></a><code>[wbr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-wbr-element)</code>

<strong><a id="the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><strong>The <code>template</code> element</strong></strong>

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>

<strong><a id="raw&#45;text&#45;elements"></a><strong>Raw text elements</strong></strong>

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code>

<strong><a id="escapable&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;elements"></a><strong>Escapable raw text elements</strong></strong>

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code>&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element"></a><code>[title](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-title-element)</code>

<strong><a id="foreign&#45;elements"></a><strong>Foreign elements</strong></strong>

Elements from the <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;mathml&#45;namespace"></a>[MathML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#mathml-namespace) and the <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;svg&#45;namespace"></a>[SVG namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#svg-namespace)&#46;

<strong><a id="normal&#45;elements"></a><strong>Normal elements</strong></strong>

All other allowed <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML elements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) are normal elements&#46;

<a id="syntax&#45;tags"></a><strong>Tags</strong> are used to delimit the start and end of elements in the markup&#46; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;raw&#45;text&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[Raw text](#raw-text-elements)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;escapable&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[escapable raw text](#escapable-raw-text-elements)&#44; and <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;normal&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[normal](#normal-elements) elements have a <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) to indicate where they begin&#44; and an <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) to indicate where they end&#46; The start and end tags of certain <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;normal&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[normal elements](#normal-elements) can be <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[omitted](#syntax-tag-omission)&#44; as described below in the section on <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;omission&#45;2"></a>[optional tags](#syntax-tag-omission)&#46; Those that cannot be omitted must not be omitted&#46; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;void&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[Void elements](#void-elements) only have a start tag&#59; end tags must not be specified for <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;void&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[void elements](#void-elements)&#46; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;foreign&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[Foreign elements](#foreign-elements) must either have a start tag and an end tag&#44; or a start tag that is marked as self&#45;closing&#44; in which case they must not have an end tag&#46;

The <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;concept&#45;html&#45;contents"></a>[contents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-html-contents) of the element must be placed between just after the start tag &#40;which <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;omission&#45;3"></a>[might be implied&#44; in certain cases](#syntax-tag-omission)&#41; and just before the end tag &#40;which again&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;omission&#45;4"></a>[might be implied in certain cases](#syntax-tag-omission)&#41;&#46; The exact allowed contents of each individual element depend on the <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;content&#45;models"></a>[content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#content-models) of that element&#44; as described earlier in this specification&#46; Elements must not contain content that their content model disallows&#46; In addition to the restrictions placed on the contents by those content models&#44; however&#44; the five types of elements have additional <em>syntactic</em> requirements&#46;

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;void&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[Void elements](#void-elements) can&#39;t have any contents &#40;since there&#39;s no end tag&#44; no content can be put between the start tag and the end tag&#41;&#46;

<a id="template&#45;syntax"></a><a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[The <code>template</code> element](#the-template-element-2) can have <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;template&#45;contents"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents)&#44; but such <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;2"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents) are not children of the <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element itself&#46; Instead&#44; they are stored in a <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;documentfragment"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> associated with a different <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> — without a <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;browsing&#45;context"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#browsing-context) — so as to avoid the <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> contents interfering with the main <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#46; The markup for the <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;3"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents) of a <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element is placed just after the <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s start tag and just before <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s end tag &#40;as with other elements&#41;&#44; and may consist of any <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;text"></a>[text](#syntax-text)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;charref"></a>[character references](#syntax-charref)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;elements"></a>[elements](#syntax-elements)&#44; and <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;comments"></a>[comments](#syntax-comments)&#44; but the text must not contain the character U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41; or an <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;ambiguous&#45;ampersand"></a>[ambiguous ampersand](#syntax-ambiguous-ampersand)&#46;

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;raw&#45;text&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[Raw text elements](#raw-text-elements) can have <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;text&#45;2"></a>[text](#syntax-text)&#44; though it has [restrictions](#cdata-rcdata-restrictions) described below&#46;

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;escapable&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[Escapable raw text elements](#escapable-raw-text-elements) can have <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;text&#45;3"></a>[text](#syntax-text) and <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;charref&#45;2"></a>[character references](#syntax-charref)&#44; but the text must not contain an <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;2"></a>[ambiguous ampersand](#syntax-ambiguous-ampersand)&#46; There are also [further restrictions](#cdata-rcdata-restrictions) described below&#46;

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;foreign&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[Foreign elements](#foreign-elements) whose start tag is marked as self&#45;closing can&#39;t have any contents &#40;since&#44; again&#44; as there&#39;s no end tag&#44; no content can be put between the start tag and the end tag&#41;&#46; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;foreign&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[Foreign elements](#foreign-elements) whose start tag is <em>not</em> marked as self&#45;closing can have <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;text&#45;4"></a>[text](#syntax-text)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;charref&#45;3"></a>[character references](#syntax-charref)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;cdata"></a>[CDATA sections](#syntax-cdata)&#44; other <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[elements](#syntax-elements)&#44; and <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;2"></a>[comments](#syntax-comments)&#44; but the text must not contain the character U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41; or an <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;3"></a>[ambiguous ampersand](#syntax-ambiguous-ampersand)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The HTML syntax does not support namespace declarations&#44; even in <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;foreign&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[foreign elements](#foreign-elements)&#46;

For instance&#44; consider the following HTML fragment&#58;

``` text
<p>
 <svg>
  <metadata>
   <!-- this is invalid -->
   <cdr:license xmlns:cdr="https://www.example.com/cdr/metadata" name="MIT"/>
  </metadata>
 </svg>
</p>
```

The innermost element&#44; <code>cdr&#58;license</code>&#44; is actually in the SVG namespace&#44; as the &#34;<code>xmlns&#58;cdr</code>&#34; attribute has no effect &#40;unlike in XML&#41;&#46; In fact&#44; as the comment in the fragment above says&#44; the fragment is actually non&#45;conforming&#46; This is because SVG 2 does not define any elements called &#34;<code>cdr&#58;license</code>&#34; in the SVG namespace&#46;

<a id="elements&#45;2&#58;normal&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[Normal elements](#normal-elements) can have <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;text&#45;5"></a>[text](#syntax-text)&#44; <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;charref&#45;4"></a>[character references](#syntax-charref)&#44; other <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[elements](#syntax-elements)&#44; and <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;3"></a>[comments](#syntax-comments)&#44; but the text must not contain the character U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41; or an <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;4"></a>[ambiguous ampersand](#syntax-ambiguous-ampersand)&#46; Some <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;normal&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[normal elements](#normal-elements) also have [yet more restrictions](#element-restrictions) on what content they are allowed to hold&#44; beyond the restrictions imposed by the content model and those described in this paragraph&#46; Those restrictions are described below&#46;

Tags contain a <a id="syntax&#45;tag&#45;name"></a><strong>tag name</strong>&#44; giving the element&#39;s name&#46; HTML elements all have names that only use <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;alphanumeric&#45;ascii&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII alphanumerics](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alphanumeric)&#46; In the HTML syntax&#44; tag names&#44; even those for <a id="elements&#45;2&#58;foreign&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[foreign elements](#foreign-elements)&#44; may be written with any mix of lower&#45; and uppercase letters that&#44; when converted to all&#45;lowercase&#44; matches the element&#39;s tag name&#59; tag names are case&#45;insensitive&#46;

##### <a id="start&#45;tags"></a>13&#46;1&#46;2&#46;1 Start tags[](#start-tags)

<a id="syntax&#45;start&#45;tag"></a><strong>Start tags</strong> must have the following format&#58;

1.  The first character of a start tag must be a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character &#40;&#60;&#41;&#46;
2.  The next few characters of a start tag must be the element&#39;s <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;name"></a>[tag name](#syntax-tag-name)&#46;
3.  If there are to be any attributes in the next step&#44; there must first be one or more <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
4.  Then&#44; the start tag may have a number of attributes&#44; the <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;attributes"></a>[syntax for which](#syntax-attributes) is described below&#46; Attributes must be separated from each other by one or more <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
5.  After the attributes&#44; or after the <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[tag name](#syntax-tag-name) if there are no attributes&#44; there may be one or more <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46; &#40;Some attributes are required to be followed by a space&#46; See the <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;attributes&#45;2"></a>[attributes section](#syntax-attributes) below&#46;&#41;
6.  Then&#44; if the element is one of the <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;void&#45;elements"></a>[void elements](#void-elements)&#44; or if the element is a <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;foreign&#45;elements"></a>[foreign element](#foreign-elements)&#44; then there may be a single U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character &#40;&#47;&#41;&#44; which on <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;foreign&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[foreign elements](#foreign-elements) marks the start tag as self&#45;closing&#46; On <a id="start&#45;tags&#58;void&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[void elements](#void-elements)&#44; it does not mark the start tag as self&#45;closing but instead is unnecessary and has no effect of any kind&#46; For such void elements&#44; it should be used only with caution — especially since&#44; if directly preceded by an [unquoted attribute value](#unquoted)&#44; it becomes part of the attribute value rather than being discarded by the parser&#46;
7.  Finally&#44; start tags must be closed by a U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN character &#40;&#62;&#41;&#46;

##### <a id="end&#45;tags"></a>13&#46;1&#46;2&#46;2 End tags[](#end-tags)

<a id="syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a><strong>End tags</strong> must have the following format&#58;

1.  The first character of an end tag must be a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character &#40;&#60;&#41;&#46;
2.  The second character of an end tag must be a U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character &#40;&#47;&#41;&#46;
3.  The next few characters of an end tag must be the element&#39;s <a id="end&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;name"></a>[tag name](#syntax-tag-name)&#46;
4.  After the tag name&#44; there may be one or more <a id="end&#45;tags&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
5.  Finally&#44; end tags must be closed by a U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN character &#40;&#62;&#41;&#46;

##### <a id="attributes&#45;2"></a>13&#46;1&#46;2&#46;3 Attributes[](#attributes-2)

<a id="syntax&#45;attributes"></a><strong>Attributes</strong> for an element are expressed inside the element&#39;s start tag&#46;

Attributes have a name and a value&#46; <a id="syntax&#45;attribute&#45;name"></a><strong>Attribute names</strong> must consist of one or more characters other than <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;control"></a>[controls](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#control)&#44; U&#43;0020 SPACE&#44; U&#43;0022 &#40;&#34;&#41;&#44; U&#43;0027 &#40;&#39;&#41;&#44; U&#43;003E &#40;&#62;&#41;&#44; U&#43;002F &#40;&#47;&#41;&#44; U&#43;003D &#40;&#61;&#41;&#44; and <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;noncharacter"></a>[noncharacters](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#noncharacter)&#46; In the HTML syntax&#44; attribute names&#44; even those for <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;foreign&#45;elements"></a>[foreign elements](#foreign-elements)&#44; may be written with any mix of <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII lower](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-alpha) and <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII upper alphas](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha)&#46;

<a id="syntax&#45;attribute&#45;value"></a><strong>Attribute values</strong> are a mixture of <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;text"></a>[text](#syntax-text) and <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;charref"></a>[character references](#syntax-charref)&#44; except with the additional restriction that the text cannot contain an <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;ambiguous&#45;ampersand"></a>[ambiguous ampersand](#syntax-ambiguous-ampersand)&#46;

Attributes can be specified in four different ways&#58;

<strong>Empty attribute syntax</strong>

Just the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;attribute&#45;name"></a>[attribute name](#syntax-attribute-name)&#46; The value is implicitly the empty string&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-disabled)</code> attribute is given with the empty attribute syntax&#58;

``` text
<input disabled>
```

If an attribute using the empty attribute syntax is to be followed by another attribute&#44; then there must be <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) separating the two&#46;

<a id="unquoted"></a><strong>Unquoted attribute value syntax</strong>

The <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[attribute name](#syntax-attribute-name)&#44; followed by zero or more <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; followed by a single U&#43;003D EQUALS SIGN character&#44; followed by zero or more <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; followed by the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;attribute&#45;value"></a>[attribute value](#syntax-attribute-value)&#44; which&#44; in addition to the requirements given above for attribute values&#44; must not contain any literal <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;4"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; any U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK characters &#40;&#34;&#41;&#44; U&#43;0027 APOSTROPHE characters &#40;&#39;&#41;&#44; U&#43;003D EQUALS SIGN characters &#40;&#61;&#41;&#44; U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN characters &#40;&#60;&#41;&#44; U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN characters &#40;&#62;&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0060 GRAVE ACCENT characters &#40;&#96;&#41;&#44; and must not be the empty string&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-value)</code> attribute is given with the unquoted attribute value syntax&#58;

``` text
<input value=yes>
```

If an attribute using the unquoted attribute syntax is to be followed by another attribute or by the optional U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character &#40;&#47;&#41; allowed in step 6 of the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) syntax above&#44; then there must be <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;5"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) separating the two&#46;

<strong>Single&#45;quoted attribute value syntax</strong>

The <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;3"></a>[attribute name](#syntax-attribute-name)&#44; followed by zero or more <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;6"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; followed by a single U&#43;003D EQUALS SIGN character&#44; followed by zero or more <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;7"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; followed by a single U&#43;0027 APOSTROPHE character &#40;&#39;&#41;&#44; followed by the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[attribute value](#syntax-attribute-value)&#44; which&#44; in addition to the requirements given above for attribute values&#44; must not contain any literal U&#43;0027 APOSTROPHE characters &#40;&#39;&#41;&#44; and finally followed by a second single U&#43;0027 APOSTROPHE character &#40;&#39;&#41;&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is given with the single&#45;quoted attribute value syntax&#58;

``` text
<input type='checkbox'>
```

If an attribute using the single&#45;quoted attribute syntax is to be followed by another attribute&#44; then there must be <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;8"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) separating the two&#46;

<strong>Double&#45;quoted attribute value syntax</strong>

The <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;4"></a>[attribute name](#syntax-attribute-name)&#44; followed by zero or more <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;9"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; followed by a single U&#43;003D EQUALS SIGN character&#44; followed by zero or more <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;10"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; followed by a single U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK character &#40;&#34;&#41;&#44; followed by the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[attribute value](#syntax-attribute-value)&#44; which&#44; in addition to the requirements given above for attribute values&#44; must not contain any literal U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK characters &#40;&#34;&#41;&#44; and finally followed by a second single U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK character &#40;&#34;&#41;&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; the <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute is given with the double&#45;quoted attribute value syntax&#58;

``` text
<input name="be evil">
```

If an attribute using the double&#45;quoted attribute syntax is to be followed by another attribute&#44; then there must be <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;11"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) separating the two&#46;

There must never be two or more attributes on the same start tag whose names are an <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for each other&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;foreign&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[foreign element](#foreign-elements) has one of the namespaced attributes given by the local name and namespace of the first and second cells of a row from the following table&#44; it must be written using the name given by the third cell from the same row&#46;

<table><thead><tr><th> Local name </th><th> Namespace </th><th> Attribute name    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td> <code>actuate</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xlink-namespace" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace" data-x-internal="xlink-namespace">XLink namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xlink&#58;actuate</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>arcrole</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xlink-namespace-2" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace" data-x-internal="xlink-namespace">XLink namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xlink&#58;arcrole</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>href</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xlink-namespace-3" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace" data-x-internal="xlink-namespace">XLink namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xlink&#58;href</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>role</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xlink-namespace-4" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace" data-x-internal="xlink-namespace">XLink namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xlink&#58;role</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>show</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xlink-namespace-5" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace" data-x-internal="xlink-namespace">XLink namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xlink&#58;show</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>title</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xlink-namespace-6" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace" data-x-internal="xlink-namespace">XLink namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xlink&#58;title</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>type</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xlink-namespace-7" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace" data-x-internal="xlink-namespace">XLink namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xlink&#58;type</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>lang</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xml-namespace" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-namespace" data-x-internal="xml-namespace">XML namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xml&#58;lang</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>space</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xml-namespace-2" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-namespace" data-x-internal="xml-namespace">XML namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xml&#58;space</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>xmlns</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xmlns-namespace" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace" data-x-internal="xmlns-namespace">XMLNS namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xmlns</code>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>xlink</code> </td><td> <a id="attributes-2:xmlns-namespace-2" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace" data-x-internal="xmlns-namespace">XMLNS namespace</a> </td><td> <code>xmlns&#58;xlink</code>   </td></tr></tbody></table>

No other namespaced attribute can be expressed in <a id="attributes&#45;2&#58;syntax"></a>[the HTML syntax](#syntax)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Whether the attributes in the table above are conforming or not is defined by other specifications &#40;e&#46;g&#46; SVG 2 and MathML&#41;&#59; this section only describes the syntax rules if the attributes are serialized using the HTML syntax&#46;

##### <a id="optional&#45;tags"></a>13&#46;1&#46;2&#46;4 Optional tags[](#optional-tags)

Certain tags can be <a id="syntax&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a><strong>omitted</strong>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Omitting an element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) in the situations described below does not mean the element is not present&#59; it is implied&#44; but it is still there&#46; For example&#44; an HTML document always has a root <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; even if the string <code>&#60;html&#62;</code> doesn&#39;t appear anywhere in the markup&#46;

An <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;2"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) may be omitted if the first thing inside the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element is not a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;comments"></a>[comment](#syntax-comments)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; in the following case it&#39;s ok to remove the &#34;<code>&#60;html&#62;</code>&#34; tag&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html>
  <head>
    <title>Hello</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <p>Welcome to this example.</p>
  </body>
</html>
```

Doing so would make the document look like this&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>

  <head>
    <title>Hello</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <p>Welcome to this example.</p>
  </body>
</html>
```

This has the exact same DOM&#46; In particular&#44; note that whitespace around the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;document&#45;element"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) is ignored by the parser&#46; The following example would also have the exact same DOM&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML><head>
    <title>Hello</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <p>Welcome to this example.</p>
  </body>
</html>
```

However&#44; in the following example&#44; removing the start tag moves the comment to before the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html>
  <!-- where is this comment in the DOM? -->
  <head>
    <title>Hello</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <p>Welcome to this example.</p>
  </body>
</html>
```

With the tag removed&#44; the document actually turns into the same as this&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<!-- where is this comment in the DOM? -->
<html>
  <head>
    <title>Hello</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <p>Welcome to this example.</p>
  </body>
</html>
```

This is why the tag can only be removed if it is not followed by a comment&#58; removing the tag when there is a comment there changes the document&#39;s resulting parse tree&#46; Of course&#44; if the position of the comment does not matter&#44; then the tag can be omitted&#44; as if the comment had been moved to before the start tag in the first place&#46;

An <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element is not immediately followed by a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;2"></a>[comment](#syntax-comments)&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;3"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) may be omitted if the element is empty&#44; or if the first thing inside the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element is an element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;2"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element is not immediately followed by <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) or a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;3"></a>[comment](#syntax-comments)&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;4"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) may be omitted if the element is empty&#44; or if the first thing inside the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element is not <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) or a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;4"></a>[comment](#syntax-comments)&#44; except if the first thing inside the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element is a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;3"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element is not immediately followed by a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;5"></a>[comment](#syntax-comments)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Note that in the example above&#44; the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element start and end tags&#44; and the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element start tag&#44; can&#39;t be omitted&#44; because they are surrounded by whitespace&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html>
  <head>
    <title>Hello</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <p>Welcome to this example.</p>
  </body>
</html>
```

&#40;The <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> and <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element end tags could be omitted without trouble&#59; any spaces after those get parsed into the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element anyway&#46;&#41;

Usually&#44; however&#44; whitespace isn&#39;t an issue&#46; If we first remove the whitespace we don&#39;t care about&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML><html><head><title>Hello</title></head><body><p>Welcome to this example.</p></body></html>
```

Then we can omit a number of tags without affecting the DOM&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML><title>Hello</title><p>Welcome to this example.</p>
```

At that point&#44; we can also add some whitespace back&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<title>Hello</title>
<p>Welcome to this example.</p>
```

This would be equivalent to this document&#44; with the omitted tags shown in their parser&#45;implied positions&#59; the only whitespace text node that results from this is the newline at the end of the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html><head><title>Hello</title>
</head><body><p>Welcome to this example.</p></body></html>
```

An <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;4"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element is immediately followed by another <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;5"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element is immediately followed by another <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element or a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;6"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element is immediately followed by another <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element or a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;7"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element is immediately followed by an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;address&#45;element"></a><code>[address](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-address-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;article&#45;element"></a><code>[article](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-article-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;aside&#45;element"></a><code>[aside](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-aside-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;blockquote&#45;element"></a><code>[blockquote](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-blockquote-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element"></a><code>[details](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-details-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element"></a><code>[dialog](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dl&#45;element"></a><code>[dl](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dl-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;fieldset&#45;element"></a><code>[fieldset](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-fieldset-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;footer&#45;element"></a><code>[footer](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-footer-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;h1&#44;&#45;h2&#44;&#45;h3&#44;&#45;h4&#44;&#45;h5&#44;&#45;and&#45;h6&#45;elements"></a><code>[h1](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;h1&#44;&#45;h2&#44;&#45;h3&#44;&#45;h4&#44;&#45;h5&#44;&#45;and&#45;h6&#45;elements&#45;2"></a><code>[h2](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;h1&#44;&#45;h2&#44;&#45;h3&#44;&#45;h4&#44;&#45;h5&#44;&#45;and&#45;h6&#45;elements&#45;3"></a><code>[h3](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;h1&#44;&#45;h2&#44;&#45;h3&#44;&#45;h4&#44;&#45;h5&#44;&#45;and&#45;h6&#45;elements&#45;4"></a><code>[h4](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;h1&#44;&#45;h2&#44;&#45;h3&#44;&#45;h4&#44;&#45;h5&#44;&#45;and&#45;h6&#45;elements&#45;5"></a><code>[h5](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;h1&#44;&#45;h2&#44;&#45;h3&#44;&#45;h4&#44;&#45;h5&#44;&#45;and&#45;h6&#45;elements&#45;6"></a><code>[h6](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-h1,-h2,-h3,-h4,-h5,-and-h6-elements)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;header&#45;element"></a><code>[header](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-header-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;hgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[hgroup](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hgroup-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;main&#45;element"></a><code>[main](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-main-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;menu&#45;element"></a><code>[menu](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-menu-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;nav&#45;element"></a><code>[nav](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-nav-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;ol&#45;element"></a><code>[ol](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ol-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;pre&#45;element"></a><code>[pre](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-pre-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;search&#45;element"></a><code>[search](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-search-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;section&#45;element"></a><code>[section](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-section-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;ul&#45;element"></a><code>[ul](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ul-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element and the parent element is an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) that is not an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-audio-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;del&#45;element"></a><code>[del](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-del-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;ins&#45;element"></a><code>[ins](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ins-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element"></a><code>[map](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-map-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-video-element)</code> element&#44; or an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;autonomous&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[autonomous custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#autonomous-custom-element)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

We can thus simplify the earlier example further&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML><title>Hello</title><p>Welcome to this example.
```

An <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;8"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element is immediately followed by an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

An <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;9"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element is immediately followed by an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

An <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;10"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element is immediately followed by another <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; if it is immediately followed by an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

An <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;11"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element is immediately followed by another <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; if it is immediately followed by an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; if it is immediately followed by an <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;5"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) may be omitted if the first thing inside the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element is a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element"></a><code>[col](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-col-element)</code> element&#44; and if the element is not immediately preceded by another <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element whose <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;12"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) has been omitted&#46; &#40;It can&#39;t be omitted if the element is empty&#46;&#41;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;13"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element is not immediately followed by <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) or a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;6"></a>[comment](#syntax-comments)&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;14"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element is not immediately followed by <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;4"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) or a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;7"></a>[comment](#syntax-comments)&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;15"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code> element is immediately followed by a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;6"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) may be omitted if the first thing inside the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element is a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; and if the element is not immediately preceded by a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element whose <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;16"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) has been omitted&#46; &#40;It can&#39;t be omitted if the element is empty&#46;&#41;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;17"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element is immediately followed by a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;18"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;19"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element is immediately followed by another <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;20"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element is immediately followed by a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

A <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;21"></a>[end tag](#syntax-end-tag) may be omitted if the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element is immediately followed by a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The ability to omit all these table&#45;related tags makes table markup much terser&#46;

Take this example&#58;

``` text
<table>
 <caption>37547 TEE Electric Powered Rail Car Train Functions (Abbreviated)</caption>
 <colgroup><col><col><col></colgroup>
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th>Function</th>
   <th>Control Unit</th>
   <th>Central Station</th>
  </tr>
 </thead>
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <td>Headlights</td>
   <td>✔</td>
   <td>✔</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
   <td>Interior Lights</td>
   <td>✔</td>
   <td>✔</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
   <td>Electric locomotive operating sounds</td>
   <td>✔</td>
   <td>✔</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
   <td>Engineer's cab lighting</td>
   <td></td>
   <td>✔</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
   <td>Station Announcements - Swiss</td>
   <td></td>
   <td>✔</td>
  </tr>
 </tbody>
</table>
```

The exact same table&#44; modulo some whitespace differences&#44; could be marked up as follows&#58;

``` text
<table>
 <caption>37547 TEE Electric Powered Rail Car Train Functions (Abbreviated)
 <colgroup><col><col><col>
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th>Function
   <th>Control Unit
   <th>Central Station
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <td>Headlights
   <td>✔
   <td>✔
  <tr>
   <td>Interior Lights
   <td>✔
   <td>✔
  <tr>
   <td>Electric locomotive operating sounds
   <td>✔
   <td>✔
  <tr>
   <td>Engineer's cab lighting
   <td>
   <td>✔
  <tr>
   <td>Station Announcements - Swiss
   <td>
   <td>✔
</table>
```

Since the cells take up much less room this way&#44; this can be made even terser by having each row on one line&#58;

``` text
<table>
 <caption>37547 TEE Electric Powered Rail Car Train Functions (Abbreviated)
 <colgroup><col><col><col>
 <thead>
  <tr> <th>Function                              <th>Control Unit     <th>Central Station
 <tbody>
  <tr> <td>Headlights                            <td>✔                <td>✔
  <tr> <td>Interior Lights                       <td>✔                <td>✔
  <tr> <td>Electric locomotive operating sounds  <td>✔                <td>✔
  <tr> <td>Engineer's cab lighting               <td>                 <td>✔
  <tr> <td>Station Announcements - Swiss         <td>                 <td>✔
</table>
```

The only differences between these tables&#44; at the DOM level&#44; is with the precise position of the &#40;in any case semantically&#45;neutral&#41; whitespace&#46;

<strong>However</strong>&#44; a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;7"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) must never be omitted if it has any attributes&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Returning to the earlier example with all the whitespace removed and then all the optional tags removed&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML><title>Hello</title><p>Welcome to this example.
```

If the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element in this example had to have a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;classes"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code> attribute and the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element had to have a <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;attr&#45;lang"></a><code>[lang](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-lang)</code> attribute&#44; the markup would have to become&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML><html lang="en"><title>Hello</title><body class="demo"><p>Welcome to this example.
```

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This section assumes that the document is conforming&#44; in particular&#44; that there are no <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;content&#45;models"></a>[content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#content-models) violations&#46; Omitting tags in the fashion described in this section in a document that does not conform to the <a id="optional&#45;tags&#58;content&#45;models&#45;2"></a>[content models](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#content-models) described in this specification is likely to result in unexpected DOM differences &#40;this is&#44; in part&#44; what the content models are designed to avoid&#41;&#46;

##### <a id="element&#45;restrictions"></a>13&#46;1&#46;2&#46;5 Restrictions on content models[](#element-restrictions)

For historical reasons&#44; certain elements have extra restrictions beyond even the restrictions given by their content model&#46;

A <a id="element&#45;restrictions&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element must not contain <a id="element&#45;restrictions&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> elements&#44; even though these elements are technically allowed inside <a id="element&#45;restrictions&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> elements according to the content models described in this specification&#46; &#40;If a <a id="element&#45;restrictions&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element is put inside a <a id="element&#45;restrictions&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> in the markup&#44; it will in fact imply a <a id="element&#45;restrictions&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> start tag before it&#46;&#41;
