The <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;document&#39;s&#45;character&#45;encoding&#45;4"></a>[document&#39;s character encoding](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding) must immediately be set to the value returned from this algorithm&#44; at the same time as the user agent uses the returned value to select the decoder to use for the input byte stream&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When an algorithm requires a user agent to <a id="prescan&#45;a&#45;byte&#45;stream&#45;to&#45;determine&#45;its&#45;encoding"></a><strong>prescan a byte stream to determine its encoding</strong>&#44; given some defined <a id="prescan&#45;end&#45;condition"></a><strong><var>end condition</var></strong>&#44; then it must run the following steps&#46; If at any point during these steps &#40;including during instances of the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing"></a>[get an attribute](#concept-get-attributes-when-sniffing) algorithm invoked by this one&#41; the user agent either runs out of bytes &#40;meaning the <var>position</var> pointer created in the first step below goes beyond the end of the byte stream obtained so far&#41; or reaches its <var>end condition</var>&#44; then abort the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;prescan&#45;a&#45;byte&#45;stream&#45;to&#45;determine&#45;its&#45;encoding&#45;2"></a>[prescan a byte stream to determine its encoding](#prescan-a-byte-stream-to-determine-its-encoding) algorithm and return the result <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;xml&#45;encoding&#45;when&#45;sniffing"></a>[get an XML encoding](#concept-get-xml-encoding-when-sniffing) applied to the same bytes that the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;prescan&#45;a&#45;byte&#45;stream&#45;to&#45;determine&#45;its&#45;encoding&#45;3"></a>[prescan a byte stream to determine its encoding](#prescan-a-byte-stream-to-determine-its-encoding) algorithm was applied to&#46; Otherwise&#44; these steps will return a character encoding&#46;

1.  Let <var>position</var> be a pointer to a byte in the input byte stream&#44; initially pointing at the first byte&#46;

2.  Prescan for UTF&#45;16 XML declarations&#58; If <var>position</var> points to&#58;

    <strong>A sequence of bytes starting with&#58; 0x3C&#44; 0x0&#44; 0x3F&#44; 0x0&#44; 0x78&#44; 0x0 &#40;case&#45;sensitive UTF&#45;16 little&#45;endian &#39;&#60;&#63;x&#39;&#41;</strong>

    Return <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;utf&#45;16le"></a>[UTF&#45;16LE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16le)&#46;

    <strong>A sequence of bytes starting with&#58; 0x0&#44; 0x3C&#44; 0x0&#44; 0x3F&#44; 0x0&#44; 0x78 &#40;case&#45;sensitive UTF&#45;16 big&#45;endian &#39;&#60;&#63;x&#39;&#41;</strong>

    Return <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;utf&#45;16be"></a>[UTF&#45;16BE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16be)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    For historical reasons&#44; the prefix is two bytes longer than in [Appendix F](https://www.w3.org/TR/REC-xml/#sec-guessing) of XML and the encoding name is not checked&#46;

3.  <em>Loop</em>&#58; If <var>position</var> points to&#58;

    <strong>A sequence of bytes starting with&#58; 0x3C 0x21 0x2D 0x2D &#40;&#96;<code>&#60;&#33;&#45;&#45;</code>&#96;&#41;</strong>

    Advance the <var>position</var> pointer so that it points at the first 0x3E byte which is preceded by two 0x2D bytes &#40;i&#46;e&#46; at the end of an ASCII &#39;&#45;&#45;&#62;&#39; sequence&#41; and comes after the 0x3C byte that was found&#46; &#40;The two 0x2D bytes can be the same as those in the &#39;&#60;&#33;&#45;&#45;&#39; sequence&#46;&#41;

    <strong>A sequence of bytes starting with&#58; 0x3C&#44; 0x4D or 0x6D&#44; 0x45 or 0x65&#44; 0x54 or 0x74&#44; 0x41 or 0x61&#44; and one of 0x09&#44; 0x0A&#44; 0x0C&#44; 0x0D&#44; 0x20&#44; 0x2F &#40;case&#45;insensitive ASCII &#39;&#60;meta&#39; followed by a space or slash&#41;</strong>

    1.  Advance the <var>position</var> pointer so that it points at the next 0x09&#44; 0x0A&#44; 0x0C&#44; 0x0D&#44; 0x20&#44; or 0x2F byte &#40;the one in sequence of characters matched above&#41;&#46;

    2.  Let <var>attribute list</var> be an empty list of strings&#46;

    3.  Let <var>got pragma</var> be false&#46;

    4.  Let <var>need pragma</var> be null&#46;

    5.  Let <var>charset</var> be the null value &#40;which&#44; for the purposes of this algorithm&#44; is distinct from an unrecognized encoding or the empty string&#41;&#46;

    6.  <em>Attributes</em>&#58; <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing&#45;2"></a>[Get an attribute](#concept-get-attributes-when-sniffing) and its value&#46; If no attribute was sniffed&#44; then jump to the <em>processing</em> step below&#46;

    7.  If the attribute&#39;s name is already in <var>attribute list</var>&#44; then return to the step labeled <em>attributes</em>&#46;

    8.  Add the attribute&#39;s name to <var>attribute list</var>&#46;

    9.  Run the appropriate step from the following list&#44; if one applies&#58;

        <strong>If the attribute&#39;s name is &#34;<code>http&#45;equiv</code>&#34;</strong>

        If the attribute&#39;s value is &#34;<code>content&#45;type</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>got pragma</var> to true&#46;

        <strong>If the attribute&#39;s name is &#34;<code>content</code>&#34;</strong>

        Apply the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;extracting&#45;a&#45;character&#45;encoding&#45;from&#45;a&#45;meta&#45;element"></a>[algorithm for extracting a character encoding from a <code>meta</code> element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#algorithm-for-extracting-a-character-encoding-from-a-meta-element)&#44; giving the attribute&#39;s value as the string to parse&#46; If a character encoding is returned&#44; and if <var>charset</var> is still set to null&#44; let <var>charset</var> be the encoding returned&#44; and set <var>need pragma</var> to true&#46;

        <strong>If the attribute&#39;s name is &#34;<code>charset</code>&#34;</strong>

        Let <var>charset</var> be the result of <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;getting&#45;an&#45;encoding"></a>[getting an encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get) from the attribute&#39;s value&#44; and set <var>need pragma</var> to false&#46;

    10. Return to the step labeled <em>attributes</em>&#46;

    11. <em>Processing</em>&#58; If <var>need pragma</var> is null&#44; then jump to the step below labeled <em>next byte</em>&#46;

    12. If <var>need pragma</var> is true but <var>got pragma</var> is false&#44; then jump to the step below labeled <em>next byte</em>&#46;

    13. If <var>charset</var> is failure&#44; then jump to the step below labeled <em>next byte</em>&#46;

    14. If <var>charset</var> is <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;utf&#45;16&#45;encoding&#45;2"></a>[UTF&#45;16BE&#47;LE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16be-le)&#44; then set <var>charset</var> to <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;utf&#45;8"></a>[UTF&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8)&#46;

    15. If <var>charset</var> is <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;x&#45;user&#45;defined"></a>[x&#45;user&#45;defined](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#x-user-defined)&#44; then set <var>charset</var> to <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;windows&#45;1252&#45;2"></a>[windows&#45;1252](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1252)&#46;

    16. Return <var>charset</var>&#46;

    <strong>A sequence of bytes starting with a 0x3C byte &#40;&#60;&#41;&#44; optionally a 0x2F byte &#40;&#47;&#41;&#44; and finally a byte in the range 0x41&#45;0x5A or 0x61&#45;0x7A &#40;A&#45;Z or a&#45;z&#41;</strong>

    1.  Advance the <var>position</var> pointer so that it points at the next 0x09 &#40;HT&#41;&#44; 0x0A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; 0x0C &#40;FF&#41;&#44; 0x0D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; 0x20 &#40;SP&#41;&#44; or 0x3E &#40;&#62;&#41; byte&#46;

    2.  Repeatedly <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing&#45;3"></a>[get an attribute](#concept-get-attributes-when-sniffing) until no further attributes can be found&#44; then jump to the step below labeled <em>next byte</em>&#46;

    <strong>A sequence of bytes starting with&#58; 0x3C 0x21 &#40;&#96;<code>&#60;&#33;</code>&#96;&#41;</strong>

    <strong>A sequence of bytes starting with&#58; 0x3C 0x2F &#40;&#96;<code>&#60;&#47;</code>&#96;&#41;</strong>

    <strong>A sequence of bytes starting with&#58; 0x3C 0x3F &#40;&#96;<code>&#60;&#63;</code>&#96;&#41;</strong>

    Advance the <var>position</var> pointer so that it points at the first 0x3E byte &#40;&#62;&#41; that comes after the 0x3C byte that was found&#46;

    <strong>Any other byte</strong>

    Do nothing with that byte&#46;

4.  <em>Next byte</em>&#58; Move <var>position</var> so it points at the next byte in the input byte stream&#44; and return to the step above labeled <em>loop</em>&#46;

When the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;prescan&#45;a&#45;byte&#45;stream&#45;to&#45;determine&#45;its&#45;encoding&#45;4"></a>[prescan a byte stream to determine its encoding](#prescan-a-byte-stream-to-determine-its-encoding) algorithm says to <a id="concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing"></a><strong>get an attribute</strong>&#44; it means doing this&#58;

1.  If the byte at <var>position</var> is one of 0x09 &#40;HT&#41;&#44; 0x0A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; 0x0C &#40;FF&#41;&#44; 0x0D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; 0x20 &#40;SP&#41;&#44; or 0x2F &#40;&#47;&#41;&#44; then advance <var>position</var> to the next byte and redo this step&#46;

2.  If the byte at <var>position</var> is 0x3E &#40;&#62;&#41;&#44; then abort the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing&#45;4"></a>[get an attribute](#concept-get-attributes-when-sniffing) algorithm&#46; There isn&#39;t one&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; the byte at <var>position</var> is the start of the attribute name&#46; Let <var>attribute name</var> and <var>attribute value</var> be the empty string&#46;

4.  Process the byte at <var>position</var> as follows&#58;

    <strong>If it is 0x3D &#40;&#61;&#41;&#44; and the <var>attribute name</var> is longer than the empty string</strong>

    Advance <var>position</var> to the next byte and jump to the step below labeled <em>value</em>&#46;
    <strong>If it is 0x09 &#40;HT&#41;&#44; 0x0A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; 0x0C &#40;FF&#41;&#44; 0x0D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or 0x20 &#40;SP&#41;</strong>

    Jump to the step below labeled <em>spaces</em>&#46;
    <strong>If it is 0x2F &#40;&#47;&#41; or 0x3E &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

    Abort the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing&#45;5"></a>[get an attribute](#concept-get-attributes-when-sniffing) algorithm&#46; The attribute&#39;s name is the value of <var>attribute name</var>&#44; its value is the empty string&#46;
    <strong>If it is in the range 0x41 &#40;A&#41; to 0x5A &#40;Z&#41;</strong>

    Append the code point <var>b</var>&#43;0x20 to <var>attribute name</var> &#40;where <var>b</var> is the value of the byte at <var>position</var>&#41;&#46; &#40;This converts the input to lowercase&#46;&#41;
    <strong>Anything else</strong>

    Append the code point with the same value as the byte at <var>position</var> to <var>attribute name</var>&#46; &#40;It doesn&#39;t actually matter how bytes outside the ASCII range are handled here&#44; since only ASCII bytes can contribute to the detection of a character encoding&#46;&#41;

5.  Advance <var>position</var> to the next byte and return to the previous step&#46;

6.  <em>Spaces</em>&#58; If the byte at <var>position</var> is one of 0x09 &#40;HT&#41;&#44; 0x0A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; 0x0C &#40;FF&#41;&#44; 0x0D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or 0x20 &#40;SP&#41;&#44; then advance <var>position</var> to the next byte&#44; then&#44; repeat this step&#46;

7.  If the byte at <var>position</var> is <em>not</em> 0x3D &#40;&#61;&#41;&#44; abort the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing&#45;6"></a>[get an attribute](#concept-get-attributes-when-sniffing) algorithm&#46; The attribute&#39;s name is the value of <var>attribute name</var>&#44; its value is the empty string&#46;

8.  Advance <var>position</var> past the 0x3D &#40;&#61;&#41; byte&#46;

9.  <em>Value</em>&#58; If the byte at <var>position</var> is one of 0x09 &#40;HT&#41;&#44; 0x0A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; 0x0C &#40;FF&#41;&#44; 0x0D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or 0x20 &#40;SP&#41;&#44; then advance <var>position</var> to the next byte&#44; then&#44; repeat this step&#46;

10. Process the byte at <var>position</var> as follows&#58;

    <strong>If it is 0x22 &#40;&#34;&#41; or 0x27 &#40;&#39;&#41;</strong>

    1.  Let <var>b</var> be the value of the byte at <var>position</var>&#46;
    2.  <em>Quote loop</em>&#58; Advance <var>position</var> to the next byte&#46;
    3.  If the value of the byte at <var>position</var> is the value of <var>b</var>&#44; then advance <var>position</var> to the next byte and abort the &#34;get an attribute&#34; algorithm&#46; The attribute&#39;s name is the value of <var>attribute name</var>&#44; and its value is the value of <var>attribute value</var>&#46;
    4.  Otherwise&#44; if the value of the byte at <var>position</var> is in the range 0x41 &#40;A&#41; to 0x5A &#40;Z&#41;&#44; then append a code point to <var>attribute value</var> whose value is 0x20 more than the value of the byte at <var>position</var>&#46;
    5.  Otherwise&#44; append a code point to <var>attribute value</var> whose value is the same as the value of the byte at <var>position</var>&#46;
    6.  Return to the step above labeled <em>quote loop</em>&#46;

    <strong>If it is 0x3E &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

    Abort the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing&#45;7"></a>[get an attribute](#concept-get-attributes-when-sniffing) algorithm&#46; The attribute&#39;s name is the value of <var>attribute name</var>&#44; its value is the empty string&#46;
    <strong>If it is in the range 0x41 &#40;A&#41; to 0x5A &#40;Z&#41;</strong>

    Append a code point <var>b</var>&#43;0x20 to <var>attribute value</var> &#40;where <var>b</var> is the value of the byte at <var>position</var>&#41;&#46; Advance <var>position</var> to the next byte&#46;
    <strong>Anything else</strong>

    Append a code point with the same value as the byte at <var>position</var> to <var>attribute value</var>&#46; Advance <var>position</var> to the next byte&#46;

11. Process the byte at <var>position</var> as follows&#58;

    <strong>If it is 0x09 &#40;HT&#41;&#44; 0x0A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; 0x0C &#40;FF&#41;&#44; 0x0D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; 0x20 &#40;SP&#41;&#44; or 0x3E &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

    Abort the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;concept&#45;get&#45;attributes&#45;when&#45;sniffing&#45;8"></a>[get an attribute](#concept-get-attributes-when-sniffing) algorithm&#46; The attribute&#39;s name is the value of <var>attribute name</var> and its value is the value of <var>attribute value</var>&#46;
    <strong>If it is in the range 0x41 &#40;A&#41; to 0x5A &#40;Z&#41;</strong>

    Append a code point <var>b</var>&#43;0x20 to <var>attribute value</var> &#40;where <var>b</var> is the value of the byte at <var>position</var>&#41;&#46;
    <strong>Anything else</strong>

    Append a code point with the same value as the byte at <var>position</var> to <var>attribute value</var>&#46;

12. Advance <var>position</var> to the next byte and return to the previous step&#46;

When the <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;prescan&#45;a&#45;byte&#45;stream&#45;to&#45;determine&#45;its&#45;encoding&#45;5"></a>[prescan a byte stream to determine its encoding](#prescan-a-byte-stream-to-determine-its-encoding) algorithm is aborted without returning an encoding&#44; <a id="concept&#45;get&#45;xml&#45;encoding&#45;when&#45;sniffing"></a><strong>get an XML encoding</strong> means doing this&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Looking for syntax resembling an XML declaration&#44; even in <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;text&#47;html"></a><code>[text&#47;html](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#text/html)</code>&#44; is necessary for compatibility with existing content&#46;

1.  Let <var>encodingPosition</var> be a pointer to the start of the stream&#46;

2.  If <var>encodingPosition</var> does not point to the start of a byte sequence 0x3C&#44; 0x3F&#44; 0x78&#44; 0x6D&#44; 0x6C &#40;&#96;<code>&#60;&#63;xml</code>&#96;&#41;&#44; then return failure&#46;

3.  Let <var>xmlDeclarationEnd</var> be a pointer to the next byte in the input byte stream which is 0x3E &#40;&#62;&#41;&#46; If there is no such byte&#44; then return failure&#46;

4.  Set <var>encodingPosition</var> to the position of the first occurrence of the subsequence of bytes 0x65&#44; 0x6E&#44; 0x63&#44; 0x6F&#44; 0x64&#44; 0x69&#44; 0x6E&#44; 0x67 &#40;&#96;<code>encoding</code>&#96;&#41; at or after the current <var>encodingPosition</var> and before <var>xmlDeclarationEnd</var>&#46; If there is no such sequence&#44; then return failure&#46;

5.  Advance <var>encodingPosition</var> past the 0x67 &#40;g&#41; byte&#46;

6.  While the byte at <var>encodingPosition</var> is less than or equal to 0x20 &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; it is either an ASCII space or control character&#41;&#44; advance <var>encodingPosition</var> to the next byte&#46;

7.  If the byte at <var>encodingPosition</var> is not 0x3D &#40;&#61;&#41;&#44; then return failure&#46;

8.  Advance <var>encodingPosition</var> to the next byte&#46;

9.  While the byte at <var>encodingPosition</var> is less than or equal to 0x20 &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; it is either an ASCII space or control character&#41;&#44; advance <var>encodingPosition</var> to the next byte&#46;

10. Let <var>quoteMark</var> be the byte at <var>encodingPosition</var>&#46;

11. If <var>quoteMark</var> is not either 0x22 &#40;&#34;&#41; or 0x27 &#40;&#39;&#41;&#44; then return failure&#46;

12. Advance <var>encodingPosition</var> to the next byte&#46;

13. Let <var>encodingEndPosition</var> be the position of the next occurrence of <var>quoteMark</var> at or after <var>encodingPosition</var>&#46; If <var>quoteMark</var> does not occur again&#44; then return failure&#46;

14. Let <var>potentialEncoding</var> be the sequence of the bytes between <var>encodingPosition</var> &#40;inclusive&#41; and <var>encodingEndPosition</var> &#40;exclusive&#41;&#46;

15. If <var>potentialEncoding</var> contains one or more bytes whose byte value is 0x20 or below&#44; then return failure&#46;

16. Let <var>encoding</var> be the result of <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;getting&#45;an&#45;encoding&#45;2"></a>[getting an encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get) given <var>potentialEncoding</var> <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;isomorphic&#45;decode"></a>[isomorphic decoded](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#isomorphic-decode)&#46;

17. If the <var>encoding</var> is <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;utf&#45;16&#45;encoding&#45;3"></a>[UTF&#45;16BE&#47;LE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16be-le)&#44; then change it to <a id="determining&#45;the&#45;character&#45;encoding&#58;utf&#45;8&#45;2"></a>[UTF&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8)&#46;

18. Return <var>encoding</var>&#46;

For the sake of interoperability&#44; user agents should not use a pre&#45;scan algorithm that returns different results than the one described above&#46; &#40;But&#44; if you do&#44; please at least let us know&#44; so that we can improve this algorithm and benefit everyone&#46;&#46;&#46;&#41;

##### <a id="character&#45;encodings"></a>13&#46;2&#46;3&#46;3 Character encodings[](#character-encodings)

User agents must support the encodings defined in Encoding&#44; including&#44; but not limited to&#44; <a id="utf&#45;8"></a><strong>[UTF&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8)</strong>&#44; <a id="iso&#45;8859&#45;2"></a><strong>[ISO&#45;8859&#45;2](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#iso-8859-2)</strong>&#44; <a id="iso&#45;8859&#45;7"></a><strong>[ISO&#45;8859&#45;7](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#iso-8859-7)</strong>&#44; <a id="iso&#45;8859&#45;8"></a><strong>[ISO&#45;8859&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#iso-8859-8)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;874"></a><strong>[windows&#45;874](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-874)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;1250"></a><strong>[windows&#45;1250](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1250)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;1251"></a><strong>[windows&#45;1251](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1251)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;1252"></a><strong>[windows&#45;1252](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1252)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;1254"></a><strong>[windows&#45;1254](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1254)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;1255"></a><strong>[windows&#45;1255](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1255)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;1256"></a><strong>[windows&#45;1256](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1256)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;1257"></a><strong>[windows&#45;1257](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1257)</strong>&#44; <a id="windows&#45;1258"></a><strong>[windows&#45;1258](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1258)</strong>&#44; <a id="gbk"></a><strong>[GBK](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#gbk)</strong>&#44; <a id="big5"></a><strong>[Big5](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#big5)</strong>&#44; <a id="iso&#45;2022&#45;jp"></a><strong>[ISO&#45;2022&#45;JP](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#iso-2022-jp)</strong>&#44; <a id="shift&#95;jis"></a><strong>[Shift&#95;JIS](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#shift_jis)</strong>&#44; <a id="euc&#45;kr"></a><strong>[EUC&#45;KR](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#euc-kr)</strong>&#44; <a id="utf&#45;16be"></a><strong>[UTF&#45;16BE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16be)</strong>&#44; <a id="utf&#45;16le"></a><strong>[UTF&#45;16LE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16le)</strong>&#44; <a id="utf&#45;16&#45;encoding"></a><strong>[UTF&#45;16BE&#47;LE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16be-le)</strong>&#44; and <a id="x&#45;user&#45;defined"></a><strong>[x&#45;user&#45;defined](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#x-user-defined)</strong>&#46; User agents must not support other encodings&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The above prohibits supporting&#44; for example&#44; CESU&#45;8&#44; UTF&#45;7&#44; BOCU&#45;1&#44; SCSU&#44; EBCDIC&#44; and UTF&#45;32&#46; This specification does not make any attempt to support prohibited encodings in its algorithms&#59; support and use of prohibited encodings would thus lead to unexpected behavior&#46; [&#91;CESU8&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCESU8) [&#91;UTF7&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsUTF7) [&#91;BOCU1&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBOCU1) [&#91;SCSU&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSCSU)

##### <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing"></a>13&#46;2&#46;3&#46;4 Changing the encoding while parsing[](#changing-the-encoding-while-parsing)

When the parser requires the user agent to <a id="change&#45;the&#45;encoding"></a><strong>change the encoding</strong>&#44; it must run the following steps&#46; This might happen if the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;encoding&#45;sniffing&#45;algorithm"></a>[encoding sniffing algorithm](#encoding-sniffing-algorithm) described above failed to find a character encoding&#44; or if it found a character encoding that was not the actual encoding of the file&#46;

1.  If the encoding that is already being used to interpret the input stream is <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;utf&#45;16&#45;encoding"></a>[UTF&#45;16BE&#47;LE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16be-le)&#44; then set the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;encoding&#45;confidence"></a>[confidence](#concept-encoding-confidence) to <em>certain</em> and return&#46; The new encoding is ignored&#59; if it was anything but the same encoding&#44; then it would be clearly incorrect&#46;

2.  If the new encoding is <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;utf&#45;16&#45;encoding&#45;2"></a>[UTF&#45;16BE&#47;LE](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-16be-le)&#44; then change it to <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;utf&#45;8"></a>[UTF&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8)&#46;

3.  If the new encoding is <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;x&#45;user&#45;defined"></a>[x&#45;user&#45;defined](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#x-user-defined)&#44; then change it to <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;windows&#45;1252"></a>[windows&#45;1252](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#windows-1252)&#46;

4.  If the new encoding is identical or equivalent to the encoding that is already being used to interpret the input stream&#44; then set the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;encoding&#45;confidence&#45;2"></a>[confidence](#concept-encoding-confidence) to <em>certain</em> and return&#46; This happens when the encoding information found in the file matches what the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;encoding&#45;sniffing&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[encoding sniffing algorithm](#encoding-sniffing-algorithm) determined to be the encoding&#44; and in the second pass through the parser if the first pass found that the encoding sniffing algorithm described in the earlier section failed to find the right encoding&#46;

5.  If all the bytes up to the last byte converted by the current decoder have the same Unicode interpretations in both the current encoding and the new encoding&#44; and if the user agent supports changing the converter on the fly&#44; then the user agent may change to the new converter for the encoding on the fly&#46; Set the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;document&#39;s&#45;character&#45;encoding"></a>[document&#39;s character encoding](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding) and the encoding used to convert the input stream to the new encoding&#44; set the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;encoding&#45;confidence&#45;3"></a>[confidence](#concept-encoding-confidence) to <em>certain</em>&#44; and return&#46;

6.  Otherwise&#44; restart the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;navigate"></a>[navigate](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) algorithm&#44; with <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;navigation&#45;hh"></a><em>[historyHandling](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-hh)</em> set to &#34;<a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;navigationhistorybehavior&#45;replace"></a><code>[replace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)</code>&#34; and other inputs kept the same&#44; but this time skip the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;encoding&#45;sniffing&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[encoding sniffing algorithm](#encoding-sniffing-algorithm) and instead just set the encoding to the new encoding and the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;encoding&#45;confidence&#45;4"></a>[confidence](#concept-encoding-confidence) to <em>certain</em>&#46; Whenever possible&#44; this should be done without actually contacting the network layer &#40;the bytes should be re&#45;parsed from memory&#41;&#44; even if&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; the document is marked as not being cacheable&#46; If this is not possible and contacting the network layer would involve repeating a request that uses a method other than &#96;<code>GET</code>&#96;&#44; then instead set the <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;encoding&#45;confidence&#45;5"></a>[confidence](#concept-encoding-confidence) to <em>certain</em> and ignore the new encoding&#46; The resource will be misinterpreted&#46; User agents may notify the user of the situation&#44; to aid in application development&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This algorithm is only invoked when a new encoding is found declared on a <a id="changing&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;while&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code> element&#46;

##### <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream"></a>13&#46;2&#46;3&#46;5 Preprocessing the input stream[](#preprocessing-the-input-stream)

The <a id="input&#45;stream"></a><strong>input stream</strong> consists of the characters pushed into it as the <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;the&#45;input&#45;byte&#45;stream"></a>[input byte stream](#the-input-byte-stream) is decoded or from the various APIs that directly manipulate the input stream&#46;

Any occurrences of <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;surrogate"></a>[surrogates](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#surrogate) are <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;surrogate&#45;in&#45;input&#45;stream"></a>[surrogate&#45;in&#45;input&#45;stream](#parse-error-surrogate-in-input-stream) <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse errors](#parse-errors)&#46; Any occurrences of <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;noncharacter"></a>[noncharacters](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#noncharacter) are <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;noncharacter&#45;in&#45;input&#45;stream"></a>[noncharacter&#45;in&#45;input&#45;stream](#parse-error-noncharacter-in-input-stream) <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse errors](#parse-errors) and any occurrences of <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;control"></a>[controls](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#control) other than <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) and U&#43;0000 NULL characters are <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;control&#45;character&#45;in&#45;input&#45;stream"></a>[control&#45;character&#45;in&#45;input&#45;stream](#parse-error-control-character-in-input-stream) <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse errors](#parse-errors)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The handling of U&#43;0000 NULL characters varies based on where the characters are found and happens at the later stages of the parsing&#46; They are either ignored or&#44; for security reasons&#44; replaced with a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER&#46; This handling is&#44; by necessity&#44; spread across both the tokenization stage and the tree construction stage&#46;

Before the <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;tokenization"></a>[tokenization](#tokenization) stage&#44; the input stream must be preprocessed by <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;normalize&#45;newlines"></a>[normalizing newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#normalize-newlines)&#46; Thus&#44; newlines in HTML DOMs are represented by U&#43;000A LF characters&#44; and there are never any U&#43;000D CR characters in the input to the <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;tokenization&#45;2"></a>[tokenization](#tokenization) stage&#46;

The <a id="next&#45;input&#45;character"></a><strong>next input character</strong> is the first character in the <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;input&#45;stream"></a>[input stream](#input-stream) that has not yet been <strong>consumed</strong> or explicitly ignored by the requirements in this section&#46; Initially&#44; the <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a><em>[next input character](#next-input-character)</em> is the first character in the input&#46; The <a id="current&#45;input&#45;character"></a><strong>current input character</strong> is the last character to have been <em>consumed</em>&#46;

The <a id="insertion&#45;point"></a><strong>insertion point</strong> is the position &#40;just before a character or just before the end of the input stream&#41; where content inserted using <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write"></a><code>[document&#46;write&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)</code> is actually inserted&#46; The insertion point is relative to the position of the character immediately after it&#44; it is not an absolute offset into the input stream&#46; Initially&#44; the insertion point is undefined&#46;

The &#34;EOF&#34; character in the tables below is a conceptual character representing the end of the <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;input&#45;stream&#45;2"></a>[input stream](#input-stream)&#46; If the parser is a <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;script&#45;created&#45;parser"></a>[script&#45;created parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#script-created-parser)&#44; then the end of the <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;input&#45;stream&#45;3"></a>[input stream](#input-stream) is reached when an <a id="explicit&#45;eof&#45;character"></a><strong>explicit &#34;EOF&#34; character</strong> &#40;inserted by the <a id="preprocessing&#45;the&#45;input&#45;stream&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;close"></a><code>[document&#46;close&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-close)</code> method&#41; is consumed&#46; Otherwise&#44; the &#34;EOF&#34; character is not a real character in the stream&#44; but rather the lack of any further characters&#46;

#### <a id="parse&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;4 Parse state[](#parse-state)

##### <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>13&#46;2&#46;4&#46;1 The insertion mode[](#the-insertion-mode)

The <a id="insertion&#45;mode"></a><strong>insertion mode</strong> is a state variable that controls the primary operation of the tree construction stage&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The rules for parsing tokens <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign"></a>[in foreign content](#parsing-main-inforeign) are not an <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;tree&#45;construction&#45;dispatcher"></a>[tree construction dispatcher](#tree-construction-dispatcher) selects them independently of the current <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; which is left unchanged while they are in use&#46;

Initially&#44; the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) is &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[initial](#the-initial-insertion-mode)&#34;&#46; It can change to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[before html](#the-before-html-insertion-mode)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[before head](#the-before-head-insertion-mode)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript"></a>[in head noscript](#parsing-main-inheadnoscript)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after head](#the-after-head-insertion-mode)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata"></a>[text](#parsing-main-incdata)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext"></a>[in table text](#parsing-main-intabletext)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption"></a>[in caption](#parsing-main-incaption)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup"></a>[in column group](#parsing-main-incolgroup)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intd"></a>[in cell](#parsing-main-intd)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate"></a>[in template](#parsing-main-intemplate)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody"></a>[after body](#parsing-main-afterbody)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset"></a>[in frameset](#parsing-main-inframeset)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset"></a>[after frameset](#parsing-main-afterframeset)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after after body](#the-after-after-body-insertion-mode)&#34;&#44; and &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after after frameset](#the-after-after-frameset-insertion-mode)&#34; during the course of the parsing&#44; as described in the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;tree&#45;construction"></a>[tree construction](#tree-construction) stage&#46; The insertion mode affects how tokens are processed&#46;

Several of these modes&#44; namely &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#45;2"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34;&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;2"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34;&#44; and &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#45;2"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#44; are special&#44; in that the other modes defer to them at various times&#46; When the algorithm below says that the user agent is to do something &#34;<a id="using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a><strong>using the rules for</strong> the <var>m</var> insertion mode&#34;&#44; where <var>m</var> is one of these modes&#44; the user agent must use the rules described under the <var>m</var> <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#39;s section&#44; but must leave the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) unchanged unless the rules in <var>m</var> themselves switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to a new value&#46;

When the insertion mode is switched to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#45;2"></a>[text](#parsing-main-incdata)&#34; or &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#45;2"></a>[in table text](#parsing-main-intabletext)&#34;&#44; the <a id="original&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a><strong>original insertion mode</strong> is also set&#46; This is the insertion mode to which the tree construction stage will return&#46;

Similarly&#44; to parse nested <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> elements&#44; a <a id="stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes"></a><strong>stack of template insertion modes</strong> is used&#46; It is initially empty&#46; The <a id="current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a><strong>current template insertion mode</strong> is the insertion mode that was most recently added to the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes)&#46; The algorithms in the sections below will <em>push</em> insertion modes onto this stack&#44; meaning that the specified insertion mode is to be added to the stack&#44; and <em>pop</em> insertion modes from the stack&#44; which means that the most recently added insertion mode must be removed from the stack&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When the steps below require the UA to <a id="reset&#45;the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;appropriately"></a><strong>reset the insertion mode appropriately</strong>&#44; it means the UA must follow these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>last</var> be false&#46;

2.  Let <var>node</var> be the last node in the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

3.  <em>Loop</em>&#58; If <var>node</var> is the first node in the stack of open elements&#44; then set <var>last</var> to true&#44; and&#44; if the parser&#39;s <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is non&#45;null&#44; then set <var>node</var> to that element &#40;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;&#46;

4.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element and <var>last</var> is false&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;7"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#45;2"></a>[in cell](#parsing-main-intd)&#34; and return&#46;

5.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;8"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#45;2"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34; and return&#46;

6.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;9"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#45;2"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34; and return&#46;

7.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;10"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#45;2"></a>[in caption](#parsing-main-incaption)&#34; and return&#46;

8.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;11"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#45;2"></a>[in column group](#parsing-main-incolgroup)&#34; and return&#46;

9.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;12"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#45;3"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34; and return&#46;

10. If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;13"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode) and return&#46;

11. If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element and <var>last</var> is false&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;14"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#45;3"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; and return&#46;

12. If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;15"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;3"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; and return&#46;

13. If <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;frameset"></a><code>[frameset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frameset)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;16"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#45;2"></a>[in frameset](#parsing-main-inframeset)&#34; and return&#46; &#40;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;2"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

14. If <var>node</var> is an <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; run these substeps&#58;

    1.  If the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;head&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>head</code> element pointer](#head-element-pointer) is null&#44; switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;17"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[before head](#the-before-head-insertion-mode)&#34; and return&#46; &#40;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;3"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

    2.  Otherwise&#44; the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;head&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;2"></a>[<code>head</code> element pointer](#head-element-pointer) is not null&#44; switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;18"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[after head](#the-after-head-insertion-mode)&#34; and return&#46;

15. If <var>last</var> is true&#44; then switch the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;19"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;4"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; and return&#46; &#40;<a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;4"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

16. Let <var>node</var> now be the node before <var>node</var> in the <a id="the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

17. Return to the step labeled <em>loop</em>&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>13&#46;2&#46;4&#46;2 The stack of open elements[](#the-stack-of-open-elements)

Initially&#44; the <a id="stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a><strong>stack of open elements</strong> is empty&#46; The stack grows downwards&#59; the topmost node on the stack is the first one added to the stack&#44; and the bottommost node of the stack is the most recently added node in the stack &#40;notwithstanding when the stack is manipulated in a random access fashion as part of [the handling for misnested tags](#adoptionAgency)&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The &#34;<a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[before html](#the-before-html-insertion-mode)&#34; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) creates the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;document&#45;element"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#44; which is then added to the stack&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#44; the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is initialized to contain an <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element that is created as part of <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;html&#45;fragment&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[that algorithm](#html-fragment-parsing-algorithm)&#46; &#40;The <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;2"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case) skips the &#34;<a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[before html](#the-before-html-insertion-mode)&#34; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;&#41;

The <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> node&#44; however it is created&#44; is the topmost node of the stack&#46; It only gets popped off the stack when the parser <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[finishes](#stop-parsing)&#46;

The <a id="current&#45;node"></a><strong>current node</strong> is the bottommost node in this <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

The <a id="adjusted&#45;current&#45;node"></a><strong>adjusted current node</strong> is the parser&#39;s <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) if that element is non&#45;null and the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has only one element in it &#40;<a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;3"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;&#59; otherwise&#44; the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#46;

When the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) is removed from the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;process&#45;internal&#45;resource&#45;links"></a>[process internal resource links](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#process-internal-resource-links) given the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

Elements in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) fall into the following categories&#58;
