<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

An <code>image</code> start tag token is handled by the tree builder&#44; but it is not in this list because it is not an element&#59; it gets turned into an <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="formatting"></a><strong>Formatting</strong></strong>

The following HTML elements are those that end up in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#58; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;big"></a><code>[big](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#big)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;code&#45;element"></a><code>[code](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-code-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;em&#45;element"></a><code>[em](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-em-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;font"></a><code>[font](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#font)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;nobr"></a><code>[nobr](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#nobr)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;s&#45;element"></a><code>[s](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-s-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;small&#45;element"></a><code>[small](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-small-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;strike"></a><code>[strike](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#strike)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;strong&#45;element"></a><code>[strong](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-strong-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;tt"></a><code>[tt](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#tt)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;u&#45;element"></a><code>[u](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-u-element)</code>&#46;

<strong><a id="ordinary"></a><strong>Ordinary</strong></strong>

All other elements found while parsing an HTML document&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Typically&#44; the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;special"></a>[special](#special) elements have the start and end tag tokens handled specifically&#44; while <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;ordinary"></a>[ordinary](#ordinary) elements&#39; tokens fall into &#34;any other start tag&#34; and &#34;any other end tag&#34; clauses&#44; and some parts of the tree builder check if a particular element in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;special&#45;2"></a>[special](#special) category&#46; However&#44; some elements &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#41; have their start or end tag tokens handled specifically&#44; but are still not in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;special&#45;3"></a>[special](#special) category&#44; so that they get the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;ordinary&#45;2"></a>[ordinary](#ordinary) handling elsewhere&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;7"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is said to <a id="has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;the&#45;specific&#45;scope"></a><strong>have an element <var>target node</var> in a specific scope</strong> consisting of a list of element types <var>list</var> when the following algorithm terminates in a match state&#58;

1.  Initialize <var>node</var> to be the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;the bottommost node of the stack&#41;&#46;

2.  If <var>node</var> is <var>target node</var>&#44; terminate in a match state&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>node</var> is one of the element types in <var>list</var>&#44; terminate in a failure state&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>node</var> to the previous entry in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and return to step 2&#46; &#40;This will never fail&#44; since the loop will always terminate in the previous step if the top of the stack — an <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element — is reached&#46;&#41;

The <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;9"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is said to <a id="has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope"></a><strong>have a particular element in scope</strong> when it <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;the&#45;specific&#45;scope"></a>[has that element in the specific scope](#has-an-element-in-the-specific-scope) consisting of the following element types&#58;

- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;applet&#45;2"></a><code>[applet](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#applet)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;marquee&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[marquee](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#the-marquee-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;mathml&#45;mi&#45;2"></a>[MathML <code>mi</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#the-mi-element)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;mathml&#45;mo&#45;2"></a>[MathML <code>mo</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#operator-fence-separator-or-accent-mo)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;mathml&#45;mn&#45;2"></a>[MathML <code>mn</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#number-mn)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;mathml&#45;ms&#45;2"></a>[MathML <code>ms</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#string-literal-ms)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;mathml&#45;mtext&#45;2"></a>[MathML <code>mtext</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#text-mtext)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;mathml&#45;annotation&#45;xml&#45;2"></a>[MathML <code>annotation&#45;xml</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#dfn-annotation-xml)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;svg&#45;foreignobject&#45;2"></a>[SVG <code>foreignObject</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/embedded.html#elementdef-foreignObject)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;svg&#45;desc&#45;2"></a>[SVG <code>desc</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-desc)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;svg&#45;title&#45;2"></a>[SVG <code>title</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-title)

The <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;10"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is said to <a id="has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;list&#45;item&#45;scope"></a><strong>have a particular element in list item scope</strong> when it <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;the&#45;specific&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[has that element in the specific scope](#has-an-element-in-the-specific-scope) consisting of the following element types&#58;

- All the element types listed above for the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope"></a><em>[has an element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)</em> algorithm&#46;
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;ol&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[ol](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ol-element)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;ul&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[ul](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ul-element)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)

The <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;11"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is said to <a id="has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope"></a><strong>have a particular element in button scope</strong> when it <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;the&#45;specific&#45;scope&#45;3"></a>[has that element in the specific scope](#has-an-element-in-the-specific-scope) consisting of the following element types&#58;

- All the element types listed above for the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;2"></a><em>[has an element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)</em> algorithm&#46;
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[button](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-button-element)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)

The <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;12"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is said to <a id="has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope"></a><strong>have a particular element in table scope</strong> when it <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;the&#45;specific&#45;scope&#45;4"></a>[has that element in the specific scope](#has-an-element-in-the-specific-scope) consisting of the following element types&#58;

- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;4"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;5"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)
- <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;6"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)

Nothing happens if at any time any of the elements in the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;13"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) are moved to a new location in&#44; or removed from&#44; the <a id="the&#45;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> tree&#46; In particular&#44; the stack is not changed in this situation&#46; This can cause&#44; amongst other strange effects&#44; content to be appended to nodes that are no longer in the DOM&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In some cases &#40;namely&#44; when [closing misnested formatting elements](#adoptionAgency)&#41;&#44; the stack is manipulated in a random&#45;access fashion&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>13&#46;2&#46;4&#46;3 The list of active formatting elements[](#the-list-of-active-formatting-elements)

Initially&#44; the <a id="list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a><strong>list of active formatting elements</strong> is empty&#46; It is used to handle mis&#45;nested <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;formatting"></a>[formatting element tags](#formatting)&#46;

The list contains elements in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;formatting&#45;2"></a>[formatting](#formatting) category&#44; and <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker"></a>[markers](#concept-parser-marker)&#46; The <a id="concept&#45;parser&#45;marker"></a><strong>markers</strong> are inserted when entering <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;applet"></a><code>[applet](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#applet)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;marquee&#45;element"></a><code>[marquee](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#the-marquee-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> elements&#44; and are used to prevent formatting from &#34;leaking&#34; <em>into</em> <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;applet&#45;2"></a><code>[applet](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#applet)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;marquee&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[marquee](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#the-marquee-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> elements&#46;

In addition&#44; each element in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) is associated with the token for which it was created&#44; so that further elements can be created for that token if necessary&#46;

When the steps below require the UA to <a id="push&#45;onto&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a><strong>push onto the list of active formatting elements</strong> an element <var>element</var>&#44; the UA must perform the following steps&#58;

<a id="noah"></a>

1.  If there are already three elements in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) after the last <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker)&#44; if any&#44; or anywhere in the list if there are no <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;3"></a>[markers](#concept-parser-marker)&#44; that have the same tag name&#44; namespace&#44; and attributes as <var>element</var>&#44; then remove the earliest such element from the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46; For these purposes&#44; the attributes must be compared as they were when the elements were created by the parser&#59; two elements have the same attributes if all their parsed attributes can be paired such that the two attributes in each pair have identical names&#44; namespaces&#44; and values &#40;the order of the attributes does not matter&#41;&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This is the Noah&#39;s Ark clause&#46; But with three per family instead of two&#46;

2.  Add <var>element</var> to the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

When the steps below require the UA to <a id="reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a><strong>reconstruct the active formatting elements</strong>&#44; the UA must perform the following steps&#58;

1.  If there are no entries in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; then there is nothing to reconstruct&#59; stop this algorithm&#46;

2.  If the last &#40;most recently added&#41; entry in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) is a <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;4"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker)&#44; or if it is an element that is in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; then there is nothing to reconstruct&#59; stop this algorithm&#46;

3.  Let <var>entry</var> be the last &#40;most recently added&#41; element in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;7"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

4.  <em>Rewind</em>&#58; If there are no entries before <var>entry</var> in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>create</em>&#46;

5.  Let <var>entry</var> be the entry one earlier than <var>entry</var> in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;9"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

6.  If <var>entry</var> is neither a <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;5"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) nor an element that is also in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; go to the step labeled <em>rewind</em>&#46;

7.  <em>Advance</em>&#58; Let <var>entry</var> be the element one later than <var>entry</var> in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;10"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

8.  <em>Create</em>&#58; <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token for which the element <var>entry</var> was created&#44; to obtain <var>new element</var>&#46;

9.  Replace the entry for <var>entry</var> in the list with an entry for <var>new element</var>&#46;

10. If the entry for <var>new element</var> in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;11"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) is not the last entry in the list&#44; return to the step labeled <em>advance</em>&#46;

This has the effect of reopening all the formatting elements that were opened in the current body&#44; cell&#44; or caption &#40;whichever is youngest&#41; that haven&#39;t been explicitly closed&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The way this specification is written&#44; the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;12"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) always consists of elements in chronological order with the least recently added element first and the most recently added element last &#40;except for while steps 7 to 10 of the above algorithm are being executed&#44; of course&#41;&#46;

When the steps below require the UA to <a id="clear&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;up&#45;to&#45;the&#45;last&#45;marker"></a><strong>clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker</strong>&#44; the UA must perform the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>entry</var> be the last &#40;most recently added&#41; entry in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;13"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

2.  Remove <var>entry</var> from the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;14"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

3.  If <var>entry</var> was a <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;6"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker)&#44; then stop the algorithm at this point&#46; The list has been cleared up to the last <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;7"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker)&#46;

4.  Go to step 1&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers"></a>13&#46;2&#46;4&#46;4 The element pointers[](#the-element-pointers)

Initially&#44; the <a id="head&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a><strong><code>head</code> element pointer</strong> and the <a id="form&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a><strong><code>form</code> element pointer</strong> are both null&#46;

Once a <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element has been parsed &#40;whether implicitly or explicitly&#41; the <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;head&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>head</code> element pointer](#head-element-pointer) gets set to point to this node&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) points to the last <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element that was opened and whose end tag has not yet been seen&#46; It is used to make form controls associate with forms in the face of dramatically bad markup&#44; for historical reasons&#46; It is ignored inside <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> elements&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) is <a id="parsing&#45;template&#45;contents"></a><strong>parsing template contents</strong> if there is a <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element on the <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; or the parser&#39;s <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is a <a id="the&#45;element&#45;pointers&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#46;

##### <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags"></a>13&#46;2&#46;4&#46;5 Other parsing state flags[](#other-parsing-state-flags)

The <a id="root&#45;insertion&#45;target"></a><strong>root insertion target</strong>&#44; which is null or a <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;documentfragment"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> &#40;initially null&#41;&#46;

An <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code>&#45;or&#45;null <a id="fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a><strong>fragment context element</strong>&#44; initially null&#46;

A boolean <a id="allow&#45;declarative&#45;shadow&#45;roots"></a><strong>allow declarative shadow roots</strong> &#40;initially false&#41;&#46;

The <a id="scripting&#45;mode"></a><strong>scripting mode</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;parser&#45;scripting&#45;mode"></a>[parser scripting mode](#parser-scripting-mode)&#46; It is initially set to <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;normal"></a>[Normal](#scripting-mode-normal) if <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script"></a>[scripting was enabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script) for the <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> with which the parser is associated when the parser was created&#44; and <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled"></a>[Disabled](#scripting-mode-disabled) otherwise&#46;

A <a id="parser&#45;scripting&#45;mode"></a><strong>parser scripting mode</strong> is one of the following&#58;

<strong><a id="scripting&#45;mode&#45;normal"></a><strong>Normal</strong></strong>

Scripts are processed when inserted&#44; respecting <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async"></a><code>[async](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-script-async)</code> and <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer"></a><code>[defer](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-script-defer)</code> attributes and blocking the parser when encountering a <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;classic&#45;script"></a>[classic script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#classic-script)&#46;

<strong><a id="scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled"></a><strong>Disabled</strong></strong>

Scripts are disabled&#44; and the <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code> element can represent fallback content&#46;

<strong><a id="scripting&#45;mode&#45;inert"></a><strong>Inert</strong></strong>

Scripts are enabled&#44; however they are marked as <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;already&#45;started"></a>[already started](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#already-started)&#44; essentially preventing them from executing&#46; This is the default mode of the <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;html&#45;fragment&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[HTML fragment parsing algorithm](#html-fragment-parsing-algorithm)&#46;

<strong><a id="scripting&#45;mode&#45;fragment"></a><strong>Fragment</strong></strong>

Scripts are executed as soon as they are inserted into the document as part of the <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;html&#45;fragment&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[HTML fragment parsing algorithm](#html-fragment-parsing-algorithm)&#44; ignoring <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;async&#45;2"></a><code>[async](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-script-async)</code> and <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;defer&#45;2"></a><code>[defer](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-script-defer)</code> attributes&#46; This mode is used by <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;dom&#45;range&#45;createcontextualfragment"></a><code>[createContextualFragment&#40;&#41;](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-range-createcontextualfragment)</code>&#44; by <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;sethtmlunsafe"></a><code>[setHTMLUnsafe&#40;&#41;](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-sethtmlunsafe)</code> when <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;dom&#45;sethtmlunsafeoptions&#45;runscripts"></a><code>[runScripts](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-sethtmlunsafeoptions-runscripts)</code> is true&#44; and by <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;innerhtml"></a><code>[innerHTML](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-innerhtml)</code>&#44; <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;outerhtml"></a><code>[outerHTML](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-outerhtml)</code>&#44; and <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;insertadjacenthtml"></a><code>[insertAdjacentHTML&#40;&#41;](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-insertadjacenthtml)</code> when a Trusted Types default policy enables script execution&#46;

The <a id="frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag"></a><strong>frameset&#45;ok flag</strong> is set to &#34;ok&#34; when the parser is created&#46; It is set to &#34;not ok&#34; after certain tokens are seen&#44; and back to &#34;ok&#34; when the <a id="other&#45;parsing&#45;state&#45;flags&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element is inserted implicitly&#46;

#### <a id="tokenization"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5 <strong>Tokenization</strong>[](#tokenization)

Implementations must act as if they used the following state machine to tokenize HTML&#46; The state machine must start in the <a id="tokenization&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Most states consume a single character&#44; which may have various side&#45;effects&#44; and either switches the state machine to a new state to <a id="tokenization&#58;reconsume"></a>[reconsume](#reconsume) the <a id="tokenization&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character)&#44; or switches it to a new state to consume the <a id="tokenization&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next character](#next-input-character)&#44; or stays in the same state to consume the next character&#46; Some states have more complicated behavior and can consume several characters before switching to another state&#46; In some cases&#44; the tokenizer state is also changed by the tree construction stage&#46;

When a state says to <a id="reconsume"></a><strong>reconsume</strong> a matched character in a specified state&#44; that means to switch to that state&#44; but when it attempts to consume the <a id="tokenization&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#44; provide it with the <a id="tokenization&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) instead&#46;

The exact behavior of certain states depends on the <a id="tokenization&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) and the <a id="tokenization&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; Certain states also use a <a id="temporary&#45;buffer"></a><strong><var>temporary buffer</var></strong> to track progress&#44; and the <a id="tokenization&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>[character reference state](#character-reference-state) uses a <a id="return&#45;state"></a><strong><var>return state</var></strong> to return to the state it was invoked from&#46;

The output of the tokenization step is a series of zero or more of the following tokens&#58; DOCTYPE&#44; start tag&#44; end tag&#44; comment&#44; character&#44; end&#45;of&#45;file&#46; DOCTYPE tokens have a name&#44; a public identifier&#44; a system identifier&#44; and a <a id="force&#45;quirks&#45;flag"></a><strong><em>force&#45;quirks flag</em></strong>&#46; When a DOCTYPE token is created&#44; its name&#44; public identifier&#44; and system identifier must be marked as missing &#40;which is a distinct state from the empty string&#41;&#44; and the <a id="tokenization&#58;force&#45;quirks&#45;flag"></a><em>[force&#45;quirks flag](#force-quirks-flag)</em> must be set to <em>off</em> &#40;its other state is <em>on</em>&#41;&#46; Start and end tag tokens have a tag name&#44; a <a id="self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a><strong>self&#45;closing flag</strong>&#44; and a list of attributes&#44; each of which has a name and a value&#46; When a start or end tag token is created&#44; its <a id="tokenization&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a><em>[self&#45;closing flag](#self-closing-flag)</em> must be unset &#40;its other state is that it be set&#41;&#44; and its attributes list must be empty&#46; Comment and character tokens have data&#46;

When a token is emitted&#44; it must immediately be handled by the <a id="tokenization&#58;tree&#45;construction"></a>[tree construction](#tree-construction) stage&#46; The tree construction stage can affect the state of the tokenization stage&#44; and can insert additional characters into the stream&#46; &#40;For example&#44; the <a id="tokenization&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element can result in scripts executing and using the <a id="tokenization&#58;dynamic&#45;markup&#45;insertion"></a>[dynamic markup insertion](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dynamic-markup-insertion) APIs to insert characters into the stream being tokenized&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Creating a token and emitting it are distinct actions&#46; It is possible for a token to be created but implicitly abandoned &#40;never emitted&#41;&#44; e&#46;g&#46; if the file ends unexpectedly while processing the characters that are being parsed into a start tag token&#46;

When a start tag token is emitted with its <a id="tokenization&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;2"></a><em>[self&#45;closing flag](#self-closing-flag)</em> set&#44; if the flag is not <a id="acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a><strong>acknowledged</strong> when it is processed by the tree construction stage&#44; that is a <a id="tokenization&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;non&#45;void&#45;html&#45;element&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;with&#45;trailing&#45;solidus"></a>[non&#45;void&#45;html&#45;element&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;with&#45;trailing&#45;solidus](#parse-error-non-void-html-element-start-tag-with-trailing-solidus) <a id="tokenization&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

When an end tag token is emitted with attributes&#44; that is an <a id="tokenization&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;with&#45;attributes"></a>[end&#45;tag&#45;with&#45;attributes](#parse-error-end-tag-with-attributes) <a id="tokenization&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

When an end tag token is emitted with its <a id="tokenization&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;3"></a><em>[self&#45;closing flag](#self-closing-flag)</em> set&#44; that is an <a id="tokenization&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;with&#45;trailing&#45;solidus"></a>[end&#45;tag&#45;with&#45;trailing&#45;solidus](#parse-error-end-tag-with-trailing-solidus) <a id="tokenization&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

An <a id="appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token"></a><strong>appropriate end tag token</strong> is an end tag token whose tag name matches the tag name of the last start tag to have been emitted from this tokenizer&#44; if any&#46; If no start tag has been emitted from this tokenizer&#44; then no end tag token is appropriate&#46;

A <a id="tokenization&#58;syntax&#45;charref"></a>[character reference](#syntax-charref) is said to be <a id="charref&#45;in&#45;attribute"></a><strong>consumed as part of an attribute</strong> if the <a id="tokenization&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var> is either <a id="tokenization&#58;attribute&#45;value&#45;&#40;double&#45;quoted&#41;&#45;state"></a>[attribute value &#40;double&#45;quoted&#41; state](#attribute-value-(double-quoted)-state)&#44; <a id="tokenization&#58;attribute&#45;value&#45;&#40;single&#45;quoted&#41;&#45;state"></a>[attribute value &#40;single&#45;quoted&#41; state](#attribute-value-(single-quoted)-state)&#44; or <a id="tokenization&#58;attribute&#45;value&#45;&#40;unquoted&#41;&#45;state"></a>[attribute value &#40;unquoted&#41; state](#attribute-value-(unquoted)-state)&#46;

When a state says to <a id="flush&#45;code&#45;points&#45;consumed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;character&#45;reference"></a><strong>flush code points consumed as a character reference</strong>&#44; it means that for each <a id="tokenization&#58;code&#45;point"></a>[code point](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-point) in the <a id="tokenization&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> &#40;in the order they were added to the buffer&#41;&#44; the user agent must append the code point from the buffer to the current attribute&#39;s value if the character reference was <a id="tokenization&#58;charref&#45;in&#45;attribute"></a>[consumed as part of an attribute](#charref-in-attribute)&#44; or emit the code point as a character token otherwise&#46;

To <a id="convert&#45;the&#45;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;to&#45;a&#45;comment"></a><strong>convert the temporary buffer to a comment</strong>&#44; create a comment token whose data is the concatenation of &#34;<code>&#63;</code>&#34; and the <a id="tokenization&#58;code&#45;point&#45;2"></a>[code points](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-point) in the <a id="tokenization&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#44; in the order they were added to the buffer&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This is used when a processing instruction is found to have an invalid target and is instead treated as a bogus comment&#46;

<a id="check&#45;parser&#45;pause&#45;flag"></a>Before each step of the tokenizer&#44; the user agent must first check the <a id="tokenization&#58;parser&#45;pause&#45;flag"></a>[parser pause flag](#parser-pause-flag)&#46; If it is true&#44; then the tokenizer must abort the processing of any nested invocations of the tokenizer&#44; yielding control back to the caller&#46;

The tokenizer state machine consists of the states defined in the following subsections&#46;

##### <a id="data&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;1 <strong>Data state</strong>[](#data-state)

Consume the <a id="data&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0026 AMPERSAND &#40;&#38;&#41;</strong>

Set the <a id="data&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var> to the <a id="data&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Switch to the <a id="data&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>[character reference state](#character-reference-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="data&#45;state&#58;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>[tag open state](#tag-open-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="data&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="data&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit the <a id="data&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit the <a id="data&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

##### <a id="rcdata&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;2 <strong>RCDATA state</strong>[](#rcdata-state)

Consume the <a id="rcdata&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0026 AMPERSAND &#40;&#38;&#41;</strong>

Set the <a id="rcdata&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var> to the <a id="rcdata&#45;state&#58;rcdata&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA state](#rcdata-state)&#46; Switch to the <a id="rcdata&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>[character reference state](#character-reference-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="rcdata&#45;state&#58;rcdata&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA less&#45;than sign state](#rcdata-less-than-sign-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="rcdata&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="rcdata&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit the <a id="rcdata&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

##### <a id="rawtext&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;3 <strong>RAWTEXT state</strong>[](#rawtext-state)

Consume the <a id="rawtext&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="rawtext&#45;state&#58;rawtext&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>[RAWTEXT less&#45;than sign state](#rawtext-less-than-sign-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="rawtext&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="rawtext&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit the <a id="rawtext&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;4 <strong>Script data state</strong>[](#script-data-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>[script data less&#45;than sign state](#script-data-less-than-sign-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="script&#45;data&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

##### <a id="plaintext&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;5 <strong>PLAINTEXT state</strong>[](#plaintext-state)

Consume the <a id="plaintext&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="plaintext&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="plaintext&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit the <a id="plaintext&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

##### <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;6 <strong>Tag open state</strong>[](#tag-open-state)

Consume the <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0021 EXCLAMATION MARK &#40;&#33;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state"></a>[markup declaration open state](#markup-declaration-open-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>[end tag open state](#end-tag-open-state)&#46;

<strong><a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alpha)</strong>

Create a new start tag token&#44; set its tag name to the empty string&#46; <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[tag name state](#tag-name-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003F QUESTION MARK &#40;&#63;&#41;</strong>

Set the <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> to the empty string&#46; Switch to the <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state"></a>[processing instruction open state](#processing-instruction-open-state)&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;before&#45;tag&#45;name"></a>[eof&#45;before&#45;tag&#45;name](#parse-error-eof-before-tag-name) <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token and an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is an <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;invalid&#45;first&#45;character&#45;of&#45;tag&#45;name"></a>[invalid&#45;first&#45;character&#45;of&#45;tag&#45;name](#parse-error-invalid-first-character-of-tag-name) <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#46; <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46;

##### <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;7 <strong>End tag open state</strong>[](#end-tag-open-state)

Consume the <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alpha)</strong>

Create a new end tag token&#44; set its tag name to the empty string&#46; <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[tag name state](#tag-name-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

This is a <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;missing&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name"></a>[missing&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name](#parse-error-missing-end-tag-name) <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Switch to the <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;before&#45;tag&#45;name"></a>[eof&#45;before&#45;tag&#45;name](#parse-error-eof-before-tag-name) <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#44; a U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character token and an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is an <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;invalid&#45;first&#45;character&#45;of&#45;tag&#45;name"></a>[invalid&#45;first&#45;character&#45;of&#45;tag&#45;name](#parse-error-invalid-first-character-of-tag-name) <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Create a comment token whose data is the empty string&#46; <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;bogus&#45;comment&#45;state"></a>[bogus comment state](#bogus-comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;8 <strong>Tag name state</strong>[](#tag-name-state)

Consume the <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Switch to the <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[before attribute name state](#before-attribute-name-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;state"></a>[self&#45;closing start tag state](#self-closing-start-tag-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current tag token&#46;

<strong><a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII upper alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha)</strong>

Append the lowercase version of the <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;add 0x0020 to the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Append a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;tag"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;tag](#parse-error-eof-in-tag) <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append the <a id="tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46;

##### <a id="rcdata&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;9 <strong>RCDATA less&#45;than sign state</strong>[](#rcdata-less-than-sign-state)

Consume the <a id="rcdata&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

Set the <a id="rcdata&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> to the empty string&#46; Switch to the <a id="rcdata&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA end tag open state](#rcdata-end-tag-open-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#46; <a id="rcdata&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="rcdata&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;rcdata&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA state](#rcdata-state)&#46;

##### <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;10 <strong>RCDATA end tag open state</strong>[](#rcdata-end-tag-open-state)

Consume the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alpha)</strong>

Create a new end tag token&#44; set its tag name to the empty string&#46; <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA end tag name state](#rcdata-end-tag-name-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token and a U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character token&#46; <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;rcdata&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA state](#rcdata-state)&#46;

##### <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;11 <strong>RCDATA end tag name state</strong>[](#rcdata-end-tag-name-state)

Consume the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[before attribute name state](#before-attribute-name-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token&#45;2"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;state"></a>[self&#45;closing start tag state](#self-closing-start-tag-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token&#45;3"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state) and emit the current tag token&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong><a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII upper alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha)</strong>

Append the lowercase version of the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;add 0x0020 to the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46; Append the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII lower alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-alpha)</strong>

Append the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;3"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46; Append the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;4"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#44; a U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character token&#44; and a character token for each of the characters in the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;3"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> &#40;in the order they were added to the buffer&#41;&#46; <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="rcdata&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;rcdata&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA state](#rcdata-state)&#46;

##### <a id="rawtext&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;12 <strong>RAWTEXT less&#45;than sign state</strong>[](#rawtext-less-than-sign-state)

Consume the <a id="rawtext&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

Set the <a id="rawtext&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> to the empty string&#46; Switch to the <a id="rawtext&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>[RAWTEXT end tag open state](#rawtext-end-tag-open-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#46; <a id="rawtext&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="rawtext&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;rawtext&#45;state"></a>[RAWTEXT state](#rawtext-state)&#46;

##### <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;13 <strong>RAWTEXT end tag open state</strong>[](#rawtext-end-tag-open-state)

Consume the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alpha)</strong>

Create a new end tag token&#44; set its tag name to the empty string&#46; <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[RAWTEXT end tag name state](#rawtext-end-tag-name-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token and a U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character token&#46; <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;rawtext&#45;state"></a>[RAWTEXT state](#rawtext-state)&#46;

##### <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;14 <strong>RAWTEXT end tag name state</strong>[](#rawtext-end-tag-name-state)

Consume the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[before attribute name state](#before-attribute-name-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token&#45;2"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;state"></a>[self&#45;closing start tag state](#self-closing-start-tag-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token&#45;3"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state) and emit the current tag token&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong><a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII upper alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha)</strong>

Append the lowercase version of the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;add 0x0020 to the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46; Append the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII lower alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-alpha)</strong>

Append the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;3"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46; Append the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;4"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#44; a U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character token&#44; and a character token for each of the characters in the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;3"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> &#40;in the order they were added to the buffer&#41;&#46; <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="rawtext&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;rawtext&#45;state"></a>[RAWTEXT state](#rawtext-state)&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;15 <strong>Script data less&#45;than sign state</strong>[](#script-data-less-than-sign-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

Set the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> to the empty string&#46; Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>[script data end tag open state](#script-data-end-tag-open-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#46; <a id="script&#45;data&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;state"></a>[script data state](#script-data-state)&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;16 <strong>Script data end tag open state</strong>[](#script-data-end-tag-open-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="script&#45;data&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alpha)</strong>

Create a new end tag token&#44; set its tag name to the empty string&#46; <a id="script&#45;data&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[script data end tag name state](#script-data-end-tag-name-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>
