##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;24 <strong>Script data escaped end tag open state</strong>[](#script-data-escaped-end-tag-open-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alpha)</strong>

Create a new end tag token&#44; set its tag name to the empty string&#46; <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[script data escaped end tag name state](#script-data-escaped-end-tag-name-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token and a U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character token&#46; <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;open&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data escaped state](#script-data-escaped-state)&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;25 <strong>Script data escaped end tag name state</strong>[](#script-data-escaped-end-tag-name-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[before attribute name state](#before-attribute-name-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token&#45;2"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;start&#45;tag&#45;state"></a>[self&#45;closing start tag state](#self-closing-start-tag-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

If the current end tag token is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token&#45;3"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token)&#44; then switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state) and emit the current tag token&#46; Otherwise&#44; treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong><a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII upper alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha)</strong>

Append the lowercase version of the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;add 0x0020 to the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46; Append the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII lower alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-alpha)</strong>

Append the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;3"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the current tag token&#39;s tag name&#46; Append the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;4"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#44; a U&#43;002F SOLIDUS character token&#44; and a character token for each of the characters in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;3"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer) </var> &#40;in the order they were added to the buffer&#41;&#46; <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;name&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data escaped state](#script-data-escaped-state)&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;26 <strong>Script data double escape start state</strong>[](#script-data-double-escape-start-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

If the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> is &#34;<code>script</code>&#34;&#44; then switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped state](#script-data-double-escaped-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data escaped state](#script-data-escaped-state)&#46; Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

<strong><a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII upper alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha)</strong>

Append the lowercase version of the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;add 0x0020 to the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46; Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;3"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

<strong><a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII lower alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-alpha)</strong>

Append the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;4"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;3"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46; Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;5"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;start&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[script data escaped state](#script-data-escaped-state)&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;27 <strong>Script data double escaped state</strong>[](#script-data-double-escaped-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped dash state](#script-data-double-escaped-dash-state)&#46; Emit a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped less&#45;than sign state](#script-data-double-escaped-less-than-sign-state)&#46; Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;script&#45;html&#45;comment&#45;like&#45;text"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;script&#45;html&#45;comment&#45;like&#45;text](#parse-error-eof-in-script-html-comment-like-text) <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;28 <strong>Script data double escaped dash state</strong>[](#script-data-double-escaped-dash-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped dash dash state](#script-data-double-escaped-dash-dash-state)&#46; Emit a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped less&#45;than sign state](#script-data-double-escaped-less-than-sign-state)&#46; Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped state](#script-data-double-escaped-state)&#46; Emit a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[script data double escaped state](#script-data-double-escaped-state)&#46; Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;29 <strong>Script data double escaped dash dash state</strong>[](#script-data-double-escaped-dash-dash-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Emit a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped less&#45;than sign state](#script-data-double-escaped-less-than-sign-state)&#46; Emit a U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped state](#script-data-double-escaped-state)&#46; Emit a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;script&#45;html&#45;comment&#45;like&#45;text"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;script&#45;html&#45;comment&#45;like&#45;text](#parse-error-eof-in-script-html-comment-like-text) <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[script data double escaped state](#script-data-double-escaped-state)&#46; Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;30 <strong>Script data double escaped less&#45;than sign state</strong>[](#script-data-double-escaped-less-than-sign-state)

Consume the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped state](#script-data-double-escaped-state)&#46;

##### <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;31 <strong>Script data double escape end state</strong>[](#script-data-double-escape-end-state)

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

If the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> is &#34;<code>script</code>&#34;&#44; then switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data escaped state](#script-data-escaped-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; switch to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state"></a>[script data double escaped state](#script-data-double-escaped-state)&#46; Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

Append the lowercase version of the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;add 0x0020 to the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46; Emit the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;3"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escape&#45;end&#45;state&#58;script&#45;data&#45;double&#45;escaped&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[script data double escaped state](#script-data-double-escaped-state)&#46;

##### <a id="before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;32 <strong>Before attribute name state</strong>[](#before-attribute-name-state)

Consume the <a id="before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Ignore the character&#46;

<strong>U&#43;002F SOLIDUS &#40;&#47;&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

<strong>EOF</strong>

<a id="before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;after&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[after attribute name state](#after-attribute-name-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Start a new attribute in the current tag token&#46; Set that attribute name and value to the empty string&#46; <a id="before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="before&#45;attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[attribute name state](#attribute-name-state)&#46;

##### <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;33 <strong>Attribute name state</strong>[](#attribute-name-state)

Consume the <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003D EQUALS SIGN &#40;&#61;&#41;</strong>

Append the lowercase version of the <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;add 0x0020 to the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the current attribute&#39;s name&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Append a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current attribute&#39;s name&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK &#40;&#34;&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0027 APOSTROPHE &#40;&#39;&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

This is an <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;character&#45;in&#45;attribute&#45;name"></a>[unexpected&#45;character&#45;in&#45;attribute&#45;name](#parse-error-unexpected-character-in-attribute-name) <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Treat it as per the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append the <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the current attribute&#39;s name&#46;

When the user agent leaves the attribute name state &#40;and before emitting the tag token&#44; if appropriate&#41;&#44; the complete attribute&#39;s name must be compared to the other attributes on the same token&#59; if there is already an attribute on the token with the exact same name&#44; then this is a <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;duplicate&#45;attribute"></a>[duplicate&#45;attribute](#parse-error-duplicate-attribute) <a id="attribute&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors) and the new attribute must be removed from the token&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If an attribute is so removed from a token&#44; it&#44; and the value that gets associated with it&#44; if any&#44; are never subsequently used by the parser&#44; and are therefore effectively discarded&#46; Removing the attribute in this way does not change its status as the &#34;current attribute&#34; for the purposes of the tokenizer&#44; however&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append the <a id="attribute&#45;value&#45;&#40;unquoted&#41;&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the current attribute&#39;s value&#46;

##### <a id="after&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;&#40;quoted&#41;&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;39 <strong>After attribute value &#40;quoted&#41; state</strong>[](#after-attribute-value-(quoted)-state)

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="bogus&#45;comment&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

Emit the current comment token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

##### <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;42 <strong>Markup declaration open state</strong>[](#markup-declaration-open-state)

If the next few characters are&#58;

<strong>Two U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS characters &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Consume those two characters&#44; create a comment token whose data is the empty string&#44; and switch to the <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;start&#45;state"></a>[comment start state](#comment-start-state)&#46;

<strong><a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>DOCTYPE</code>&#34;</strong>

Consume those characters and switch to the <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;doctype&#45;state"></a>[DOCTYPE state](#doctype-state)&#46;

<strong>&#34;<code>&#91;CDATA&#91;</code>&#34;</strong>

Consume those characters&#46; If there is an <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) and it is not an element in the <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; then switch to the <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;cdata&#45;section&#45;state"></a>[CDATA section state](#cdata-section-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; this is a <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;cdata&#45;in&#45;html&#45;content"></a>[cdata&#45;in&#45;html&#45;content](#parse-error-cdata-in-html-content) <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Create a comment token whose data is &#34;<code>&#91;CDATA&#91;</code>&#34;&#46; Switch to the <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;bogus&#45;comment&#45;state"></a>[bogus comment state](#bogus-comment-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is an <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;incorrectly&#45;opened&#45;comment"></a>[incorrectly&#45;opened&#45;comment](#parse-error-incorrectly-opened-comment) <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Create a comment token whose data is the empty string&#46; Switch to the <a id="markup&#45;declaration&#45;open&#45;state&#58;bogus&#45;comment&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[bogus comment state](#bogus-comment-state) &#40;don&#39;t consume anything in the current state&#41;&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;43 <strong>Comment start state</strong>[](#comment-start-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>[comment start dash state](#comment-start-dash-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;abrupt&#45;closing&#45;of&#45;empty&#45;comment"></a>[abrupt&#45;closing&#45;of&#45;empty&#45;comment](#parse-error-abrupt-closing-of-empty-comment) <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="comment&#45;start&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;state"></a>[comment state](#comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;44 <strong>Comment start dash state</strong>[](#comment-start-dash-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;end&#45;state"></a>[comment end state](#comment-end-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;abrupt&#45;closing&#45;of&#45;empty&#45;comment"></a>[abrupt&#45;closing&#45;of&#45;empty&#45;comment](#parse-error-abrupt-closing-of-empty-comment) <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;comment"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;comment](#parse-error-eof-in-comment) <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41; to the comment token&#39;s data&#46; <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;start&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;state"></a>[comment state](#comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;45 <a id="comment"></a><strong>Comment state</strong>[](#comment-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Append the <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the comment token&#39;s data&#46; Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>[comment less&#45;than sign state](#comment-less-than-sign-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>[comment end dash state](#comment-end-dash-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Append a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the comment token&#39;s data&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;comment"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;comment](#parse-error-eof-in-comment) <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append the <a id="comment&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the comment token&#39;s data&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;46 <strong>Comment less&#45;than sign state</strong>[](#comment-less-than-sign-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0021 EXCLAMATION MARK &#40;&#33;&#41;</strong>

Append the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the comment token&#39;s data&#46; Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;state"></a>[comment less&#45;than sign bang state](#comment-less-than-sign-bang-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#60;&#41;</strong>

Append the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the comment token&#39;s data&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;state"></a>[comment state](#comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;47 <strong>Comment less&#45;than sign bang state</strong>[](#comment-less-than-sign-bang-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>[comment less&#45;than sign bang dash state](#comment-less-than-sign-bang-dash-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;state"></a>[comment state](#comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;48 <strong>Comment less&#45;than sign bang dash state</strong>[](#comment-less-than-sign-bang-dash-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>[comment less&#45;than sign bang dash dash state](#comment-less-than-sign-bang-dash-dash-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>[comment end dash state](#comment-end-dash-state)&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;49 <strong>Comment less&#45;than sign bang dash dash state</strong>[](#comment-less-than-sign-bang-dash-dash-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

<strong>EOF</strong>

<a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;end&#45;state"></a>[comment end state](#comment-end-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is a <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;nested&#45;comment"></a>[nested&#45;comment](#parse-error-nested-comment) <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;less&#45;than&#45;sign&#45;bang&#45;dash&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;end&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[comment end state](#comment-end-state)&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;50 <strong>Comment end dash state</strong>[](#comment-end-dash-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;end&#45;state"></a>[comment end state](#comment-end-state)&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;comment"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;comment](#parse-error-eof-in-comment) <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41; to the comment token&#39;s data&#46; <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;state"></a>[comment state](#comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;51 <strong>Comment end state</strong>[](#comment-end-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0021 EXCLAMATION MARK &#40;&#33;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state"></a>[comment end bang state](#comment-end-bang-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Append a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41; to the comment token&#39;s data&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;comment"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;comment](#parse-error-eof-in-comment) <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append two U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS characters &#40;&#45;&#41; to the comment token&#39;s data&#46; <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;state"></a>[comment state](#comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;52 <strong>Comment end bang state</strong>[](#comment-end-bang-state)

Consume the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

Append two U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS characters &#40;&#45;&#41; and a U&#43;0021 EXCLAMATION MARK character &#40;&#33;&#41; to the comment token&#39;s data&#46; Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;end&#45;dash&#45;state"></a>[comment end dash state](#comment-end-dash-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;incorrectly&#45;closed&#45;comment"></a>[incorrectly&#45;closed&#45;comment](#parse-error-incorrectly-closed-comment) <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Switch to the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;comment"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;comment](#parse-error-eof-in-comment) <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit the current comment token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append two U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS characters &#40;&#45;&#41; and a U&#43;0021 EXCLAMATION MARK character &#40;&#33;&#41; to the comment token&#39;s data&#46; <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="comment&#45;end&#45;bang&#45;state&#58;comment&#45;state"></a>[comment state](#comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="doctype&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;53 <strong>DOCTYPE state</strong>[](#doctype-state)

Consume the <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Switch to the <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[before DOCTYPE name state](#before-doctype-name-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

<a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[before DOCTYPE name state](#before-doctype-name-state)&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;doctype"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;doctype](#parse-error-eof-in-doctype) <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Create a new DOCTYPE token&#46; Set its <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;force&#45;quirks&#45;flag"></a><em>[force&#45;quirks flag](#force-quirks-flag)</em> to <em>on</em>&#46; Emit the current token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is a <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;missing&#45;whitespace&#45;before&#45;doctype&#45;name"></a>[missing&#45;whitespace&#45;before&#45;doctype&#45;name](#parse-error-missing-whitespace-before-doctype-name) <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="doctype&#45;state&#58;before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[before DOCTYPE name state](#before-doctype-name-state)&#46;

##### <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;54 <strong>Before DOCTYPE name state</strong>[](#before-doctype-name-state)

Consume the <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Ignore the character&#46;

<strong><a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII upper alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-alpha)</strong>

Create a new DOCTYPE token&#46; Set the token&#39;s name to the lowercase version of the <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;add 0x0020 to the character&#39;s code point&#41;&#46; Switch to the <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;doctype&#45;name&#45;state"></a>[DOCTYPE name state](#doctype-name-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Create a new DOCTYPE token&#46; Set the token&#39;s name to a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character&#46; Switch to the <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[DOCTYPE name state](#doctype-name-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

This is a <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;missing&#45;doctype&#45;name"></a>[missing&#45;doctype&#45;name](#parse-error-missing-doctype-name) <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Create a new DOCTYPE token&#46; Set its <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;force&#45;quirks&#45;flag"></a><em>[force&#45;quirks flag](#force-quirks-flag)</em> to <em>on</em>&#46; Switch to the <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;doctype"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;doctype](#parse-error-eof-in-doctype) <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Create a new DOCTYPE token&#46; Set its <a id="before&#45;doctype&#45;name&#45;state&#58;force&#45;quirks&#45;flag&#45;2"></a><em>[force&#45;quirks flag](#force-quirks-flag)</em> to <em>on</em>&#46; Emit the current token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

##### <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;67 <strong>After DOCTYPE system identifier state</strong>[](#after-doctype-system-identifier-state)

Consume the <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Ignore the character&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current DOCTYPE token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;doctype"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;doctype](#parse-error-eof-in-doctype) <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Set the current DOCTYPE token&#39;s <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;force&#45;quirks&#45;flag"></a><em>[force&#45;quirks flag](#force-quirks-flag)</em> to <em>on</em>&#46; Emit the current DOCTYPE token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is an <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;character&#45;after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier"></a>[unexpected&#45;character&#45;after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier](#parse-error-unexpected-character-after-doctype-system-identifier) <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;bogus&#45;doctype&#45;state"></a>[bogus DOCTYPE state](#bogus-doctype-state)&#46; &#40;This does <em>not</em> set the current DOCTYPE token&#39;s <a id="after&#45;doctype&#45;system&#45;identifier&#45;state&#58;force&#45;quirks&#45;flag&#45;2"></a><em>[force&#45;quirks flag](#force-quirks-flag)</em> to <em>on</em>&#46;&#41;

##### <a id="bogus&#45;doctype&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;68 <strong>Bogus DOCTYPE state</strong>[](#bogus-doctype-state)

Consume the <a id="bogus&#45;doctype&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="bogus&#45;doctype&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current DOCTYPE token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

This is an <a id="bogus&#45;doctype&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unexpected&#45;null&#45;character"></a>[unexpected&#45;null&#45;character](#parse-error-unexpected-null-character) <a id="bogus&#45;doctype&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the character&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

Emit the current DOCTYPE token&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Ignore the character&#46;

##### <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;69 <strong>CDATA section state</strong>[](#cdata-section-state)

Consume the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;005D RIGHT SQUARE BRACKET &#40;&#93;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;state&#58;cdata&#45;section&#45;bracket&#45;state"></a>[CDATA section bracket state](#cdata-section-bracket-state)&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;cdata"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;cdata](#parse-error-eof-in-cdata) <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

U&#43;0000 NULL characters are handled in the tree construction stage&#44; as part of the rules for parsing tokens <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;state&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign"></a>[in foreign content](#parsing-main-inforeign)&#44; which is the only place where CDATA sections can appear&#46;

##### <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;bracket&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;70 <strong>CDATA section bracket state</strong>[](#cdata-section-bracket-state)

Consume the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;bracket&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;005D RIGHT SQUARE BRACKET &#40;&#93;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;bracket&#45;state&#58;cdata&#45;section&#45;end&#45;state"></a>[CDATA section end state](#cdata-section-end-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit a U&#43;005D RIGHT SQUARE BRACKET character token&#46; <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;bracket&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;bracket&#45;state&#58;cdata&#45;section&#45;state"></a>[CDATA section state](#cdata-section-state)&#46;

##### <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;end&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;71 <strong>CDATA section end state</strong>[](#cdata-section-end-state)

Consume the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;end&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;005D RIGHT SQUARE BRACKET &#40;&#93;&#41;</strong>

Emit a U&#43;005D RIGHT SQUARE BRACKET character token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;end&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Emit two U&#43;005D RIGHT SQUARE BRACKET character tokens&#46; <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;end&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="cdata&#45;section&#45;end&#45;state&#58;cdata&#45;section&#45;state"></a>[CDATA section state](#cdata-section-state)&#46;

##### <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;72 <strong>Processing instruction open state</strong>[](#processing-instruction-open-state)

Consume the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;letters"></a>[ASCII alpha](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alpha)</strong>

<strong>U&#43;005F LOW LINE &#40;&#95;&#41;</strong>

<a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state"></a>[processing instruction target state](#processing-instruction-target-state)&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;processing&#45;instruction](#parse-error-eof-in-processing-instruction) <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is an <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;invalid&#45;first&#45;character&#45;of&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target"></a>[invalid&#45;first&#45;character&#45;of&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target](#parse-error-invalid-first-character-of-processing-instruction-target) <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;convert&#45;the&#45;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;to&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Convert the temporary buffer to a comment](#convert-the-temporary-buffer-to-a-comment)&#46; <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;open&#45;state&#58;bogus&#45;comment&#45;state"></a>[bogus comment state](#bogus-comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;73 <strong>Processing instruction target state</strong>[](#processing-instruction-target-state)

Consume the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<strong>U&#43;003F QUESTION MARK &#40;&#63;&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Let <var>target</var> be the concatenation of the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;code&#45;point"></a>[code points](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-point) in the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#44; in the order they were added to the buffer&#46;

If <var>target</var> is an <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>xml</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>xml&#45;stylesheet</code>&#34;&#58;

1.  This is a <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;disallowed&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target"></a>[disallowed&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target](#parse-error-disallowed-processing-instruction-target) <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

2.  <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;convert&#45;the&#45;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;to&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Convert the temporary buffer to a comment](#convert-the-temporary-buffer-to-a-comment)&#46;

3.  <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;bogus&#45;comment&#45;state"></a>[bogus comment state](#bogus-comment-state)&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  Create a processing instruction token whose target is <var>target</var> and data is the empty string&#46;

2.  <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;after&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state"></a>[after processing instruction target state](#after-processing-instruction-target-state)&#46;

<strong><a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;alphanumeric&#45;ascii&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII alphanumeric](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alphanumeric)</strong>

<strong>U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS &#40;&#45;&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;005F LOW LINE &#40;&#95;&#41;</strong>

Append the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;processing&#45;instruction](#parse-error-eof-in-processing-instruction) <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is an <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;invalid&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target"></a>[invalid&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target](#parse-error-invalid-processing-instruction-target) <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;convert&#45;the&#45;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;to&#45;a&#45;comment&#45;2"></a>[Convert the temporary buffer to a comment](#convert-the-temporary-buffer-to-a-comment)&#46; <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;3"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;bogus&#45;comment&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[bogus comment state](#bogus-comment-state)&#46;

##### <a id="after&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;74 <strong>After processing instruction target state</strong>[](#after-processing-instruction-target-state)

Consume the <a id="after&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Ignore the character&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="after&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="after&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;target&#45;state&#58;processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state"></a>[processing instruction data state](#processing-instruction-data-state)&#46;

##### <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;75 <strong>Processing instruction data state</strong>[](#processing-instruction-data-state)

Consume the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003F QUESTION MARK &#40;&#63;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state&#58;processing&#45;instruction&#45;questionable&#45;state"></a>[processing instruction questionable state](#processing-instruction-questionable-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current processing instruction token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;processing&#45;instruction](#parse-error-eof-in-processing-instruction) <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the current processing instruction token&#39;s data&#46;

##### <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;questionable&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;76 <strong>Processing instruction questionable state</strong>[](#processing-instruction-questionable-state)

Consume the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;questionable&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;003E GREATER&#45;THAN SIGN &#40;&#62;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;questionable&#45;state&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46; Emit the current processing instruction token&#46;

<strong>EOF</strong>

This is an <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;questionable&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;eof&#45;in&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[eof&#45;in&#45;processing&#45;instruction](#parse-error-eof-in-processing-instruction) <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;questionable&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Emit an end&#45;of&#45;file token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Append U&#43;003F &#40;&#63;&#41; to the current processing instruction token&#39;s data&#46; <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;questionable&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="processing&#45;instruction&#45;questionable&#45;state&#58;processing&#45;instruction&#45;data&#45;state"></a>[processing instruction data state](#processing-instruction-data-state)&#46;

##### <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;77 <strong>Character reference state</strong>[](#character-reference-state)

Set the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> to the empty string&#46; Append a U&#43;0026 AMPERSAND &#40;&#38;&#41; character to the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46; Consume the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;alphanumeric&#45;ascii&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII alphanumeric](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alphanumeric)</strong>

<a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>[named character reference state](#named-character-reference-state)&#46;

<strong>U&#43;0023 NUMBER SIGN &#40;&#35;&#41;</strong>

Append the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;3"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46; Switch to the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>[numeric character reference state](#numeric-character-reference-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;flush&#45;code&#45;points&#45;consumed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[Flush code points consumed as a character reference](#flush-code-points-consumed-as-a-character-reference)&#46; <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var>&#46;

##### <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;78 <strong>Named character reference state</strong>[](#named-character-reference-state)

Consume the maximum number of characters possible&#44; where the consumed characters are one of the identifiers in the first column of the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;named&#45;character&#45;references"></a>[named character references](#named-character-references) table&#46; Append each character to the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> when it&#39;s consumed&#46;

<strong>If there is a match</strong>

If the character reference was <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;charref&#45;in&#45;attribute"></a>[consumed as part of an attribute](#charref-in-attribute)&#44; and the last character matched is not a U&#43;003B SEMICOLON character &#40;&#59;&#41;&#44; and the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character) is either a U&#43;003D EQUALS SIGN character &#40;&#61;&#41; or an <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;alphanumeric&#45;ascii&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII alphanumeric](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alphanumeric)&#44; then&#44; for historical reasons&#44; <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;flush&#45;code&#45;points&#45;consumed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[flush code points consumed as a character reference](#flush-code-points-consumed-as-a-character-reference) and switch to the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var>&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  If the last character matched is not a U&#43;003B SEMICOLON character &#40;&#59;&#41;&#44; then this is a <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;missing&#45;semicolon&#45;after&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[missing&#45;semicolon&#45;after&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-missing-semicolon-after-character-reference) <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

2.  Set the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> to the empty string&#46; Append one or two characters corresponding to the character reference name &#40;as given by the second column of the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;named&#45;character&#45;references&#45;2"></a>[named character references](#named-character-references) table&#41; to the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;3"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46;

3.  <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;flush&#45;code&#45;points&#45;consumed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;2"></a>[Flush code points consumed as a character reference](#flush-code-points-consumed-as-a-character-reference)&#46; Switch to the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state&#45;2"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var>&#46;

<strong>Otherwise</strong>

<a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;flush&#45;code&#45;points&#45;consumed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;3"></a>[Flush code points consumed as a character reference](#flush-code-points-consumed-as-a-character-reference)&#46; Switch to the <a id="named&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state"></a>[ambiguous ampersand state](#ambiguous-ampersand-state)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

If the markup contains &#40;not in an attribute&#41; the string <code>I&#39;m &#38;notit&#59; I tell you</code>&#44; the character reference is parsed as &#34;not&#34;&#44; as in&#44; <code>I&#39;m ¬it&#59; I tell you</code> &#40;and this is a parse error&#41;&#46; But if the markup was <code>I&#39;m &#38;notin&#59; I tell you</code>&#44; the character reference would be parsed as &#34;notin&#59;&#34;&#44; resulting in <code>I&#39;m ∉ I tell you</code> &#40;and no parse error&#41;&#46;

However&#44; if the markup contains the string <code>I&#39;m &#38;notit&#59; I tell you</code> in an attribute&#44; no character reference is parsed and string remains intact &#40;and there is no parse error&#41;&#46;

##### <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;79 <strong>Ambiguous ampersand state</strong>[](#ambiguous-ampersand-state)

Consume the <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;alphanumeric&#45;ascii&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII alphanumeric](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-alphanumeric)</strong>

If the character reference was <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;charref&#45;in&#45;attribute"></a>[consumed as part of an attribute](#charref-in-attribute)&#44; then append the <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the current attribute&#39;s value&#46; Otherwise&#44; emit the <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a character token&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003B SEMICOLON &#40;&#59;&#41;</strong>

This is an <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;unknown&#45;named&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[unknown&#45;named&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-unknown-named-character-reference) <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var>&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="ambiguous&#45;ampersand&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state&#45;2"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var>&#46;

##### <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;80 <strong>Numeric character reference state</strong>[](#numeric-character-reference-state)

Set the <a id="character&#45;reference&#45;code"></a><strong><var>character reference code</var></strong> to zero &#40;0&#41;&#46;

Consume the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong>U&#43;0078 LATIN SMALL LETTER X</strong>

<strong>U&#43;0058 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER X</strong>

Append the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) to the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46; Switch to the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state"></a>[hexadecimal character reference start state](#hexadecimal-character-reference-start-state)&#46;

<a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state"></a><strong><a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII digit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)</strong>

<a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>[decimal character reference state](#decimal-character-reference-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is an <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;absence&#45;of&#45;digits&#45;in&#45;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[absence&#45;of&#45;digits&#45;in&#45;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-absence-of-digits-in-numeric-character-reference) <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;flush&#45;code&#45;points&#45;consumed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[Flush code points consumed as a character reference](#flush-code-points-consumed-as-a-character-reference)&#46; <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var>&#46;

##### <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;81 <strong>Hexadecimal character reference start state</strong>[](#hexadecimal-character-reference-start-state)

Consume the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;hex&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII hex digit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-hex-digit)</strong>

<a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>[hexadecimal character reference state](#hexadecimal-character-reference-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is an <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;absence&#45;of&#45;digits&#45;in&#45;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[absence&#45;of&#45;digits&#45;in&#45;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-absence-of-digits-in-numeric-character-reference) <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;flush&#45;code&#45;points&#45;consumed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[Flush code points consumed as a character reference](#flush-code-points-consumed-as-a-character-reference)&#46; <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;reconsume&#45;2"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;start&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var>&#46;

##### <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;82 <strong>Hexadecimal character reference state</strong>[](#hexadecimal-character-reference-state)

Consume the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;

<strong><a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII digit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)</strong>

Multiply the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> by 16&#46; Add a numeric version of the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;subtract 0x0030 from the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;2"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;hex&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII upper hex digit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-hex-digit)</strong>

Multiply the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;3"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> by 16&#46; Add a numeric version of the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a hexadecimal digit &#40;subtract 0x0037 from the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;4"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;lowercase&#45;ascii&#45;hex&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII lower hex digit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lower-hex-digit)</strong>

Multiply the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;5"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> by 16&#46; Add a numeric version of the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character&#45;3"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) as a hexadecimal digit &#40;subtract 0x0057 from the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;6"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var>&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003B SEMICOLON &#40;&#59;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state"></a>[numeric character reference end state](#numeric-character-reference-end-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is a <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;missing&#45;semicolon&#45;after&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[missing&#45;semicolon&#45;after&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-missing-semicolon-after-character-reference) <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="hexadecimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[numeric character reference end state](#numeric-character-reference-end-state)&#46;

##### <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;83 <strong>Decimal character reference state</strong>[](#decimal-character-reference-state)

Consume the <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#58;
