<strong><a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;ascii&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII digit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit)</strong>

Multiply the <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> by 10&#46; Add a numeric version of the <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;current&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[current input character](#current-input-character) &#40;subtract 0x0030 from the character&#39;s code point&#41; to the <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;2"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var>&#46;

<strong>U&#43;003B SEMICOLON &#40;&#59;&#41;</strong>

Switch to the <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state"></a>[numeric character reference end state](#numeric-character-reference-end-state)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

This is a <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;missing&#45;semicolon&#45;after&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[missing&#45;semicolon&#45;after&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-missing-semicolon-after-character-reference) <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;reconsume"></a>[Reconsume](#reconsume) in the <a id="decimal&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;state&#58;numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[numeric character reference end state](#numeric-character-reference-end-state)&#46;

##### <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state"></a>13&#46;2&#46;5&#46;84 <strong>Numeric character reference end state</strong>[](#numeric-character-reference-end-state)

Check the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var>&#58;

- If the number is 0x00&#44; then this is a <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;null&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[null&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-null-character-reference) <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Set the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;2"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> to 0xFFFD&#46;

- If the number is greater than 0x10FFFF&#44; then this is a <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;outside&#45;unicode&#45;range"></a>[character&#45;reference&#45;outside&#45;unicode&#45;range](#parse-error-character-reference-outside-unicode-range) <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Set the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;3"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> to 0xFFFD&#46;

- If the number is a <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;surrogate"></a>[surrogate](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#surrogate)&#44; then this is a <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;surrogate&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[surrogate&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-surrogate-character-reference) <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Set the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;4"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> to 0xFFFD&#46;

- If the number is a <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;noncharacter"></a>[noncharacter](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#noncharacter)&#44; then this is a <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;noncharacter&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[noncharacter&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-noncharacter-character-reference) <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

- If the number is 0x0D&#44; or a <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;control"></a>[control](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#control) that&#39;s not <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; then this is a <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;error&#45;control&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[control&#45;character&#45;reference](#parse-error-control-character-reference) <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;5"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; If the number is one of the numbers in the first column of the following table&#44; then find the row with that number in the first column&#44; and set the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;5"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> to the number in the second column of that row&#46;

  <table id="table-charref-overrides"><thead><tr><th>Number </th><th colspan="2">Code point       </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>0x80 </td><td>0x20AC </td><td>EURO SIGN &#40;€&#41;              </td></tr><tr><td>0x82 </td><td>0x201A </td><td>SINGLE LOW&#45;9 QUOTATION MARK &#40;‚&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x83 </td><td>0x0192 </td><td>LATIN SMALL LETTER F WITH HOOK &#40;ƒ&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x84 </td><td>0x201E </td><td>DOUBLE LOW&#45;9 QUOTATION MARK &#40;„&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x85 </td><td>0x2026 </td><td>HORIZONTAL ELLIPSIS &#40;…&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x86 </td><td>0x2020 </td><td>DAGGER &#40;†&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x87 </td><td>0x2021 </td><td>DOUBLE DAGGER &#40;‡&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x88 </td><td>0x02C6 </td><td>MODIFIER LETTER CIRCUMFLEX ACCENT &#40;ˆ&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x89 </td><td>0x2030 </td><td>PER MILLE SIGN &#40;‰&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x8A </td><td>0x0160 </td><td>LATIN CAPITAL LETTER S WITH CARON &#40;Š&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x8B </td><td>0x2039 </td><td>SINGLE LEFT&#45;POINTING ANGLE QUOTATION MARK &#40;‹&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x8C </td><td>0x0152 </td><td>LATIN CAPITAL LIGATURE OE &#40;Œ&#41;              </td></tr><tr><td>0x8E </td><td>0x017D </td><td>LATIN CAPITAL LETTER Z WITH CARON &#40;Ž&#41;                     </td></tr><tr><td>0x91 </td><td>0x2018 </td><td>LEFT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK &#40;‘&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x92 </td><td>0x2019 </td><td>RIGHT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK &#40;’&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x93 </td><td>0x201C </td><td>LEFT DOUBLE QUOTATION MARK &#40;“&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x94 </td><td>0x201D </td><td>RIGHT DOUBLE QUOTATION MARK &#40;”&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x95 </td><td>0x2022 </td><td>BULLET &#40;•&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x96 </td><td>0x2013 </td><td>EN DASH &#40;–&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x97 </td><td>0x2014 </td><td>EM DASH &#40;—&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x98 </td><td>0x02DC </td><td>SMALL TILDE &#40;˜&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x99 </td><td>0x2122 </td><td>TRADE MARK SIGN &#40;™&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x9A </td><td>0x0161 </td><td>LATIN SMALL LETTER S WITH CARON &#40;š&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x9B </td><td>0x203A </td><td>SINGLE RIGHT&#45;POINTING ANGLE QUOTATION MARK &#40;›&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x9C </td><td>0x0153 </td><td>LATIN SMALL LIGATURE OE &#40;œ&#41;              </td></tr><tr><td>0x9E </td><td>0x017E </td><td>LATIN SMALL LETTER Z WITH CARON &#40;ž&#41;       </td></tr><tr><td>0x9F </td><td>0x0178 </td><td>LATIN CAPITAL LETTER Y WITH DIAERESIS &#40;Ÿ&#41;     </td></tr></tbody></table>

Set the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var> to the empty string&#46; Append a code point equal to the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;character&#45;reference&#45;code&#45;6"></a><var>[character reference code](#character-reference-code)</var> to the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;temporary&#45;buffer&#45;2"></a><var>[temporary buffer](#temporary-buffer)</var>&#46; <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;flush&#45;code&#45;points&#45;consumed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;character&#45;reference"></a>[Flush code points consumed as a character reference](#flush-code-points-consumed-as-a-character-reference)&#46; Switch to the <a id="numeric&#45;character&#45;reference&#45;end&#45;state&#58;return&#45;state"></a><var>[return state](#return-state)</var>&#46;

#### <a id="tree&#45;construction"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6 <strong>Tree construction</strong>[](#tree-construction)

The input to the tree construction stage is a sequence of tokens from the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;tokenization"></a>[tokenization](#tokenization) stage&#46; The tree construction stage is associated with a DOM <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object when a parser is created&#46; The &#34;output&#34; of this stage consists of dynamically modifying or extending that document&#39;s DOM tree&#46;

This specification does not define when an interactive user agent has to render the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> so that it is available to the user&#44; or when it has to begin accepting user input&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

As each token is emitted from the tokenizer&#44; the user agent must follow the appropriate steps from the following list&#44; known as the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#45;dispatcher"></a><strong>tree construction dispatcher</strong>&#58;

<strong>If the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is empty</strong>

<strong>If the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is an element in the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)</strong>

<strong>If the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is a <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;text&#45;integration&#45;point"></a>[MathML text integration point](#mathml-text-integration-point) and the token is a start tag whose tag name is neither &#34;mglyph&#34; nor &#34;malignmark&#34;</strong>

<strong>If the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is a <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;text&#45;integration&#45;point&#45;2"></a>[MathML text integration point](#mathml-text-integration-point) and the token is a character token</strong>

<strong>If the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is a <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;annotation&#45;xml"></a>[MathML <code>annotation&#45;xml</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#dfn-annotation-xml) element and the token is a start tag whose tag name is &#34;svg&#34;</strong>

<strong>If the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;5"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is an <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;html&#45;integration&#45;point"></a>[HTML integration point](#html-integration-point) and the token is a start tag</strong>

<strong>If the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;6"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is an <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;html&#45;integration&#45;point&#45;2"></a>[HTML integration point](#html-integration-point) and the token is a character token</strong>

<strong>If the token is an end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

Process the token according to the rules given in the section corresponding to the current <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) in HTML content&#46;

<strong>Otherwise</strong>

Process the token according to the rules given in the section for parsing tokens <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign"></a>[in foreign content](#parsing-main-inforeign)&#46;

The <a id="next&#45;token"></a><strong>next token</strong> is the token that is about to be processed by the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;tree&#45;construction&#45;dispatcher"></a>[tree construction dispatcher](#tree-construction-dispatcher) &#40;even if the token is subsequently just ignored&#41;&#46;

A node is a <a id="mathml&#45;text&#45;integration&#45;point"></a><strong>MathML text integration point</strong> if it is one of the following elements&#58;

- A <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;mi"></a>[MathML <code>mi</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#the-mi-element) element
- A <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;mo"></a>[MathML <code>mo</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#operator-fence-separator-or-accent-mo) element
- A <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;mn"></a>[MathML <code>mn</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#number-mn) element
- A <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;ms"></a>[MathML <code>ms</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#string-literal-ms) element
- A <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;mtext"></a>[MathML <code>mtext</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#text-mtext) element

A node is an <a id="html&#45;integration&#45;point"></a><strong>HTML integration point</strong> if it is one of the following elements&#58;

- A <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;annotation&#45;xml&#45;2"></a>[MathML <code>annotation&#45;xml</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#dfn-annotation-xml) element whose start tag token had an attribute with the name &#34;encoding&#34; whose value was an <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>text&#47;html</code>&#34;
- A <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;mathml&#45;annotation&#45;xml&#45;3"></a>[MathML <code>annotation&#45;xml</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#dfn-annotation-xml) element whose start tag token had an attribute with the name &#34;encoding&#34; whose value was an <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>application&#47;xhtml&#43;xml</code>&#34;
- An <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;svg&#45;foreignobject"></a>[SVG <code>foreignObject</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/embedded.html#elementdef-foreignObject) element
- An <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;svg&#45;desc"></a>[SVG <code>desc</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-desc) element
- An <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;svg&#45;title"></a>[SVG <code>title</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-title) element

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the node in question is the parser&#39;s <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element)&#44; then the start tag token for that element is the &#34;fake&#34; token created by the <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;html&#45;fragment&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[HTML fragment parsing algorithm](#html-fragment-parsing-algorithm)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Not all of the tag names mentioned below are conformant tag names in this specification&#59; many are included to handle legacy content&#46; They still form part of the algorithm that implementations are required to implement to claim conformance&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The algorithm described below places no limit on the depth of the DOM tree generated&#44; or on the length of tag names&#44; attribute names&#44; attribute values&#44; <a id="tree&#45;construction&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes&#44; etc&#46; While implementers are encouraged to [avoid arbitrary limits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#algorithm-limits)&#44; it is recognized that practical concerns will likely force user agents to impose nesting depth constraints&#46;

##### <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;1 Creating and inserting nodes[](#creating-and-inserting-nodes)

An <a id="insertion&#45;location"></a><strong>insertion location</strong> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;tuple"></a>[tuple](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#tuple) consisting of a <a id="insertion&#45;location&#45;target&#45;parent"></a><strong>target parent</strong> &#40;a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;node"></a><code>[Node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node)</code>&#41; and a <a id="insertion&#45;location&#45;reference&#45;child"></a><strong>reference child</strong> &#40;a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;node&#45;2"></a><code>[Node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node)</code> or null&#41;&#46;

While the parser is processing a token&#44; it can enable or disable <a id="foster&#45;parent"></a><strong>foster parenting</strong>&#46; This affects the following algorithm&#46;

To find the <a id="appropriate&#45;place&#45;for&#45;inserting&#45;a&#45;node"></a><strong>appropriate place for inserting a node</strong>&#44; given an optional <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;node&#45;3"></a><code>[Node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node)</code> <var>overrideTarget</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#44; perform the following steps&#46; They return an <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;location"></a>[insertion location](#insertion-location)&#46;

1.  Let <var>targetParent</var> be <var>overrideTarget</var> if it is not null&#59; otherwise the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#46;

2.  Let <var>referenceChild</var> be null&#46;

3.  If <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;foster&#45;parent"></a>[foster parenting](#foster-parent) is enabled and <var>targetParent</var> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>&#44; <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code>&#44; <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#58;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Foster parenting happens when content is misnested in tables&#46;

    1.  Let <var>lastTemplateOrTable</var> be the last <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> or <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element in the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) if there is one&#59; otherwise null&#46;

    2.  If <var>lastTemplateOrTable</var> is null&#44; then return &#40;the first element in the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) &#40;the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#41;&#44; null&#41;&#46; &#40;<a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

    3.  If <var>lastTemplateOrTable</var> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#44; then set <var>targetParent</var> to <var>lastTemplateOrTable</var>&#46;

    4.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>lastTemplateOrTable</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;parent"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is not null&#44; then set <var>targetParent</var> to <var>lastTemplateOrTable</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;parent&#45;2"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) and set <var>referenceChild</var> to <var>lastTemplateOrTable</var>&#46;

    5.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>targetParent</var> to the element immediately above <var>lastTemplateOrTable</var> in the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    These steps are involved in part because it&#39;s possible for elements&#44; the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element in this case in particular&#44; to have been moved by a script around in the DOM&#44; or indeed removed from the DOM entirely&#44; after the element was inserted by the parser&#46;

4.  If <var>targetParent</var> is not a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#44; then return &#40;<var>targetParent</var>&#44; <var>referenceChild</var>&#41;&#46;

5.  Let <var>patchInsertionTarget</var> be <var>targetParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;target"></a>[insertion target](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-target)&#46;

6.  If <var>patchInsertionTarget</var> is null&#44; then return &#40;<var>targetParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;template&#45;contents"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents)&#44; null&#41;&#46;

7.  If <var>targetParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;end&#45;marker"></a>[insertion end marker](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-end-marker) is not null and its <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;parent&#45;3"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is <var>patchInsertionTarget</var>&#44; then return &#40;<var>patchInsertionTarget</var>&#44; <var>targetParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;end&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[insertion end marker](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-end-marker)&#41;&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    If the end marker has been removed or moved to another node&#44; nodes are instead appended to <var>patchInsertionTarget</var> in the following step&#46;

8.  Return &#40;<var>patchInsertionTarget</var>&#44; null&#41;&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

To <a id="create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;for&#45;the&#45;token"></a><strong>create an element for a token</strong>&#44; given a token <var>token</var>&#44; a string <var>namespace</var>&#44; a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;node&#45;4"></a><code>[Node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node)</code> object <var>intendedParent</var>&#44; and an optional string&#45;or&#45;null <var>prefix</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#58;

1.  If the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) is not null&#44; then return the result of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;create&#45;a&#45;speculative&#45;mock&#45;element"></a>[creating a speculative mock element](#create-a-speculative-mock-element) given <var>namespace</var>&#44; <var>token</var>&#39;s tag name&#44; and <var>token</var>&#39;s attributes&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; optionally <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;create&#45;a&#45;speculative&#45;mock&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[create a speculative mock element](#create-a-speculative-mock-element) given <var>namespace</var>&#44; <var>token</var>&#39;s tag name&#44; and <var>token</var>&#39;s attributes&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The result is not used&#46; This step allows for a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;speculative&#45;fetch"></a>[speculative fetch](#speculative-fetch) to be initiated from non&#45;speculative parsing&#46; The fetch is still speculative at this point&#44; because&#44; for example&#44; by the time the element is inserted&#44; <var>intendedParent</var> might have been removed from the document&#46;

3.  Let <var>document</var> be <var>intendedParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

4.  Let <var>localName</var> be <var>token</var>&#39;s tag name&#46;

5.  Let <var>is</var> be the value of the &#34;<a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;attr&#45;is"></a><code>[is](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-is)</code>&#34; attribute in <var>token</var>&#44; if such an attribute exists&#59; otherwise null&#46;

6.  Let <var>registry</var> be the result of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;look&#45;up&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[looking up a custom element registry](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#look-up-a-custom-element-registry) given <var>intendedParent</var>&#46;

7.  Let <var>definition</var> be the result of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;look&#45;up&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;definition"></a>[looking up a custom element definition](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#look-up-a-custom-element-definition) given <var>registry</var>&#44; <var>namespace</var>&#44; <var>localName</var>&#44; and <var>is</var>&#46;

8.  Let <var>willExecuteScript</var> be true if <var>definition</var> is non&#45;null and the parser&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is null&#59; otherwise false&#46;

9.  If <var>willExecuteScript</var> is true&#58;

    1.  Increment <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;throw&#45;on&#45;dynamic&#45;markup&#45;insertion&#45;counter"></a>[throw&#45;on&#45;dynamic&#45;markup&#45;insertion counter](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter)&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;javascript&#45;execution&#45;context&#45;stack"></a>[JavaScript execution context stack](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack) is empty&#44; then <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;perform&#45;a&#45;microtask&#45;checkpoint"></a>[perform a microtask checkpoint](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#perform-a-microtask-checkpoint)&#46;

    3.  Push a new <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;element&#45;queue"></a>[element queue](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#element-queue) onto <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;relevant&#45;agent"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack"></a>[custom element reactions stack](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-reactions-stack)&#46;

10. Let <var>element</var> be the result of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given <var>document</var>&#44; <var>localName</var>&#44; <var>namespace</var>&#44; <var>prefix</var>&#44; <var>is</var>&#44; <var>willExecuteScript</var>&#44; and <var>registry</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This will cause <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor"></a>[custom element constructors](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-constructor) to run&#44; if <var>willExecuteScript</var> is true&#46; However&#44; since we incremented the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;throw&#45;on&#45;dynamic&#45;markup&#45;insertion&#45;counter&#45;2"></a>[throw&#45;on&#45;dynamic&#45;markup&#45;insertion counter](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter)&#44; this cannot cause <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write"></a>[new characters to be inserted into the tokenizer](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)&#44; or <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;open"></a>[the document to be blown away](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-open)&#46;

11. <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-append) each attribute in the given token to <var>element</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This can <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;enqueue&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;callback&#45;reaction"></a>[enqueue a custom element callback reaction](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) for the <code>attributeChangedCallback</code>&#44; which might run immediately &#40;in the next step&#41;&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Even though the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;attr&#45;is&#45;2"></a><code>[is](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-is)</code> attribute governs the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[creation](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) of a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;customized&#45;built&#45;in&#45;element"></a>[customized built&#45;in element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#customized-built-in-element)&#44; it is not present during the execution of the relevant <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor&#45;2"></a>[custom element constructor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-constructor)&#59; it is appended in this step&#44; along with all other attributes&#46;

12. If <var>willExecuteScript</var> is true&#58;

    1.  Let <var>queue</var> be the result of popping from <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;relevant&#45;agent&#45;2"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack&#45;2"></a>[custom element reactions stack](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-reactions-stack)&#46; &#40;This will be the same <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;element&#45;queue&#45;2"></a>[element queue](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#element-queue) as was pushed above&#46;&#41;

    2.  <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;invoke&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions"></a>[Invoke custom element reactions](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#invoke-custom-element-reactions) in <var>queue</var>&#46;

    3.  Decrement <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;throw&#45;on&#45;dynamic&#45;markup&#45;insertion&#45;counter&#45;3"></a>[throw&#45;on&#45;dynamic&#45;markup&#45;insertion counter](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter)&#46;

13. If <var>element</var> has an <code>xmlns</code> attribute <em>in the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;xmlns&#45;namespace"></a>[XMLNS namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace)</em> whose value is not exactly the same as the element&#39;s namespace&#44; that is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Similarly&#44; if <var>element</var> has an <code>xmlns&#58;xlink</code> attribute in the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;xmlns&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[XMLNS namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace) whose value is not the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;xlink&#45;namespace"></a>[XLink Namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace)&#44; that is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

14. If <var>element</var> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;category&#45;reset"></a>[resettable element](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#category-reset) and not a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; then invoke its <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset&#45;control"></a>[reset algorithm](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-form-reset-control)&#46; &#40;This initializes the element&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-value) and <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked"></a>[checkedness](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-fe-checked) based on the element&#39;s attributes&#46;&#41;

15. If <var>element</var> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated element](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-associated-element) and not a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) is not null&#44; the parser is not <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;parsing&#45;template&#45;contents"></a>[parsing template contents](#parsing-template-contents)&#44; the parser&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is null&#44; <var>element</var> is either not <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;category&#45;listed"></a>[listed](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#category-listed) or doesn&#39;t have a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fae-form)</code> attribute&#44; and the <var>intendedParent</var> is in the same <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree) as the element pointed to by the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;2"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer)&#44; then <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;association"></a>[associate](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#concept-form-association) <var>element</var> with the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element pointed to by the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;3"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) and set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;parser&#45;inserted&#45;flag"></a>[parser inserted flag](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#parser-inserted-flag)&#46;

16. Return <var>element</var>&#46;

To compute the <a id="adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location"></a><strong>adjusted insertion location</strong> with an optional <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;location&#45;2"></a>[insertion location](#insertion-location) <var>insertionLocation</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#58;

1.  Let <var>overrideTarget</var> be null if <var>insertionLocation</var> is null&#59; otherwise <var>insertionLocation</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;location&#45;target&#45;parent"></a>[target parent](#insertion-location-target-parent)&#46;

2.  Let <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var> be the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;appropriate&#45;place&#45;for&#45;inserting&#45;a&#45;node"></a>[appropriate place for inserting a node](#appropriate-place-for-inserting-a-node) given <var>overrideTarget</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;location&#45;target&#45;parent&#45;2"></a>[target parent](#insertion-location-target-parent) is the first element in the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and the parser&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;root&#45;insertion&#45;target"></a>[root insertion target](#root-insertion-target) is non&#45;null&#44; then set <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var> to &#40;the parser&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;root&#45;insertion&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[root insertion target](#root-insertion-target)&#44; null&#41;&#46;

4.  Return <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

To <a id="insert&#45;an&#45;element&#45;at&#45;the&#45;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location"></a><strong>insert an element at the adjusted insertion location</strong> with an element <var>element</var> and an optional <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;location&#45;3"></a>[insertion location](#insertion-location) <var>insertionLocation</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#58;

1.  Let &#40;<var>targetParent</var>&#44; <var>referenceChild</var>&#41; be the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location"></a>[adjusted insertion location](#adjusted-insertion-location) given <var>insertionLocation</var>&#46;

2.  If any of the following are true&#58;

    - <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;parent&#45;4"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is non&#45;null&#59;
    - <var>element</var> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;host&#45;including&#45;inclusive&#45;ancestor"></a>[host&#45;including inclusive ancestor](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-host-including-inclusive-ancestor) of <var>targetParent</var>&#59; or
    - <var>targetParent</var> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node that already has an element child&#44;

    then return&#46;

3.  <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;ensure&#45;pre&#45;insert&#45;validity"></a>[ensure pre&#45;insert validity](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-ensure-pre-insertion-validity) given <var>element</var>&#44; <var>targetParent</var>&#44; <var>referenceChild</var>&#44; and « » does not throw&#46;

4.  If the parser&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is null&#44; then push a new <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;element&#45;queue&#45;3"></a>[element queue](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#element-queue) onto <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;relevant&#45;agent&#45;3"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack&#45;3"></a>[custom element reactions stack](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-reactions-stack)&#46;

5.  <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert"></a>[Insert](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert) <var>element</var> into <var>targetParent</var> before <var>referenceChild</var>&#46;

6.  If the parser&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is null&#44; then pop the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;element&#45;queue&#45;4"></a>[element queue](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#element-queue) from <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;relevant&#45;agent&#45;4"></a>[relevant agent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-agent)&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;stack&#45;4"></a>[custom element reactions stack](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-reactions-stack)&#44; and <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;invoke&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;reactions&#45;2"></a>[invoke custom element reactions](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#invoke-custom-element-reactions) in that queue&#46;

To <a id="insert&#45;a&#45;foreign&#45;element"></a><strong>insert a foreign element</strong>&#44; given a token <var>token</var>&#44; a string <var>namespace</var>&#44; and a boolean <var>onlyAddToElementStack</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var> be the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;appropriate&#45;place&#45;for&#45;inserting&#45;a&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[appropriate place for inserting a node](#appropriate-place-for-inserting-a-node)&#46;

2.  Let <var>element</var> be the result of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;for&#45;the&#45;token"></a>[creating an element for the token](#create-an-element-for-the-token) given <var>token</var>&#44; <var>namespace</var>&#44; and <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;location&#45;target&#45;parent&#45;3"></a>[target parent](#insertion-location-target-parent)&#46;

3.  If <var>onlyAddToElementStack</var> is false&#44; then run <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;element&#45;at&#45;the&#45;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location"></a>[insert an element at the adjusted insertion location](#insert-an-element-at-the-adjusted-insertion-location) with <var>element</var>&#46;

4.  Push <var>element</var> onto the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) so that it is the new <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#46;

5.  Return <var>element</var>&#46;

To <a id="insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a><strong>insert an HTML element</strong> given a token <var>token</var>&#58; <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;foreign&#45;element"></a>[insert a foreign element](#insert-a-foreign-element) given <var>token</var>&#44; the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; and false&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace" data-x-internal="xmlns-namespace">XMLNS namespace</a>     </td></tr><tr><td> <code>xmlns&#58;xlink</code> </td><td> <code>xmlns</code> </td><td> <code>xlink</code> </td><td> <a id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:xmlns-namespace-4" href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace" data-x-internal="xmlns-namespace">XMLNS namespace</a>   </td></tr></tbody></table>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When the steps below require the user agent to <a id="insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a><strong>insert a character</strong> while processing a token&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>data</var> be the characters passed to the algorithm&#44; or&#44; if no characters were explicitly specified&#44; the character of the character token being processed&#46;

2.  Let &#40;<var>targetParent</var>&#44; <var>referenceChild</var>&#41; be the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location&#45;2"></a>[adjusted insertion location](#adjusted-insertion-location)&#46;

3.  If <var>targetParent</var> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The DOM will not let <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> nodes have <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node children&#44; so they are dropped on the floor&#46;

4.  Let <var>previousSibling</var> be <var>referenceChild</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;previous&#45;sibling"></a>[previous sibling](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-previous-sibling) if <var>referenceChild</var> is non&#45;null&#59; otherwise <var>targetParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;last&#45;child"></a>[last child](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-last-child)&#46;

5.  If <var>previousSibling</var> is a <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node&#44; then append <var>data</var> to <var>previousSibling</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data)&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; let <var>text</var> be the result of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;create&#45;a&#45;text&#45;node"></a>[creating a text node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-text-node) given <var>targetParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) and <var>data</var>&#44; and <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert&#45;2"></a>[insert](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert) <var>text</var> into <var>targetParent</var> before <var>referenceChild</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here are some sample inputs to the parser and the corresponding number of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> nodes that they result in&#44; assuming a user agent that executes scripts&#46;

<table><thead><tr><th>Input </th><th>Number of <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-4"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> nodes     </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>A&lt;script&gt;&#10;var script &#61; document&#46;getElementsByTagName&#40;&#39;script&#39;&#41;&#91;0&#93;&#59;&#10;document&#46;body&#46;removeChild&#40;script&#41;&#59;&#10;&lt;&#47;script&gt;B</code>       </td><td>One <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-5"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> node in the document&#44; containing &#34;AB&#34;&#46;      </td></tr><tr><td><code>A&lt;script&gt;&#10;var text &#61; document&#46;createTextNode&#40;&#39;B&#39;&#41;&#59;&#10;document&#46;body&#46;appendChild&#40;text&#41;&#59;&#10;&lt;&#47;script&gt;C</code>       </td><td>Three <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-6"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> nodes&#59; &#34;A&#34; before the script&#44; the script&#39;s contents&#44; and &#34;BC&#34; after the script &#40;the parser appends to the <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-7"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> node created by the script&#41;&#46;      </td></tr><tr><td><code>A&lt;script&gt;&#10;var text &#61; document&#46;getElementsByTagName&#40;&#39;script&#39;&#41;&#91;0&#93;&#46;firstChild&#59;&#10;text&#46;data &#61; &#39;B&#39;&#59;&#10;document&#46;body&#46;appendChild&#40;text&#41;&#59;&#10;&lt;&#47;script&gt;C</code>       </td><td>Two adjacent <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-8"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> nodes in the document&#44; containing &#34;A&#34; and &#34;BC&#34;&#46;      </td></tr><tr><td><code>A&lt;table&gt;B&lt;tr&gt;C&lt;&#47;tr&gt;D&lt;&#47;table&gt;</code>       </td><td>One <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-9"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> node before the table&#44; containing &#34;ABCD&#34;&#46; &#40;This is caused by <a href="#foster-parent" id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:foster-parent-2">foster parenting</a>&#46;&#41;      </td></tr><tr><td><code>A&lt;table&gt;&lt;tr&gt; B&lt;&#47;tr&gt; C&lt;&#47;table&gt;</code>       </td><td>One <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-10"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> node before the table&#44; containing &#34;A B C&#34; &#40;A&#45;space&#45;B&#45;space&#45;C&#41;&#46; &#40;This is caused by <a href="#foster-parent" id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:foster-parent-3">foster parenting</a>&#46;&#41;      </td></tr><tr><td><code>A&lt;table&gt;&lt;tr&gt; B&lt;&#47;tr&gt; &lt;&#47;em&gt;C&lt;&#47;table&gt;</code>       </td><td>One <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-11"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> node before the table&#44; containing &#34;A BC&#34; &#40;A&#45;space&#45;B&#45;C&#41;&#44; and one <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:text-12"><a data-x-internal="text" href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text">Text</a></code> node inside the table &#40;as a child of a <code id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:the-tbody-element-2"><a href="html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element">tbody</a></code>&#41; with a single space character&#46; &#40;Space characters separated from non&#45;space characters by non&#45;character tokens are not affected by <a href="#foster-parent" id="creating-and-inserting-nodes:foster-parent-4">foster parenting</a>&#44; even if those other tokens then get ignored&#46;&#41;    </td></tr></tbody></table>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When the steps below require the user agent to <a id="insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a><strong>insert a comment</strong> while processing a comment token&#44; with an optional <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;location&#45;4"></a>[insertion location](#insertion-location) <var>insertionLocation</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>data</var> be the data given in the comment token being processed&#46;

2.  Let &#40;<var>targetParent</var>&#44; <var>referenceChild</var>&#41; be the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location&#45;3"></a>[adjusted insertion location](#adjusted-insertion-location) given <var>insertionLocation</var>&#46;

3.  Let <var>comment</var> be the result of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;create&#45;a&#45;comment&#45;node"></a>[creating a comment node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-comment-node) given <var>targetParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) and <var>data</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert&#45;3"></a>[Insert](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert) <var>comment</var> into <var>targetParent</var> before <var>referenceChild</var>&#46;

When the steps below require the user agent to <a id="insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a><strong>insert a processing instruction</strong> while processing a processing instruction token&#44; with an optional <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;insertion&#45;location&#45;5"></a>[insertion location](#insertion-location) <var>insertionLocation</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>piTarget</var> be the target given in the processing instruction token being processed&#46;

2.  Let <var>data</var> be the data given in the processing instruction token being processed&#46;

3.  Let &#40;<var>targetParent</var>&#44; <var>referenceChild</var>&#41; be the <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location&#45;4"></a>[adjusted insertion location](#adjusted-insertion-location) given <var>insertionLocation</var>&#46;

4.  Let <var>pi</var> be the result of <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;create&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction&#45;node"></a>[creating a processing instruction node](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-processing-instruction-node) given <var>targetParent</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; <var>piTarget</var>&#44; and <var>data</var>&#46;

5.  <a id="creating&#45;and&#45;inserting&#45;nodes&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert&#45;4"></a>[Insert](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert) <var>pi</var> into <var>targetParent</var> before <var>referenceChild</var>&#46;

##### <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;2 Parsing elements that contain only text[](#parsing-elements-that-contain-only-text)

The <a id="generic&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>generic raw text element parsing algorithm</strong> and the <a id="generic&#45;rcdata&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>generic RCDATA element parsing algorithm</strong> consist of the following steps&#46; These algorithms are always invoked in response to a start tag token&#46;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

2.  If the algorithm that was invoked is the <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;generic&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm)&#44; switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;rawtext&#45;state"></a>[RAWTEXT state](#rawtext-state)&#59; otherwise the algorithm invoked was the <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;generic&#45;rcdata&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[generic RCDATA element parsing algorithm](#generic-rcdata-element-parsing-algorithm)&#44; switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;rcdata&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA state](#rcdata-state)&#46;

3.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode) to the current <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

4.  Then&#44; switch the <a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;contain&#45;only&#45;text&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata"></a>[text](#parsing-main-incdata)&#34;&#46;

##### <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;3 Closing elements that have implied end tags[](#closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags)

When the steps below require the UA to <a id="generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags"></a><strong>generate implied end tags</strong>&#44; then&#44; while the <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) is a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;rb"></a><code>[rb](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rb)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element&#44; or an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;rtc"></a><code>[rtc](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rtc)</code> element&#44; the UA must pop the <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

If a step requires the UA to generate implied end tags but lists an element to exclude from the process&#44; then the UA must perform the above steps as if that element was not in the above list&#46;

When the steps below require the UA to <a id="generate&#45;all&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;thoroughly"></a><strong>generate all implied end tags thoroughly</strong>&#44; then&#44; while the <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) is a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;rb&#45;2"></a><code>[rb](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rb)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;rtc&#45;2"></a><code>[rtc](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rtc)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code> element&#44; or a <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; the UA must pop the <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="closing&#45;elements&#45;that&#45;have&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

##### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhtml"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4 The rules for parsing tokens in HTML content[](#parsing-main-inhtml)

###### <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;1 The &#34;<strong>initial</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#the-initial-insertion-mode)

A <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object has an associated <a id="parser&#45;cannot&#45;change&#45;the&#45;mode&#45;flag"></a><strong>parser cannot change the mode flag</strong> &#40;a boolean&#41;&#46; It is initially false&#46;

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[initial](#the-initial-insertion-mode)&#34; <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment) given &#40;the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction) given &#40;the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

If the DOCTYPE token&#39;s name is not &#34;<code>html</code>&#34;&#44; or the token&#39;s public identifier is not missing&#44; or the token&#39;s system identifier is neither missing nor &#34;<a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;about&#58;legacy&#45;compat"></a><code>[about&#58;legacy&#45;compat](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#about:legacy-compat)</code>&#34;&#44; then there is a <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

Let <var>doctype</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;create&#45;a&#45;doctype"></a>[creating a doctype](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-doctype) given the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node&#44; the name given in the DOCTYPE token &#40;or the empty string if the name was missing&#41;&#44; the public identifier given in the DOCTYPE token &#40;or the empty string if the public identifier was missing&#41;&#44; and the system identifier given in the DOCTYPE token &#40;or the empty string if the system identifier was missing&#41;&#46; Then&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node has neither a <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;documenttype"></a><code>[DocumentType](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documenttype)</code> child nor an element child&#44; append <var>doctype</var> to the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This also ensures that the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;documenttype&#45;2"></a><code>[DocumentType](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documenttype)</code> node is returned as the value of the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;doctype"></a><code>[doctype](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-doctype)</code> attribute of the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#46;

<a id="quirks&#45;mode&#45;doctypes"></a>Then&#44; if the document is <em>not</em> <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document"></a>[an <code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> document](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#an-iframe-srcdoc-document)&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parser&#45;cannot&#45;change&#45;the&#45;mode&#45;flag"></a>[parser cannot change the mode flag](#parser-cannot-change-the-mode-flag) is false&#44; and the DOCTYPE token matches one of the conditions in the following list&#44; then set the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> to <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;quirks&#45;mode"></a>[quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-quirks)&#58;

- The <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;force&#45;quirks&#45;flag"></a><em>[force&#45;quirks flag](#force-quirks-flag)</em> is set to <em>on</em>&#46;
- The name is not &#34;<code>html</code>&#34;&#46;
- The public identifier is set to&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3O&#47;&#47;DTD W3 HTML Strict 3&#46;0&#47;&#47;EN&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier is set to&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;W3C&#47;DTD HTML 4&#46;0 Transitional&#47;EN</code>&#34;
- The public identifier is set to&#58; &#34;<code>HTML</code>&#34;
- The system identifier is set to&#58; &#34;<code>http&#58;&#47;&#47;www&#46;ibm&#46;com&#47;data&#47;dtd&#47;v11&#47;ibmxhtml1&#45;transitional&#46;dtd</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#43;&#47;&#47;Silmaril&#47;&#47;dtd html Pro v0r11 19970101&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;AS&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;0 asWedit &#43; extensions&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;AdvaSoft Ltd&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;0 asWedit &#43; extensions&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0 Level 1&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0 Level 2&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0 Strict Level 1&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0 Strict Level 2&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0 Strict&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;1E&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;2 Final&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;2&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Level 0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Level 1&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Level 2&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Level 3&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Strict Level 0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Strict Level 1&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Strict Level 2&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Strict Level 3&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Strict&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;IETF&#47;&#47;DTD HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Metrius&#47;&#47;DTD Metrius Presentational&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Microsoft&#47;&#47;DTD Internet Explorer 2&#46;0 HTML Strict&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Microsoft&#47;&#47;DTD Internet Explorer 2&#46;0 HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Microsoft&#47;&#47;DTD Internet Explorer 2&#46;0 Tables&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Microsoft&#47;&#47;DTD Internet Explorer 3&#46;0 HTML Strict&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Microsoft&#47;&#47;DTD Internet Explorer 3&#46;0 HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Microsoft&#47;&#47;DTD Internet Explorer 3&#46;0 Tables&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Netscape Comm&#46; Corp&#46;&#47;&#47;DTD HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Netscape Comm&#46; Corp&#46;&#47;&#47;DTD Strict HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;O&#39;Reilly and Associates&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;O&#39;Reilly and Associates&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Extended 1&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;O&#39;Reilly and Associates&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Extended Relaxed 1&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;SQ&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0 HoTMetaL &#43; extensions&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
