- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;SoftQuad Software&#47;&#47;DTD HoTMetaL PRO 6&#46;0&#58;&#58;19990601&#58;&#58;extensions to HTML 4&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;SoftQuad&#47;&#47;DTD HoTMetaL PRO 4&#46;0&#58;&#58;19971010&#58;&#58;extensions to HTML 4&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Spyglass&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 2&#46;0 Extended&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Sun Microsystems Corp&#46;&#47;&#47;DTD HotJava HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;Sun Microsystems Corp&#46;&#47;&#47;DTD HotJava Strict HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3 1995&#45;03&#45;24&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;2 Draft&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;2 Final&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;2&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 3&#46;2S Draft&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 4&#46;0 Frameset&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 4&#46;0 Transitional&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Experimental 19960712&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML Experimental 970421&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD W3 HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3O&#47;&#47;DTD W3 HTML 3&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;WebTechs&#47;&#47;DTD Mozilla HTML 2&#46;0&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;WebTechs&#47;&#47;DTD Mozilla HTML&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The system identifier is missing or the empty string&#44; and the public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 4&#46;01 Frameset&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The system identifier is missing or the empty string&#44; and the public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 4&#46;01 Transitional&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;

Otherwise&#44; if the document is <em>not</em> <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[an <code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> document](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#an-iframe-srcdoc-document)&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parser&#45;cannot&#45;change&#45;the&#45;mode&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[parser cannot change the mode flag](#parser-cannot-change-the-mode-flag) is false&#44; and the DOCTYPE token matches one of the conditions in the following list&#44; then set the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> to <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;limited&#45;quirks&#45;mode"></a>[limited&#45;quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-limited-quirks)&#58;

- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD XHTML 1&#46;0 Frameset&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD XHTML 1&#46;0 Transitional&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The system identifier is neither missing nor the empty string&#44; and the public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 4&#46;01 Frameset&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;
- The system identifier is neither missing nor the empty string&#44; and the public identifier starts with&#58; &#34;<code>&#45;&#47;&#47;W3C&#47;&#47;DTD HTML 4&#46;01 Transitional&#47;&#47;</code>&#34;

The system identifier and public identifier strings must be compared to the values given in the lists above in an <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) manner&#46; A system identifier whose value is the empty string is not considered missing for the purposes of the conditions above&#46;

Then&#44; switch the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[before html](#the-before-html-insertion-mode)&#34;&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

If the document is <em>not</em> <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[an <code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> document](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#an-iframe-srcdoc-document)&#44; then this is a <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; if the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parser&#45;cannot&#45;change&#45;the&#45;mode&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[parser cannot change the mode flag](#parser-cannot-change-the-mode-flag) is false&#44; set the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> to <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;quirks&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-quirks)&#46;

In any case&#44; switch the <a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;initial&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[before html](#the-before-html-insertion-mode)&#34;&#44; then reprocess the token&#46;

###### <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;2 The &#34;<strong>before html</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#the-before-html-insertion-mode)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[before html](#the-before-html-insertion-mode)&#34; <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment) given &#40;the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction) given &#40;the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;for&#45;the&#45;token"></a>[Create an element for the token](#create-an-element-for-the-token) in the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> as the intended parent&#46; <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;element&#45;at&#45;the&#45;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location"></a>[Insert an element at the adjusted insertion location](#insert-an-element-at-the-adjusted-insertion-location) with that element and &#40;the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#44; null&#41;&#46; Put this element in the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Switch the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[before head](#the-before-head-insertion-mode)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;head&#34;&#44; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;&#44; &#34;br&#34;</strong>

Act as described in the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Create an <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#46; Append it to the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#46; Put this element in the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Switch the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[before head](#the-before-head-insertion-mode)&#34;&#44; then reprocess the token&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;element"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) can end up being removed from the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;html&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; e&#46;g&#46; by scripts&#59; nothing in particular happens in such cases&#44; content continues being appended to the nodes as described in the next section&#46;

###### <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;3 The &#34;<strong>before head</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#the-before-head-insertion-mode)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[before head](#the-before-head-insertion-mode)&#34; <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;head&#34;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

Set the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;head&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>head</code> element pointer](#head-element-pointer) to the newly created <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#46;

Switch the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;head&#34;&#44; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;&#44; &#34;br&#34;</strong>

Act as described in the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for a &#34;head&#34; start tag token with no attributes&#46;

Set the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;head&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;2"></a>[<code>head</code> element pointer](#head-element-pointer) to the newly created <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#46;

Switch the <a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;before&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#45;2"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the current token&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;4 The &#34;<strong>in head</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-inhead)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[Insert the character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;base&#34;&#44; &#34;basefont&#34;&#44; &#34;bgsound&#34;&#44; &#34;link&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; Immediately pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;meta&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; Immediately pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) is null&#58;

1.  <a id="meta&#45;charset&#45;during&#45;parse"></a>If the element has a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;charset"></a><code>[charset](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-charset)</code> attribute&#44; and <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;getting&#45;an&#45;encoding"></a>[getting an encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get) from its value results in an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;encoding"></a>[encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding)&#44; and the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;encoding&#45;confidence"></a>[confidence](#concept-encoding-confidence) is currently <em>tentative</em>&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;change&#45;the&#45;encoding"></a>[change the encoding](#change-the-encoding) to the resulting encoding&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; if the element has an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;http&#45;equiv"></a><code>[http&#45;equiv](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-http-equiv)</code> attribute whose value is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>Content&#45;Type</code>&#34;&#44; and the element has a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;content"></a><code>[content](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-content)</code> attribute&#44; and applying the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;extracting&#45;a&#45;character&#45;encoding&#45;from&#45;a&#45;meta&#45;element"></a>[algorithm for extracting a character encoding from a <code>meta</code> element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#algorithm-for-extracting-a-character-encoding-from-a-meta-element) to that attribute&#39;s value returns an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;encoding&#45;2"></a>[encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding)&#44; and the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;encoding&#45;confidence&#45;2"></a>[confidence](#concept-encoding-confidence) is currently <em>tentative</em>&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;change&#45;the&#45;encoding&#45;2"></a>[change the encoding](#change-the-encoding) to the extracted encoding&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[speculative HTML parser](#speculative-html-parser) doesn&#39;t speculatively apply character encoding declarations in order to reduce implementation complexity&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;title&#34;</strong>

Follow the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;generic&#45;rcdata&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[generic RCDATA element parsing algorithm](#generic-rcdata-element-parsing-algorithm)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;noscript&#34;&#44; if <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled"></a>[Disabled](#scripting-mode-disabled)</strong>

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;noframes&#34;&#44; &#34;style&#34;</strong>

Follow the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;generic&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;noscript&#34;&#44; if <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) is <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[Disabled](#scripting-mode-disabled)</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript"></a>[in head noscript](#parsing-main-inheadnoscript)&#34;&#46;

<a id="scriptTag"></a><strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;script&#34;</strong>

Run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var> be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;appropriate&#45;place&#45;for&#45;inserting&#45;a&#45;node"></a>[appropriate place for inserting a node](#appropriate-place-for-inserting-a-node)&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;for&#45;the&#45;token"></a>[Create an element for the token](#create-an-element-for-the-token) in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; with the intended parent being the node in which the <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var> finds itself&#46;

3.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;fragment"></a>[Fragment](#scripting-mode-fragment)&#44; then set the element&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parser&#45;document"></a>[parser document](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#parser-document) to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;fragment&#45;2"></a>[Fragment](#scripting-mode-fragment) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) treats <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parser&#45;inserted"></a>[parser&#45;inserted](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#parser-inserted) scripts as if they were not parser&#45;inserted&#44; allowing&#44; for example&#44; executing scripts when applying a fragment created by <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;dom&#45;range&#45;createcontextualfragment"></a><code>[createContextualFragment&#40;&#41;](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-range-createcontextualfragment)</code>&#46;

4.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;script&#45;force&#45;async"></a>[force async](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#script-force-async) to false&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This ensures that&#44; if the script is external&#44; any <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write"></a><code>[document&#46;write&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)</code> calls in the script will execute in&#45;line&#44; instead of blowing the document away&#44; as would happen in most other cases&#46; It also prevents the script from executing until the end tag is seen&#46;

5.  If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) is <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;inert"></a>[Inert](#scripting-mode-inert)&#44; then set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;already&#45;started"></a>[already started](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#already-started) to true&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

6.  <a id="document&#45;written&#45;scripts&#45;intervention"></a>

    If the parser was invoked via the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write&#45;2"></a><code>[document&#46;write&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)</code> or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;writeln"></a><code>[document&#46;writeln&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-writeln)</code> methods&#44; then optionally set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;already&#45;started&#45;2"></a>[already started](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#already-started) to true&#46; &#40;For example&#44; the user agent might use this clause to prevent execution of <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;origin"></a>[cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin) scripts inserted via <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write&#45;3"></a><code>[document&#46;write&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)</code> under slow network conditions&#44; or when the page has already taken a long time to load&#46;&#41;

7.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;element&#45;at&#45;the&#45;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location"></a>[Insert an element at the adjusted insertion location](#insert-an-element-at-the-adjusted-insertion-location) with the newly created element and <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var>&#46;

8.  Push the element onto the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) so that it is the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#46;

9.  Switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;script&#45;data&#45;state"></a>[script data state](#script-data-state)&#46;

10. Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode) to the current <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

11. Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata"></a>[text](#parsing-main-incdata)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;head&#34;</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;which will be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#41; off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after head](#the-after-head-insertion-mode)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;&#44; &#34;br&#34;</strong>

Act as described in the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;template&#34;</strong>

Run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>templateStartTag</var> be the start tag&#46;

2.  Insert a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) at the end of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

3.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

4.  Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;7"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate"></a>[in template](#parsing-main-intemplate)&#34;&#46;

5.  Push &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#45;2"></a>[in template](#parsing-main-intemplate)&#34; onto the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode)&#46;

6.  Let <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var> be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;appropriate&#45;place&#45;for&#45;inserting&#45;a&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[appropriate place for inserting a node](#appropriate-place-for-inserting-a-node)&#46;

7.  If <var>templateStartTag</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootmode"></a><code>[shadowrootmode](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootmode)</code> is not in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;shadowrootmode&#45;none&#45;state"></a>[None](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-shadowrootmode-none-state) state&#58;

    1.  If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;allow&#45;declarative&#45;shadow&#45;roots"></a>[allow declarative shadow roots](#allow-declarative-shadow-roots) is false&#44; or the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is the topmost element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token and return&#46;

    2.  Let <var>declarativeShadowHostElement</var> be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node)&#46;

    3.  Let <var>template</var> be the result of <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;foreign&#45;element"></a>[insert a foreign element](#insert-a-foreign-element) for <var>templateStartTag</var>&#44; with <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace) and true&#46;

    4.  Let <var>mode</var> be <var>templateStartTag</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootmode&#45;2"></a><code>[shadowrootmode](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootmode)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#46;

    5.  Let <var>delegatesFocus</var> be true if <var>templateStartTag</var> has a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootdelegatesfocus"></a><code>[shadowrootdelegatesfocus](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootdelegatesfocus)</code> attribute&#59; otherwise false&#46;

    6.  Let <var>serializable</var> be true if <var>templateStartTag</var> has a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootserializable"></a><code>[shadowrootserializable](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootserializable)</code> attribute&#59; otherwise false&#46;

    7.  Let <var>slotAssignment</var> be &#34;<code>named</code>&#34;&#46;

    8.  If <var>templateStartTag</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootslotassignment"></a><code>[shadowrootslotassignment](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootslotassignment)</code> attribute is in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;shadowrootslotassignment&#45;manual&#45;state"></a>[Manual](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-shadowrootslotassignment-manual-state) state&#44; then set <var>slotAssignment</var> to &#34;<code>manual</code>&#34;&#46;

    9.  Let <var>clonable</var> be true if <var>templateStartTag</var> has a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootclonable"></a><code>[shadowrootclonable](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootclonable)</code> attribute&#59; otherwise false&#46;

    10. If <var>declarativeShadowHostElement</var> is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;shadow&#45;host"></a>[shadow host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-shadow-host)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;element&#45;at&#45;the&#45;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location&#45;2"></a>[insert an element at the adjusted insertion location](#insert-an-element-at-the-adjusted-insertion-location) with <var>template</var> and <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var>&#46;

    11. Otherwise&#58;

        1.  Let <var>registry</var> be null if <var>templateStartTag</var> has a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootcustomelementregistry"></a><code>[shadowrootcustomelementregistry](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootcustomelementregistry)</code> attribute&#59; otherwise <var>declarativeShadowHostElement</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;element&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-custom-element-registry)&#46;

        2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;attach&#45;a&#45;shadow&#45;root"></a>[Attach a shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attach-a-shadow-root) with <var>declarativeShadowHostElement</var>&#44; <var>mode</var>&#44; <var>delegatesFocus</var>&#44; <var>serializable</var>&#44; <var>slotAssignment</var>&#44; <var>clonable</var>&#44; and <var>registry</var>&#46;

            If an exception is thrown&#44; then catch it and&#58;

            1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;element&#45;at&#45;the&#45;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location&#45;3"></a>[Insert an element at the adjusted insertion location](#insert-an-element-at-the-adjusted-insertion-location) with <var>template</var> and <var>adjustedInsertionLocation</var>&#46;

            2.  The user agent may report an error to the developer console&#46;

            3.  Return&#46;

        3.  Let <var>shadow</var> be <var>declarativeShadowHostElement</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;shadow&#45;root"></a>[shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-shadow-root)&#46;

        4.  Set <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;available&#45;to&#45;element&#45;internals"></a>[available to element internals](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-available-to-element-internals) to true&#46;

        5.  Set <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;shadow&#45;root&#45;declarative"></a>[declarative](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-declarative) to true&#46;

        6.  Set <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;template&#45;contents"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents) to <var>shadow</var>&#46;

        7.  If <var>templateStartTag</var> has a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootcustomelementregistry&#45;2"></a><code>[shadowrootcustomelementregistry](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootcustomelementregistry)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;keep&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;null"></a>[keep custom element registry null](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-keep-custom-element-registry-null) to true&#46;

8.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>templateStartTag</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;for"></a><code>[for](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-for)</code> attribute is specified&#58;

    1.  Let <var>scope</var> be the node that contains the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location"></a>[adjusted insertion location](#adjusted-insertion-location)&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        In the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;2"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#44; <var>scope</var> can be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;documentfragment"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> into which nodes are being inserted&#46;

    2.  If <var>scope</var> is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#44; then set <var>scope</var> to <var>scope</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;2"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents)&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        This is to support patching inside plain <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> elements or those using <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;shadowrootmode&#45;3"></a><code>[shadowrootmode](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-shadowrootmode)</code>&#46; Nested patching is not supported&#44; since in this case the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;3"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents) will have no children and <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;prepare&#45;content&#45;patching"></a>[prepare content patching](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#prepare-content-patching) will fail&#46;

    3.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>scope</var> is <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[the body element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-body-element-2) of its <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; then set <var>scope</var> to its <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parent"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent)&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        This is to support patching <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> with a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> inside <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>&#46;

    4.  Let <var>template</var> be the result of <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;foreign&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[insert a foreign element](#insert-a-foreign-element) for <var>templateStartTag</var>&#44; with <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace) and true&#46;

    5.  Let <var>success</var> be the result of <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;prepare&#45;content&#45;patching&#45;2"></a>[prepare content patching](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#prepare-content-patching) given <var>scope</var> and <var>template</var>&#46;

    6.  If <var>success</var> is false&#58;

        1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>template</var> is the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node&#45;5"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#46;

        2.  Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node&#45;6"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

        3.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;element&#45;at&#45;the&#45;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location&#45;4"></a>[Insert an element at the adjusted insertion location](#insert-an-element-at-the-adjusted-insertion-location) with <var>template</var>&#46;

        4.  Push <var>template</var> onto the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;7"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

            <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

            The above steps undo the effect of the <em>onlyAddToElementStack</em> argument from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;foreign&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[insert a foreign element](#insert-a-foreign-element) call that created <var>template</var>&#44; inserting it where it would have been inserted otherwise&#46; This is to signal an error&#46;

9.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for <var>templateStartTag</var>&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;template&#34;</strong>

If there is no <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;generate&#45;all&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;thoroughly"></a>[Generate all implied end tags thoroughly](#generate-all-implied-end-tags-thoroughly)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node&#45;7"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Let <var>template</var> be the last <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;9"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This is the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element that will be popped from the stack below&#46; It is not necessarily the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node&#45;8"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#44; as the content of a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element with a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;attr&#45;template&#45;for&#45;2"></a><code>[for](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-template-for)</code> attribute might have left an element open&#46;

4.  If <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;target"></a>[insertion target](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-target) is not null&#58;

    1.  Let <var>start</var> be <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;start&#45;marker"></a>[insertion start marker](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-start-marker)&#46;

    2.  Let <var>end</var> be <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;end&#45;marker"></a>[insertion end marker](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-end-marker)&#46;

    3.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>start</var> is not null&#46;

    4.  If <var>start</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parent&#45;2"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is not null&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) <var>start</var>&#46;

    5.  If <var>end</var> is not null and <var>end</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parent&#45;3"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is not null&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove&#45;2"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) <var>end</var>&#46;

    6.  Set <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;target&#45;2"></a>[insertion target](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-target) to null&#46;

    7.  Set <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;start&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[insertion start marker](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-start-marker) to null&#46;

    8.  Set <var>template</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;end&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[insertion end marker](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#insertion-end-marker) to null&#46;

5.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;10"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

6.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;up&#45;to&#45;the&#45;last&#45;marker"></a>[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker)&#46;

7.  Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;2"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes)&#46;

8.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;appropriately"></a>[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;head&#34;</strong>

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;current&#45;node&#45;9"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;which will be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#41; off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;11"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;8"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#58;the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[after head](#the-after-head-insertion-mode)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the token&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;5 The &#34;<strong>in head noscript</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-inheadnoscript)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript"></a>[in head noscript](#parsing-main-inheadnoscript)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;noscript&#34;</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;which will be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code> element&#41; from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#59; the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) will be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;basefont&#34;&#44; &#34;bgsound&#34;&#44; &#34;link&#34;&#44; &#34;meta&#34;&#44; &#34;noframes&#34;&#44; &#34;style&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#45;2"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;br&#34;</strong>

Act as described in the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;head&#34;&#44; &#34;noscript&#34;</strong>

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;which will be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code> element&#41; from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#59; the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) will be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code> element&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inheadnoscript&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#45;3"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the token&#46;

###### <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;6 The &#34;<strong>after head</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#the-after-head-insertion-mode)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after head](#the-after-head-insertion-mode)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[Insert the character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;body&#34;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

Set the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

Switch the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;2"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;frameset&#34;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

Switch the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset"></a>[in frameset](#parsing-main-inframeset)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;base&#34;&#44; &#34;basefont&#34;&#44; &#34;bgsound&#34;&#44; &#34;link&#34;&#44; &#34;meta&#34;&#44; &#34;noframes&#34;&#44; &#34;script&#34;&#44; &#34;style&#34;&#44; &#34;template&#34;&#44; &#34;title&#34;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

Push the node pointed to by the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;head&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>head</code> element pointer](#head-element-pointer) onto the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Process the token <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

Remove the node pointed to by the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;head&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;2"></a>[<code>head</code> element pointer](#head-element-pointer) from the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; &#40;It might not be the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) at this point&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;head&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;3"></a>[<code>head</code> element pointer](#head-element-pointer) cannot be null at this point&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;template&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;3"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead&#45;2"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;&#44; &#34;br&#34;</strong>

Act as described in the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;head&#34;</strong>

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for a &#34;body&#34; start tag token with no attributes&#46;

Set the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;ok&#34;&#46;

Switch the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;7"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;head&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;3"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the current token&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;7 The &#34;<strong>in body</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-inbody)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[Insert the token&#39;s character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>Any other character token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[Insert the token&#39;s character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

If there is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; then ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; for each attribute on the token&#44; check to see if the attribute is already present on the top element of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; If it is not&#44; add the attribute and its corresponding value to that element&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;base&#34;&#44; &#34;basefont&#34;&#44; &#34;bgsound&#34;&#44; &#34;link&#34;&#44; &#34;meta&#34;&#44; &#34;noframes&#34;&#44; &#34;script&#34;&#44; &#34;style&#34;&#44; &#34;template&#34;&#44; &#34;title&#34;</strong>

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;template&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;body&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has only one node on it&#44; or if the second element on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; then ignore the token&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case) or there is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element on the stack&#41;

Otherwise&#44; set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#59; then&#44; for each attribute on the token&#44; check to see if the attribute is already present on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element &#40;the second element&#41; on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; and if it is not&#44; add the attribute and its corresponding value to that element&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;frameset&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;5"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;7"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has only one node on it&#44; or if the second element on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#44; then ignore the token&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;2"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case) or there is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element on the stack&#41;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) is set to &#34;not ok&#34;&#44; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  Remove the second element on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;9"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) from its parent node&#44; if it has one&#46;

2.  Pop all the nodes from the bottom of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;10"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) up to&#44; but not including&#44; the root <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#46;

3.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

4.  Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset"></a>[in frameset](#parsing-main-inframeset)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes) is not empty&#44; then process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate"></a>[in template](#parsing-main-intemplate)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

Otherwise&#44; follow these steps&#58;

1.  If there is a node in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;11"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rb"></a><code>[rb](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rb)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rtc"></a><code>[rtc](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rtc)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#44; or the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;6"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[Stop parsing](#stop-parsing)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;body&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;12"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope"></a>[have a <code>body</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;7"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; if there is a node in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;13"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44;
