a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rb&#45;2"></a><code>[rb](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rb)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rtc&#45;2"></a><code>[rtc](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rtc)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#44; or the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;8"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody"></a>[after body](#parsing-main-afterbody)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;14"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[have a <code>body</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;9"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; if there is a node in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;15"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rb&#45;3"></a><code>[rb](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rb)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;rp&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[rp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rp-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;rt&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[rt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-rt-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rtc&#45;3"></a><code>[rtc](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rtc)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code> element&#44; a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#44; or the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;10"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#45;2"></a>[after body](#parsing-main-afterbody)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;address&#34;&#44; &#34;article&#34;&#44; &#34;aside&#34;&#44; &#34;blockquote&#34;&#44; &#34;center&#34;&#44; &#34;details&#34;&#44; &#34;dialog&#34;&#44; &#34;dir&#34;&#44; &#34;div&#34;&#44; &#34;dl&#34;&#44; &#34;fieldset&#34;&#44; &#34;figcaption&#34;&#44; &#34;figure&#34;&#44; &#34;footer&#34;&#44; &#34;header&#34;&#44; &#34;hgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;main&#34;&#44; &#34;menu&#34;&#44; &#34;nav&#34;&#44; &#34;ol&#34;&#44; &#34;p&#34;&#44; &#34;search&#34;&#44; &#34;section&#34;&#44; &#34;summary&#34;&#44; &#34;ul&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;16"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;h1&#34;&#44; &#34;h2&#34;&#44; &#34;h3&#34;&#44; &#34;h4&#34;&#44; &#34;h5&#34;&#44; &#34;h6&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;17"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) whose tag name is one of &#34;h1&#34;&#44; &#34;h2&#34;&#44; &#34;h3&#34;&#44; &#34;h4&#34;&#44; &#34;h5&#34;&#44; or &#34;h6&#34;&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;11"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;18"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;pre&#34;&#44; &#34;listing&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;19"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;3"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;next&#45;token"></a>[next token](#next-token) is a U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; character token&#44; then ignore that token and move on to the next one&#46; &#40;Newlines at the start of <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;pre&#45;element"></a><code>[pre](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-pre-element)</code> blocks are ignored as an authoring convenience&#46;&#41;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;4"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;form&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) is not null&#44; and the parser is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;template&#45;contents"></a>[parsing template contents](#parsing-template-contents)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;12"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;20"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;4"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#44; and&#44; if the parser is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;template&#45;contents&#45;2"></a>[parsing template contents](#parsing-template-contents)&#44; set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;2"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) to point to the element created&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;li&#34;</strong>

Run these steps&#58;

1.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;5"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

2.  Initialize <var>node</var> to be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;the bottommost node of the stack&#41;&#46;

3.  <em>Loop</em>&#58; If <var>node</var> is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#44; then run these substeps&#58;

    1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#44; except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> elements&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;5"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;13"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

    3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;21"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

    4.  Jump to the step labeled <em>done</em> below&#46;

4.  If <var>node</var> is in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;special"></a>[special](#special) category&#44; but is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;address&#45;element"></a><code>[address](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-address-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>done</em> below&#46;

5.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>node</var> to the previous entry in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;22"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and return to the step labeled <em>loop</em>&#46;

6.  <em>Done</em>&#58; If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;23"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;5"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

7.  Finally&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;dd&#34;&#44; &#34;dt&#34;</strong>

Run these steps&#58;

1.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;6"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

2.  Initialize <var>node</var> to be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;6"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;the bottommost node of the stack&#41;&#46;

3.  <em>Loop</em>&#58; If <var>node</var> is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#44; then run these substeps&#58;

    1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;2"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#44; except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> elements&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;7"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;14"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

    3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;24"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dd&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[dd](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dd-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

    4.  Jump to the step labeled <em>done</em> below&#46;

4.  If <var>node</var> is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#44; then run these substeps&#58;

    1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;3"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#44; except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> elements&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;8"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;15"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

    3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;25"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;dt&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[dt](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-dt-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

    4.  Jump to the step labeled <em>done</em> below&#46;

5.  If <var>node</var> is in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;special&#45;2"></a>[special](#special) category&#44; but is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;address&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[address](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-address-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>done</em> below&#46;

6.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>node</var> to the previous entry in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;26"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and return to the step labeled <em>loop</em>&#46;

7.  <em>Done</em>&#58; If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;27"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;6"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

8.  Finally&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;plaintext&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;28"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;7"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

Switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;plaintext&#45;state"></a>[PLAINTEXT state](#plaintext-state)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Once a start tag with the tag name &#34;plaintext&#34; has been seen&#44; all remaining tokens will be character tokens &#40;and a final end&#45;of&#45;file token&#41; because there is no way to switch the tokenizer out of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;plaintext&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[PLAINTEXT state](#plaintext-state)&#46; However&#44; as the tree builder remains in its existing insertion mode&#44; it might <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements) while processing those character tokens&#46; This means that the parser can insert other elements into the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;plaintext"></a><code>[plaintext](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#plaintext)</code> element&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;button&#34;</strong>

1.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;29"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;3"></a>[has a <code>button</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then run these substeps&#58;

    1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;16"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

    2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;4"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

    3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;30"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element"></a><code>[button](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-button-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

3.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

4.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;7"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;address&#34;&#44; &#34;article&#34;&#44; &#34;aside&#34;&#44; &#34;blockquote&#34;&#44; &#34;button&#34;&#44; &#34;center&#34;&#44; &#34;details&#34;&#44; &#34;dialog&#34;&#44; &#34;dir&#34;&#44; &#34;div&#34;&#44; &#34;dl&#34;&#44; &#34;fieldset&#34;&#44; &#34;figcaption&#34;&#44; &#34;figure&#34;&#44; &#34;footer&#34;&#44; &#34;header&#34;&#44; &#34;hgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;listing&#34;&#44; &#34;main&#34;&#44; &#34;menu&#34;&#44; &#34;nav&#34;&#44; &#34;ol&#34;&#44; &#34;pre&#34;&#44; &#34;search&#34;&#44; &#34;section&#34;&#44; &#34;select&#34;&#44; &#34;summary&#34;&#44; &#34;ul&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;31"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;4"></a>[have an element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope) that is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;17"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;5"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;9"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;18"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;32"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;form&#34;</strong>

If the parser is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;template&#45;contents&#45;3"></a>[parsing template contents](#parsing-template-contents)&#58;

1.  Let <var>node</var> be the element that the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;3"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) is set to&#44; or null if it is not set to an element&#46;

2.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;4"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) to null&#46;

3.  If <var>node</var> is null or if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;33"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;5"></a>[have <var>node</var> in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;19"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; return and ignore the token&#46;

4.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;6"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

5.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;10"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not <var>node</var>&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;20"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

6.  Remove <var>node</var> from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;34"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;35"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;6"></a>[have a <code>form</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;21"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; return and ignore the token&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;7"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

3.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;11"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;22"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

4.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;36"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;p&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;37"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;8"></a>[have a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;23"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for a &#34;p&#34; start tag token with no attributes&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[Close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;li&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;38"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;list&#45;item&#45;scope"></a>[have an <code>li</code> element in list item scope](#has-an-element-in-list-item-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;24"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;8"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#44; except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> elements&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;12"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;25"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;39"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;li&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[li](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-li-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;dd&#34;&#44; &#34;dt&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;40"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;7"></a>[have an element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope) that is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;26"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;9"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#44; except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[HTML elements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;13"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;7"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;27"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;41"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;h1&#34;&#44; &#34;h2&#34;&#44; &#34;h3&#34;&#44; &#34;h4&#34;&#44; &#34;h5&#34;&#44; &#34;h6&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;42"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;8"></a>[have an element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope) that is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;9"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) and whose tag name is one of &#34;h1&#34;&#44; &#34;h2&#34;&#44; &#34;h3&#34;&#44; &#34;h4&#34;&#44; &#34;h5&#34;&#44; or &#34;h6&#34;&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;28"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;10"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;14"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;10"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;29"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;43"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;11"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) whose tag name is one of &#34;h1&#34;&#44; &#34;h2&#34;&#44; &#34;h3&#34;&#44; &#34;h4&#34;&#44; &#34;h5&#34;&#44; or &#34;h6&#34; has been popped from the stack&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;sarcasm&#34;</strong>

Take a deep breath&#44; then act as described in the &#34;any other end tag&#34; entry below&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;a&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) contains an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element between the end of the list and the last <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) on the list &#40;or the start of the list if there is no <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) on the list&#41;&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;30"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; run the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adoption&#45;agency&#45;algorithm"></a>[adoption agency algorithm](#adoption-agency-algorithm) for the token&#44; then remove that element from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) and the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;44"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adoption&#45;agency&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[adoption agency algorithm](#adoption-agency-algorithm) didn&#39;t already remove it &#40;it might not have if the element is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope"></a>[in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#41;&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the non&#45;conforming stream <code>&#60;a href&#61;&#34;a&#34;&#62;a&#60;table&#62;&#60;a href&#61;&#34;b&#34;&#62;b&#60;&#47;table&#62;x</code>&#44; the first <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element would be closed upon seeing the second one&#44; and the &#34;x&#34; character would be inside a link to &#34;b&#34;&#44; not to &#34;a&#34;&#46; This is despite the fact that the outer <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element is not in table scope &#40;meaning that a regular <code>&#60;&#47;a&#62;</code> end tag at the start of the table wouldn&#39;t close the outer <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element&#41;&#46; The result is that the two <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> elements are indirectly nested inside each other — non&#45;conforming markup will often result in non&#45;conforming DOMs when parsed&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;push&#45;onto&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[Push onto the list of active formatting elements](#push-onto-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) that element&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;b&#34;&#44; &#34;big&#34;&#44; &#34;code&#34;&#44; &#34;em&#34;&#44; &#34;font&#34;&#44; &#34;i&#34;&#44; &#34;s&#34;&#44; &#34;small&#34;&#44; &#34;strike&#34;&#44; &#34;strong&#34;&#44; &#34;tt&#34;&#44; &#34;u&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;push&#45;onto&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[Push onto the list of active formatting elements](#push-onto-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) that element&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;nobr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;7"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;45"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;9"></a>[has a <code>nobr</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;31"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; run the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adoption&#45;agency&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[adoption agency algorithm](#adoption-agency-algorithm) for the token&#44; then once again <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;13"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;push&#45;onto&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[Push onto the list of active formatting elements](#push-onto-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) that element&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;a&#34;&#44; &#34;b&#34;&#44; &#34;big&#34;&#44; &#34;code&#34;&#44; &#34;em&#34;&#44; &#34;font&#34;&#44; &#34;i&#34;&#44; &#34;nobr&#34;&#44; &#34;s&#34;&#44; &#34;small&#34;&#44; &#34;strike&#34;&#44; &#34;strong&#34;&#44; &#34;tt&#34;&#44; &#34;u&#34;</strong>

Run the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adoption&#45;agency&#45;algorithm&#45;4"></a>[adoption agency algorithm](#adoption-agency-algorithm) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;applet&#34;&#44; &#34;marquee&#34;&#44; &#34;object&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;9"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;14"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

Insert a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;3"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) at the end of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;8"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag token whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;applet&#34;&#44; &#34;marquee&#34;&#44; &#34;object&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;46"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;10"></a>[have an element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope) that is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;12"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;32"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;11"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;15"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;13"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;33"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;47"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;14"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack&#46;

4.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;up&#45;to&#45;the&#45;last&#45;marker"></a>[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;table&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> is <em>not</em> set to <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;quirks&#45;mode"></a>[quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-quirks)&#44; and the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;48"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;9"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;15"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;9"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;7"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;br&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;34"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Drop the attributes from the token&#44; and act as described in the next entry&#59; i&#46;e&#46; act as if this was a &#34;br&#34; start tag token with no attributes&#44; rather than the end tag token that it actually is&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;area&#34;&#44; &#34;br&#34;&#44; &#34;embed&#34;&#44; &#34;img&#34;&#44; &#34;keygen&#34;&#44; &#34;wbr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;10"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;16"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; Immediately pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;16"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;49"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;10"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;input&#34;</strong>

If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;3"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;35"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

2.  Ignore the token&#46;

3.  Return&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;50"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;11"></a>[has a <code>select</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;36"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

2.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;51"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;11"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;17"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; Immediately pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;17"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;52"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

If the token does not have an attribute with the name &#34;type&#34;&#44; or if it does&#44; but that attribute&#39;s value is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>hidden</code>&#34;&#44; then set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;11"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;param&#34;&#44; &#34;source&#34;&#44; &#34;track&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;18"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; Immediately pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;18"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;53"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;hr&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;54"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;10"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;55"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;12"></a>[has a <code>select</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;12"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;56"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;13"></a>[has an <code>option</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope) or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;14"></a>[has an <code>optgroup</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;37"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;19"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; Immediately pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;19"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;57"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;4"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;12"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;image&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;38"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Change the token&#39;s tag name to &#34;img&#34; and reprocess it&#46; &#40;Don&#39;t ask&#46;&#41;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;textarea&#34;</strong>

Run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;20"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;next&#45;token&#45;2"></a>[next token](#next-token) is a U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; character token&#44; then ignore that token and move on to the next one&#46; &#40;Newlines at the start of <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code> elements are ignored as an authoring convenience&#46;&#41;

3.  Switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rcdata&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA state](#rcdata-state)&#46;

4.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode) to the current <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;8"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

5.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;13"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

6.  Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;9"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata"></a>[text](#parsing-main-incdata)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;xmp&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;58"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;button&#45;scope&#45;11"></a>[has a <code>p</code> element in button scope](#has-an-element-in-button-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[close a <code>p</code> element](#close-a-p-element)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;12"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;14"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

Follow the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generic&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a>[generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;iframe&#34;</strong>

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;15"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

Follow the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generic&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;noembed&#34;</strong>

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;noscript&#34;&#44; if <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;scripting&#45;mode"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled"></a>[Disabled](#scripting-mode-disabled)</strong>

Follow the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generic&#45;raw&#45;text&#45;element&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#generic-raw-text-element-parsing-algorithm)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;select&#34;</strong>

If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;4"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;39"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

2.  Ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;59"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;15"></a>[has a <code>select</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;40"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

2.  Ignore the token&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;60"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[select](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-select-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;13"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;21"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

3.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag&#45;16"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;option&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;61"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;16"></a>[has a <code>select</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;13"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags) except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[optgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-optgroup-element)</code> elements&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;62"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;17"></a>[has an <code>option</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;41"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;20"></a>[current node](#current-node) is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; then pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;21"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;63"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;14"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;22"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;optgroup&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;64"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;18"></a>[has a <code>select</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;14"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;65"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;19"></a>[has an <code>option</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope) or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;20"></a>[has an <code>optgroup</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;42"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;22"></a>[current node](#current-node) is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[option](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; then pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;23"></a>[current node](#current-node) from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;66"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;15"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;23"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;rb&#34;&#44; &#34;rtc&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;67"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;21"></a>[has a <code>ruby</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;15"></a>[generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46; If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;24"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not now a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;ruby&#45;element"></a><code>[ruby](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ruby-element)</code> element&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;43"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;24"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;rp&#34;&#44; &#34;rt&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;68"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;22"></a>[has a <code>ruby</code> element in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;16"></a>[generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#44; except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rtc&#45;4"></a><code>[rtc](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rtc)</code> elements&#46; If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;25"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not now a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;rtc&#45;5"></a><code>[rtc](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#rtc)</code> element or a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;ruby&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[ruby](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ruby-element)</code> element&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;44"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;25"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;math&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;16"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adjust&#45;mathml&#45;attributes"></a>[Adjust MathML attributes](#adjust-mathml-attributes) for the token&#46; &#40;This fixes the case of MathML attributes that are not all lowercase&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adjust&#45;foreign&#45;attributes"></a>[Adjust foreign attributes](#adjust-foreign-attributes) for the token&#46; &#40;This fixes the use of namespaced attributes&#44; in particular XLink&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;foreign&#45;element"></a>[Insert a foreign element](#insert-a-foreign-element) for the token&#44; with <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;mathml&#45;namespace"></a>[MathML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#mathml-namespace) and false&#46;

If the token has its <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a><em>[self&#45;closing flag](#self-closing-flag)</em> set&#44; pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;26"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;69"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;5"></a>[acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;svg&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;17"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adjust&#45;svg&#45;attributes"></a>[Adjust SVG attributes](#adjust-svg-attributes) for the token&#46; &#40;This fixes the case of SVG attributes that are not all lowercase&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adjust&#45;foreign&#45;attributes&#45;2"></a>[Adjust foreign attributes](#adjust-foreign-attributes) for the token&#46; &#40;This fixes the use of namespaced attributes&#44; in particular XLink in SVG&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;foreign&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Insert a foreign element](#insert-a-foreign-element) for the token&#44; with <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;svg&#45;namespace"></a>[SVG namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#svg-namespace) and false&#46;

If the token has its <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;2"></a><em>[self&#45;closing flag](#self-closing-flag)</em> set&#44; pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;27"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;70"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;6"></a>[acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;frame&#34;&#44; &#34;head&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;45"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Any other start tag</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;18"></a>[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; if any&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;26"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This element will be an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;ordinary"></a>[ordinary](#ordinary) element&#46; With one exception&#58; if <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) is <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[Disabled](#scripting-mode-disabled)&#44; it can also be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

Run these steps&#58;

1.  Initialize <var>node</var> to be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;28"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;the bottommost node of the stack&#41;&#46;

2.  <em>Loop</em>&#58; If <var>node</var> is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;15"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token&#58;

    1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;17"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#44; except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;16"></a>[HTML elements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token&#46;

    2.  If <var>node</var> is not the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;29"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;46"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

    3.  Pop all the nodes from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;30"></a>[current node](#current-node) up to <var>node</var>&#44; including <var>node</var>&#44; then stop these steps&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>node</var> is in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;special&#45;3"></a>[special](#special) category&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;47"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#44; and return&#46;

4.  Set <var>node</var> to the previous entry in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;71"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

5.  Return to the step labeled <em>loop</em>&#46;

When the steps above say the user agent is to <a id="close&#45;a&#45;p&#45;element"></a><strong>close a <code>p</code> element</strong>&#44; it means that the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;18"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#44; except for <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> elements&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;31"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;48"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;72"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

<a id="adoptionAgency"></a>The <a id="adoption&#45;agency&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>adoption agency algorithm</strong>&#44; which takes as its only argument a token <var>token</var> for which the algorithm is being run&#44; consists of the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>subject</var> be <var>token</var>&#39;s tag name&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;32"></a>[current node](#current-node) is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;17"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) whose tag name is <var>subject</var>&#44; and the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;33"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; then pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;34"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;73"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and return&#46;

3.  Let <var>outerLoopCounter</var> be 0&#46;

4.  While true&#58;

    1.  If <var>outerLoopCounter</var> is greater than or equal to 8&#44; then return&#46;

    2.  Increment <var>outerLoopCounter</var> by 1&#46;

    3.  Let <var>formattingElement</var> be the last element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) that&#58;

        - is between the end of the list and the last <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;4"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) in the list&#44; if any&#44; or the start of the list otherwise&#44; and
        - has the tag name <var>subject</var>&#46;

        If there is no such element&#44; then act as described in the &#34;any other end tag&#34; entry above and return&#46;

    4.  If <var>formattingElement</var> is not in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;74"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;49"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; remove the element from the list&#44; and return&#46;

    5.  If <var>formattingElement</var> is in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;75"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; but the element is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;scope&#45;23"></a>[in scope](#has-an-element-in-scope)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;50"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; return&#46;

    6.  If <var>formattingElement</var> is not the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;35"></a>[current node](#current-node)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;51"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; &#40;But do not return&#46;&#41;

    7.
