Let <var>furthestBlock</var> be the topmost node in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;76"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) that is lower in the stack than <var>formattingElement</var>&#44; and is an element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;special&#45;4"></a>[special](#special) category&#46; There might not be one&#46;

    8.  If there is no <var>furthestBlock</var>&#44; then the UA must first pop all the nodes from the bottom of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;77"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;36"></a>[current node](#current-node) up to and including <var>formattingElement</var>&#44; then remove <var>formattingElement</var> from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; and finally return&#46;

    9.  Let <var>commonAncestor</var> be the element immediately above <var>formattingElement</var> in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;78"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

    10. Let a bookmark note the position of <var>formattingElement</var> in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;7"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) relative to the elements on either side of it in the list&#46;

    11. Let <var>node</var> and <var>lastNode</var> be <var>furthestBlock</var>&#46;

    12. Let <var>innerLoopCounter</var> be 0&#46;

    13. While true&#58;

        1.  Increment <var>innerLoopCounter</var> by 1&#46;

        2.  Let <var>node</var> be the element immediately above <var>node</var> in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;79"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; or if <var>node</var> is no longer in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;80"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because it got removed by this algorithm&#41;&#44; the element that was immediately above <var>node</var> in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;81"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) before <var>node</var> was removed&#46;

        3.  If <var>node</var> is <var>formattingElement</var>&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;break"></a>[break](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break)&#46;

        4.  If <var>innerLoopCounter</var> is greater than 3 and <var>node</var> is in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; then remove <var>node</var> from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;9"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

        5.  If <var>node</var> is not in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;10"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; then remove <var>node</var> from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;82"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

        6.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;for&#45;the&#45;token"></a>[Create an element for the token](#create-an-element-for-the-token) for which the element <var>node</var> was created&#44; in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; with <var>commonAncestor</var> as the intended parent&#59; replace the entry for <var>node</var> in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;11"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) with an entry for the new element&#44; replace the entry for <var>node</var> in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;83"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) with an entry for the new element&#44; and let <var>node</var> be the new element&#46;

        7.  If <var>lastNode</var> is <var>furthestBlock</var>&#44; then move the aforementioned bookmark to be immediately after the new <var>node</var> in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;12"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

        8.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) <var>lastNode</var> to <var>node</var>&#46;

        9.  Set <var>lastNode</var> to <var>node</var>&#46;

    14. Let &#40;<var>target</var>&#44; <var>refNode</var>&#41; be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;adjusted&#45;insertion&#45;location"></a>[adjusted insertion location](#adjusted-insertion-location) given &#40;<var>commonAncestor</var>&#44; null&#41;&#46;

    15. If <var>lastNode</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parent"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is non&#45;null&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) <var>lastNode</var>&#46;

    16. If all of the following are true&#58;

        - <var>lastNode</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parent&#45;2"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is null&#59;
        - <var>lastNode</var> is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;host&#45;including&#45;inclusive&#45;ancestor"></a>[host&#45;including inclusive ancestor](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-host-including-inclusive-ancestor) of <var>target</var>&#59;
        - <var>target</var> is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node&#44; or it does not have an element child&#59; and
        - <var>refNode</var> is null or its <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;parent&#45;3"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is <var>target</var>&#44;

        then&#58;

        1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;ensure&#45;pre&#45;insert&#45;validity"></a>[ensure pre&#45;insert validity](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-ensure-pre-insertion-validity) given <var>lastNode</var>&#44; <var>target</var>&#44; <var>refNode</var>&#44; and « » does not throw&#46;

        2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert"></a>[Insert](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert) <var>lastNode</var> into <var>target</var> before <var>refNode</var>&#46;

    17. <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;for&#45;the&#45;token&#45;2"></a>[Create an element for the token](#create-an-element-for-the-token) for which <var>formattingElement</var> was created&#44; in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; with <var>furthestBlock</var> as the intended parent&#46;

    18. Take all of the child nodes of <var>furthestBlock</var> and append them to the element created in the last step&#46;

    19. Append that new element to <var>furthestBlock</var>&#46;

    20. Remove <var>formattingElement</var> from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;13"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; and insert the new element into the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;14"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) at the position of the aforementioned bookmark&#46;

    21. Remove <var>formattingElement</var> from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;84"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; and insert the new element into the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;85"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) immediately below the position of <var>furthestBlock</var> in that stack&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This algorithm&#39;s name&#44; the &#34;adoption agency algorithm&#34;&#44; comes from the way it causes elements to change parents&#44; and is in contrast with [other possible algorithms](https://ln.hixie.ch/?start=1037910467&count=1) for dealing with misnested content&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;8 The &#34;<strong>text</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-incdata)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata"></a>[text](#parsing-main-incdata)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[Insert the token&#39;s character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This can never be a U&#43;0000 NULL character&#59; the tokenizer converts those to U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER characters&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element&#44; then set its <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;already&#45;started"></a>[already started](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#already-started) to true&#46;

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode) and reprocess the token&#46;

<a id="scriptEndTag"></a><strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;script&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) is null and the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;javascript&#45;execution&#45;context&#45;stack"></a>[JavaScript execution context stack](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack) is empty&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;perform&#45;a&#45;microtask&#45;checkpoint"></a>[perform a microtask checkpoint](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#perform-a-microtask-checkpoint)&#46;

Let <var>script</var> be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;which will be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element&#41;&#46;

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode)&#46;

Let the <var>old insertion point</var> have the same value as the current <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;point"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point)&#46; Let the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;point&#45;2"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) be just before the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#46;

Increment the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) by one&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) is null&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;prepare&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a>[prepare the script element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#prepare-the-script-element) <var>script</var>&#46; This might cause some script to execute&#44; which might cause <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write"></a>[new characters to be inserted into the tokenizer](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)&#44; and might cause the tokenizer to output more tokens&#44; resulting in a [reentrant invocation of the parser](#nestedParsing)&#46;

Decrement the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level&#45;2"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) by one&#46; If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level&#45;3"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) is zero&#44; then set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;parser&#45;pause&#45;flag"></a>[parser pause flag](#parser-pause-flag) to false&#46;

Let the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;point&#45;3"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) have the value of the <var>old insertion point</var>&#46; &#40;In other words&#44; restore the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;point&#45;4"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) to its previous value&#46; This value might be the &#34;undefined&#34; value&#46;&#41;

<a id="scriptTagParserResumes"></a>At this stage&#44; if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script"></a>[pending parsing&#45;blocking script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#pending-parsing-blocking-script) is not null&#58;

<strong>If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level&#45;4"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) is not zero&#58;</strong>

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;parser&#45;pause&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[parser pause flag](#parser-pause-flag) to true&#44; and abort the processing of any nested invocations of the tokenizer&#44; yielding control back to the caller&#46; &#40;Tokenization will resume when the caller returns to the &#34;outer&#34; tree construction stage&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The tree construction stage of this particular parser is [being called reentrantly](#nestedParsing)&#44; say from a call to <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write&#45;2"></a><code>[document&#46;write&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)</code>&#46;

<strong>Otherwise&#58;</strong>

While the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script&#45;2"></a>[pending parsing&#45;blocking script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#pending-parsing-blocking-script) is not null&#58;

1.  Let <var>the script</var> be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script&#45;3"></a>[pending parsing&#45;blocking script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#pending-parsing-blocking-script)&#46;

2.  Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script&#45;4"></a>[pending parsing&#45;blocking script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#pending-parsing-blocking-script) to null&#46;

3.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;start&#45;the&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[Start the speculative HTML parser](#start-the-speculative-html-parser) for this instance of the HTML parser&#46;

4.  Block the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;tokenization"></a>[tokenizer](#tokenization) for this instance of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#44; such that the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) will not run <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that invoke the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;tokenization&#45;2"></a>[tokenizer](#tokenization)&#46;

5.  If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;has&#45;a&#45;style&#45;sheet&#45;that&#45;is&#45;blocking&#45;scripts"></a>[has a style sheet that is blocking scripts](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#has-a-style-sheet-that-is-blocking-scripts) or <var>the script</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;ready&#45;to&#45;be&#45;parser&#45;executed"></a>[ready to be parser&#45;executed](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#ready-to-be-parser-executed) is false&#58; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;spin&#45;the&#45;event&#45;loop"></a>[spin the event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#spin-the-event-loop) until the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;has&#45;no&#45;style&#45;sheet&#45;that&#45;is&#45;blocking&#45;scripts"></a>[has no style sheet that is blocking scripts](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#has-no-style-sheet-that-is-blocking-scripts) and <var>the script</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;ready&#45;to&#45;be&#45;parser&#45;executed&#45;2"></a>[ready to be parser&#45;executed](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#ready-to-be-parser-executed) becomes true&#46;

6.  If this <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;abort&#45;a&#45;parser"></a>[parser has been aborted](#abort-a-parser) in the meantime&#44; return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This could happen if&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; while the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;spin&#45;the&#45;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[spin the event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#spin-the-event-loop) algorithm is running&#44; the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> gets <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;destroy&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[destroyed](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#destroy-a-document)&#44; or the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;open"></a><code>[document&#46;open&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-open)</code> method gets invoked on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#46;

7.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;stop&#45;the&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[Stop the speculative HTML parser](#stop-the-speculative-html-parser) for this instance of the HTML parser&#46;

8.  Unblock the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;tokenization&#45;3"></a>[tokenizer](#tokenization) for this instance of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#44; such that <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that invoke the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;tokenization&#45;4"></a>[tokenizer](#tokenization) can again be run&#46;

9.  Let the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;point&#45;5"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) be just before the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#46;

10. Increment the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level&#45;5"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) by one &#40;it should be zero before this step&#44; so this sets it to one&#41;&#46;

11. <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a>[Execute the script element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#execute-the-script-element) <var>the script</var>&#46;

12. Decrement the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level&#45;6"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) by one&#46; If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level&#45;7"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) is zero &#40;which it always should be at this point&#41;&#44; then set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;parser&#45;pause&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[parser pause flag](#parser-pause-flag) to false&#46;

13. Let the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;point&#45;6"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) be undefined again&#46;

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;current&#45;node&#45;5"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incdata&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode)&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;9 The &#34;<strong>in table</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-intable)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token&#44; if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) is <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element</strong>

Let the <a id="concept&#45;pending&#45;table&#45;char&#45;tokens"></a><strong><var>pending table character tokens</var></strong> be an empty list of tokens&#46;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode) to the current <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext"></a>[in table text](#parsing-main-intabletext)&#34; and reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;caption&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;context"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

Insert a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) at the end of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption"></a>[in caption](#parsing-main-incaption)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;colgroup&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;context&#45;2"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup"></a>[in column group](#parsing-main-incolgroup)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;col&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;context&#45;3"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for a &#34;colgroup&#34; start tag token with no attributes&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#45;2"></a>[in column group](#parsing-main-incolgroup)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the current token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;context&#45;4"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;7"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;context&#45;5"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for a &#34;tbody&#34; start tag token with no attributes&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;8"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#45;2"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the current token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;table&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope"></a>[have a <code>table</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#44; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  Pop elements from this stack until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;appropriately"></a>[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately)&#46;

3.  Reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;table&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[have a <code>table</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  Pop elements from this stack until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;appropriately&#45;2"></a>[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;style&#34;&#44; &#34;script&#34;&#44; &#34;template&#34;</strong>

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;template&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;9"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;input&#34;</strong>

If the token does not have an attribute with the name &#34;type&#34;&#44; or if it does&#44; but that attribute&#39;s value is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>hidden</code>&#34;&#44; then act as described in the &#34;anything else&#34; entry below&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;5"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

2.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

3.  Pop that <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

4.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;form&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;6"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) is not null&#44; and the parser is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;template&#45;contents"></a>[parsing template contents](#parsing-template-contents)&#44; then ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#44; and&#44; if the parser is not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;template&#45;contents&#45;2"></a>[parsing template contents](#parsing-template-contents)&#44; set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;2"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) to point to the element created&#46;

2.  Pop that <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;10"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;7"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Enable <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;foster&#45;parent"></a>[foster parenting](#foster-parent)&#44; process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;3"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;2"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;11"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; and then disable <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;foster&#45;parent&#45;2"></a>[foster parenting](#foster-parent)&#46;

When the steps above require the UA to <a id="clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;context"></a><strong>clear the stack back to a table context</strong>&#44; it means that the UA must&#44; while the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This is the same list of elements as used in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;3"></a><em>[has an element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)</em> steps&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) being an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element after this process is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;10 The &#34;<strong>in table text</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-intabletext)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext"></a>[in table text](#parsing-main-intabletext)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Any other character token</strong>

Append the character token to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;concept&#45;pending&#45;table&#45;char&#45;tokens"></a><var>[pending table character tokens](#concept-pending-table-char-tokens)</var> list&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

If any of the tokens in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;concept&#45;pending&#45;table&#45;char&#45;tokens&#45;2"></a><var>[pending table character tokens](#concept-pending-table-char-tokens)</var> list are character tokens that are not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#58; reprocess the character tokens in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;concept&#45;pending&#45;table&#45;char&#45;tokens&#45;3"></a><var>[pending table character tokens](#concept-pending-table-char-tokens)</var> list using the rules given in the &#34;anything else&#34; entry in the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34; insertion mode&#46;

Otherwise&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[insert the characters](#insert-a-character) given by the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;concept&#45;pending&#45;table&#45;char&#45;tokens&#45;4"></a><var>[pending table character tokens](#concept-pending-table-char-tokens)</var> list&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode) and reprocess the token&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;11 The &#34;<strong>in caption</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-incaption)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption"></a>[in caption](#parsing-main-incaption)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;caption&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope"></a>[have a <code>caption</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  Now&#44; if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from this stack until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

4.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;up&#45;to&#45;the&#45;last&#45;marker"></a>[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker)&#46;

5.  Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;table&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[have a <code>caption</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;2"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;2"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  Now&#44; if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from this stack until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[caption](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-caption-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

4.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;up&#45;to&#45;the&#45;last&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker)&#46;

5.  Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#45;2"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#46;

6.  Reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;5"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incaption&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;12 The &#34;<strong>in column group</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-incolgroup)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup"></a>[in column group](#parsing-main-incolgroup)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[Insert the character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;col&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; Immediately pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;colgroup&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;col&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;template&#34;</strong>

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;template&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;3"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;2"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[colgroup](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;current&#45;node&#45;5"></a>[current node](#current-node) from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#45;2"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the token&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;13 The &#34;<strong>in table body</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-intbody)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;body&#45;context"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;body&#45;context&#45;2"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for a &#34;tr&#34; start tag token with no attributes&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#45;2"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34;&#46;

Reprocess the current token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope"></a>[have an element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;body&#45;context&#45;3"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

2.  Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;</strong>

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;table&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[have a <code>tbody</code>&#44; <code>thead</code>&#44; or <code>tfoot</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;body&#45;context&#45;4"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-body-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

2.  Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#45;2"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#46;

3.  Reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#45;3"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

When the steps above require the UA to <a id="clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;body&#45;context"></a><strong>clear the stack back to a table body context</strong>&#44; it means that the UA must&#44; while the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tfoot-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) being an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element after this process is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;14 The &#34;<strong>in row</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-intr)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;row&#45;context"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intd"></a>[in cell](#parsing-main-intd)&#34;&#46;

Insert a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) at the end of the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope"></a>[have a <code>tr</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;row&#45;context&#45;2"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

2.  Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;which will be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#41; from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;table&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[have a <code>tr</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;row&#45;context&#45;3"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

2.  Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;which will be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#41; from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#45;2"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#46;

3.  Reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;3"></a>[have an element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;4"></a>[have a <code>tr</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#44; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;row&#45;context&#45;4"></a>[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#clear-the-stack-back-to-a-table-row-context)&#46; &#40;See below&#46;&#41;

2.  Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;which will be a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> element&#41; from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;7"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46; Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#45;3"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#46;

3.  Reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

When the steps above require the UA to <a id="clear&#45;the&#45;stack&#45;back&#45;to&#45;a&#45;table&#45;row&#45;context"></a><strong>clear the stack back to a table row context</strong>&#44; it means that the UA must&#44; while the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code>&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;8"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;current&#45;node&#45;5"></a>[current node](#current-node) being an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element after this process is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;15 The &#34;<strong>in cell</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-intd)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intd"></a>[in cell](#parsing-main-intd)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope"></a>[have an element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  Now&#44; if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack&#46;

4.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;up&#45;to&#45;the&#45;last&#45;marker"></a>[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker)&#46;

5.  Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[has a <code>td</code> or <code>th</code> element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;close&#45;the&#45;cell"></a>[Close the cell](#close-the-cell) &#40;see below&#41; and reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;col&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;html&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;table&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;&#44; &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) does not <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;3"></a>[have an element in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope) that is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) with the same tag name as that of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46;

Otherwise&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;close&#45;the&#45;cell&#45;2"></a>[close the cell](#close-the-cell) &#40;see below&#41; and reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

Where the steps above say to <a id="close&#45;the&#45;cell"></a><strong>close the cell</strong>&#44; they mean to run the following algorithm&#58;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;generate&#45;implied&#45;end&#45;tags&#45;2"></a>[Generate implied end tags](#generate-implied-end-tags)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not now a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element or a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;5"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element or a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

4.  <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;up&#45;to&#45;the&#45;last&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker)&#46;

5.  Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#45;2"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) cannot have both a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> and a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[th](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-th-element)</code> element <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;has&#45;an&#45;element&#45;in&#45;table&#45;scope&#45;4"></a>[in table scope](#has-an-element-in-table-scope) at the same time&#44; nor can it have neither when the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intd&#58;close&#45;the&#45;cell&#45;3"></a>[close the cell](#close-the-cell) algorithm is invoked&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;16 The &#34;<strong>in template</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-intemplate)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate"></a>[in template](#parsing-main-intemplate)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token</strong>

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;
