<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;base&#34;&#44; &#34;basefont&#34;&#44; &#34;bgsound&#34;&#44; &#34;link&#34;&#44; &#34;meta&#34;&#44; &#34;noframes&#34;&#44; &#34;script&#34;&#44; &#34;style&#34;&#44; &#34;template&#34;&#44; &#34;title&#34;</strong>

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;template&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;caption&#34;&#44; &#34;colgroup&#34;&#44; &#34;tbody&#34;&#44; &#34;tfoot&#34;&#44; &#34;thead&#34;</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes)&#46;

Push &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34; onto the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;2"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#45;2"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#44; and reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;col&#34;</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;3"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes)&#46;

Push &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup"></a>[in column group](#parsing-main-incolgroup)&#34; onto the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;4"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;incolgroup&#45;2"></a>[in column group](#parsing-main-incolgroup)&#34;&#44; and reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;tr&#34;</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;5"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes)&#46;

Push &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34; onto the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;6"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#45;2"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#44; and reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;td&#34;&#44; &#34;th&#34;</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;7"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;7"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes)&#46;

Push &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34; onto the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;8"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;8"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;7"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#45;2"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34;&#44; and reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>Any other start tag</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;9"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;9"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes)&#46;

Push &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;2"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; onto the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;10"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;10"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode)&#46;

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;8"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;3"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34;&#44; and reprocess the token&#46;

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

If there is no <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element on the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; then <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[stop parsing](#stop-parsing)&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

Otherwise&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

Pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element has been popped from the stack&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;clear&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;up&#45;to&#45;the&#45;last&#45;marker"></a>[Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#clear-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements-up-to-the-last-marker)&#46;

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;11"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes&#45;11"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;appropriately"></a>[Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately)&#46;

Reprocess the token&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;17 The &#34;<strong>after body</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-afterbody)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody"></a>[after body](#parsing-main-afterbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment) given &#40;the first element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) &#40;the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#41;&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction) given &#40;the first element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) &#40;the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#41;&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;2"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is non&#45;null&#44; this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

Otherwise&#44; switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after after body](#the-after-after-body-insertion-mode)&#34;&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[Stop parsing](#stop-parsing)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterbody&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;3"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; and reprocess the token&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;18 The &#34;<strong>in frameset</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-inframeset)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset"></a>[in frameset](#parsing-main-inframeset)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[Insert the character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;frameset&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;frameset&#34;</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) is the root <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#59; ignore the token&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

Otherwise&#44; pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is null and the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) is no longer a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;frameset"></a><code>[frameset](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frameset)</code> element&#44; then switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset"></a>[after frameset](#parsing-main-afterframeset)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;frame&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Insert an HTML element](#insert-an-html-element) for the token&#46; Immediately pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; if it is set&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;noframes&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;current&#45;node&#45;5"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not the root <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;current&#45;node&#45;6"></a>[current node](#current-node) can only be the root <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;fragment&#45;case&#45;2"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#46;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[Stop parsing](#stop-parsing)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inframeset&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

###### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;19 The &#34;<strong>after frameset</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#parsing-main-afterframeset)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset"></a>[after frameset](#parsing-main-afterframeset)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[Insert the character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Switch the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after after frameset](#the-after-after-frameset-insertion-mode)&#34;&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;noframes&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[Stop parsing](#stop-parsing)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;afterframeset&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

###### <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;20 The &#34;<strong>after after body</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#the-after-after-body-insertion-mode)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after after body](#the-after-after-body-insertion-mode)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment) given &#40;the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction) given &#40;the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[Stop parsing](#stop-parsing)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Switch the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) to &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;body&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody&#45;2"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; and reprocess the token&#46;

###### <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;4&#46;21 The &#34;<strong>after after frameset</strong>&#34; insertion mode[](#the-after-after-frameset-insertion-mode)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[after after frameset](#the-after-after-frameset-insertion-mode)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment) given &#40;the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction) given &#40;the <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; null&#41;&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;html&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>An end&#45;of&#45;file token</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;stop&#45;parsing"></a>[Stop parsing](#stop-parsing)&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;noframes&#34;</strong>

Process the token <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;using&#45;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;2"></a>[using the rules for](#using-the-rules-for) the &#34;<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inhead"></a>[in head](#parsing-main-inhead)&#34; <a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#46;

<strong>Anything else</strong>

<a id="the&#45;after&#45;after&#45;frameset&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

##### <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign"></a>13&#46;2&#46;6&#46;5 The rules for parsing tokens <strong>in foreign content</strong>[](#parsing-main-inforeign)

When the user agent is to apply the rules for parsing tokens in foreign content&#44; the user agent must handle the token as follows&#58;

<strong>A character token that is U&#43;0000 NULL</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;parse&#45;errors"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character"></a>[Insert a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>A character token that is one of U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41;&#44; U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41;&#44; or U&#43;0020 SPACE</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character&#45;2"></a>[Insert the token&#39;s character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

<strong>Any other character token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;character&#45;3"></a>[Insert the token&#39;s character](#insert-a-character)&#46;

Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;frameset&#45;ok&#45;flag"></a>[frameset&#45;ok flag](#frameset-ok-flag) to &#34;not ok&#34;&#46;

<strong>A comment token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;comment"></a>[Insert a comment](#insert-a-comment)&#46;

<strong>A processing instruction token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;processing&#45;instruction"></a>[Insert a processing instruction](#insert-a-processing-instruction)&#46;

<strong>A DOCTYPE token</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;2"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46; Ignore the token&#46;

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is one of&#58; &#34;b&#34;&#44; &#34;big&#34;&#44; &#34;blockquote&#34;&#44; &#34;body&#34;&#44; &#34;br&#34;&#44; &#34;center&#34;&#44; &#34;code&#34;&#44; &#34;dd&#34;&#44; &#34;div&#34;&#44; &#34;dl&#34;&#44; &#34;dt&#34;&#44; &#34;em&#34;&#44; &#34;embed&#34;&#44; &#34;h1&#34;&#44; &#34;h2&#34;&#44; &#34;h3&#34;&#44; &#34;h4&#34;&#44; &#34;h5&#34;&#44; &#34;h6&#34;&#44; &#34;head&#34;&#44; &#34;hr&#34;&#44; &#34;i&#34;&#44; &#34;img&#34;&#44; &#34;li&#34;&#44; &#34;listing&#34;&#44; &#34;menu&#34;&#44; &#34;meta&#34;&#44; &#34;nobr&#34;&#44; &#34;ol&#34;&#44; &#34;p&#34;&#44; &#34;pre&#34;&#44; &#34;ruby&#34;&#44; &#34;s&#34;&#44; &#34;small&#34;&#44; &#34;span&#34;&#44; &#34;strong&#34;&#44; &#34;strike&#34;&#44; &#34;sub&#34;&#44; &#34;sup&#34;&#44; &#34;table&#34;&#44; &#34;tt&#34;&#44; &#34;u&#34;&#44; &#34;ul&#34;&#44; &#34;var&#34;</strong>

<strong>A start tag whose tag name is &#34;font&#34;&#44; if the token has any attributes named &#34;color&#34;&#44; &#34;face&#34;&#44; or &#34;size&#34;</strong>

<strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;br&#34;&#44; &#34;p&#34;</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;3"></a>[Parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

While the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;current&#45;node"></a>[current node](#current-node) is not a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;mathml&#45;text&#45;integration&#45;point"></a>[MathML text integration point](#mathml-text-integration-point)&#44; an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;html&#45;integration&#45;point"></a>[HTML integration point](#html-integration-point)&#44; or an element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Reprocess the token according to the rules given in the section corresponding to the current <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) in HTML content&#46;

<strong>Any other start tag</strong>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is an element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;mathml&#45;namespace"></a>[MathML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#mathml-namespace)&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;adjust&#45;mathml&#45;attributes"></a>[adjust MathML attributes](#adjust-mathml-attributes) for the token&#46; &#40;This fixes the case of MathML attributes that are not all lowercase&#46;&#41;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is an element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;svg&#45;namespace"></a>[SVG namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#svg-namespace)&#44; and the token&#39;s tag name is one of the ones in the first column of the following table&#44; change the tag name to the name given in the corresponding cell in the second column&#46; &#40;This fixes the case of SVG elements that are not all lowercase&#46;&#41;

<table><thead><tr><th> Tag name </th><th> Element name      </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td> <code>altglyph</code> </td><td> <code>altGlyph</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>altglyphdef</code> </td><td> <code>altGlyphDef</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>altglyphitem</code> </td><td> <code>altGlyphItem</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>animatecolor</code> </td><td> <code>animateColor</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>animatemotion</code> </td><td> <code>animateMotion</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>animatetransform</code> </td><td> </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fecomposite</code> </td><td> <code>feComposite</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>feconvolvematrix</code> </td><td> <code>feConvolveMatrix</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fediffuselighting</code> </td><td> <code>feDiffuseLighting</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fedisplacementmap</code> </td><td> <code>feDisplacementMap</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fedistantlight</code> </td><td> <code>feDistantLight</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fedropshadow</code> </td><td> <code>feDropShadow</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>feflood</code> </td><td> <code>feFlood</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fefunca</code> </td><td> <code>feFuncA</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fefuncb</code> </td><td> <code>feFuncB</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fefuncg</code> </td><td> <code>feFuncG</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fefuncr</code> </td><td> <code>feFuncR</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fegaussianblur</code> </td><td> <code>feGaussianBlur</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>feimage</code> </td><td> <code>feImage</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>femerge</code> </td><td> <code>feMerge</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>femergenode</code> </td><td> <code>feMergeNode</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>femorphology</code> </td><td> <code>feMorphology</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>feoffset</code> </td><td> <code>feOffset</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fepointlight</code> </td><td> <code>fePointLight</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fespecularlighting</code> </td><td> <code>feSpecularLighting</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fespotlight</code> </td><td> <code>feSpotLight</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>fetile</code> </td><td> <code>feTile</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>feturbulence</code> </td><td> <code>feTurbulence</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>foreignobject</code> </td><td> <code>foreignObject</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>glyphref</code> </td><td> <code>glyphRef</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>lineargradient</code> </td><td> <code>linearGradient</code>       </td></tr><tr><td> <code>radialgradient</code> </td><td> <code>radialGradient</code>              </td></tr><tr><td> <code>textpath</code> </td><td> <code>textPath</code>     </td></tr></tbody></table>

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node) is an element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;svg&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[SVG namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#svg-namespace)&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;adjust&#45;svg&#45;attributes"></a>[adjust SVG attributes](#adjust-svg-attributes) for the token&#46; &#40;This fixes the case of SVG attributes that are not all lowercase&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;adjust&#45;foreign&#45;attributes"></a>[Adjust foreign attributes](#adjust-foreign-attributes) for the token&#46; &#40;This fixes the use of namespaced attributes&#44; in particular XLink in SVG&#46;&#41;

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insert&#45;a&#45;foreign&#45;element"></a>[Insert a foreign element](#insert-a-foreign-element) for the token&#44; with the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;adjusted&#45;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[adjusted current node](#adjusted-current-node)&#39;s namespace and false&#46;

If the token has its <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a><em>[self&#45;closing flag](#self-closing-flag)</em> set&#44; then run the appropriate steps from the following list&#58;

<strong>If the token&#39;s tag name is &#34;script&#34;&#44; and the new <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;current&#45;node&#45;2"></a>[current node](#current-node) is in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;svg&#45;namespace&#45;3"></a>[SVG namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#svg-namespace)</strong>

<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag"></a>[Acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#44; and then act as described in the steps for a &#34;script&#34; end tag below&#46;

<strong>Otherwise</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;current&#45;node&#45;3"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) and <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;acknowledge&#45;self&#45;closing&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[acknowledge the token&#39;s <em>self&#45;closing flag</em>](#acknowledge-self-closing-flag)&#46;

<a id="scriptForeignEndTag"></a><strong>An end tag whose tag name is &#34;script&#34;&#44; if the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;current&#45;node&#45;4"></a>[current node](#current-node) is an <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;svg&#45;script"></a>[SVG <code>script</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/interact.html#elementdef-script) element</strong>

Pop the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;current&#45;node&#45;5"></a>[current node](#current-node) off the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

Let the <var>old insertion point</var> have the same value as the current <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insertion&#45;point"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point)&#46; Let the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insertion&#45;point&#45;2"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) be just before the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character)&#46;

Increment the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) by one&#46; Set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;parser&#45;pause&#45;flag"></a>[parser pause flag](#parser-pause-flag) to true&#46;

If the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) is null and the user agent supports SVG&#44; then [Process the SVG <code>script</code> element](https://www.w3.org/TR/SVGMobile12/script.html#ScriptContentProcessing) according to the SVG rules&#46; [&#91;SVG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSVG)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Even if this causes <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write"></a>[new characters to be inserted into the tokenizer](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)&#44; the parser will not be executed reentrantly&#44; since the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;parser&#45;pause&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[parser pause flag](#parser-pause-flag) is true&#46;

Decrement the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level&#45;2"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) by one&#46; If the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;script&#45;nesting&#45;level&#45;3"></a>[script nesting level](#script-nesting-level) is zero&#44; then set the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;parser&#45;pause&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[parser pause flag](#parser-pause-flag) to false&#46;

Let the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insertion&#45;point&#45;3"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) have the value of the <var>old insertion point</var>&#46; &#40;In other words&#44; restore the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insertion&#45;point&#45;4"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) to its previous value&#46; This value might be the &#34;undefined&#34; value&#46;&#41;

<strong>Any other end tag</strong>

Run these steps&#58;

1.  Initialize <var>node</var> to be the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;current&#45;node&#45;6"></a>[current node](#current-node) &#40;the bottommost node of the stack&#41;&#46;

2.  If <var>node</var>&#39;s tag name&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;converted&#45;to&#45;ascii&#45;lowercase"></a>[converted to ASCII lowercase](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase)&#44; is not the same as the tag name of the token&#44; then this is a <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;parse&#45;errors&#45;4"></a>[parse error](#parse-errors)&#46;

3.  <em>Loop</em>&#58; If <var>node</var> is the topmost element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; then return&#46; &#40;<a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case)&#41;

4.  If <var>node</var>&#39;s tag name&#44; <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;converted&#45;to&#45;ascii&#45;lowercase&#45;2"></a>[converted to ASCII lowercase](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase)&#44; is the same as the tag name of the token&#44; pop elements from the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) until <var>node</var> has been popped from the stack&#44; and then return&#46;

5.  Set <var>node</var> to the previous entry in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

6.  If <var>node</var> is not an element in the <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; return to the step labeled <em>loop</em>&#46;

7.  Otherwise&#44; process the token according to the rules given in the section corresponding to the current <a id="parsing&#45;main&#45;inforeign&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) in HTML content&#46;

#### <a id="the&#45;end"></a>13&#46;2&#46;7 The end[](#the-end)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Document&#47;DOMContentLoaded&#95;event](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/DOMContentLoaded_event)

Support in all current engines&#46;

[Window&#47;load&#95;event](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/load_event)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Once the user agent <a id="stop&#45;parsing"></a><strong>stops parsing</strong> the document&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) is not null&#44; then <a id="the&#45;end&#58;stop&#45;the&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[stop the speculative HTML parser](#stop-the-speculative-html-parser) and return&#46;

2.  Set the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;insertion&#45;point"></a>[insertion point](#insertion-point) to undefined&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;update&#45;the&#45;current&#45;document&#45;readiness"></a>[Update the current document readiness](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#update-the-current-document-readiness) to &#34;<code>interactive</code>&#34;&#46;

4.  Pop <em>all</em> the nodes off the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

5.  While the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;when&#45;the&#45;document&#45;has&#45;finished&#45;parsing"></a>[list of scripts that will execute when the document has finished parsing](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#list-of-scripts-that-will-execute-when-the-document-has-finished-parsing) is not empty&#58;

    1.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;spin&#45;the&#45;event&#45;loop"></a>[Spin the event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#spin-the-event-loop) until the first <a id="the&#45;end&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;when&#45;the&#45;document&#45;has&#45;finished&#45;parsing&#45;2"></a>[list of scripts that will execute when the document has finished parsing](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#list-of-scripts-that-will-execute-when-the-document-has-finished-parsing) has its <a id="the&#45;end&#58;ready&#45;to&#45;be&#45;parser&#45;executed"></a>[ready to be parser&#45;executed](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#ready-to-be-parser-executed) set to true <em>and</em> the parser&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> <a id="the&#45;end&#58;has&#45;no&#45;style&#45;sheet&#45;that&#45;is&#45;blocking&#45;scripts"></a>[has no style sheet that is blocking scripts](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#has-no-style-sheet-that-is-blocking-scripts)&#46;

    2.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;execute&#45;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a>[Execute the script element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#execute-the-script-element) given by the first <a id="the&#45;end&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;when&#45;the&#45;document&#45;has&#45;finished&#45;parsing&#45;3"></a>[list of scripts that will execute when the document has finished parsing](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#list-of-scripts-that-will-execute-when-the-document-has-finished-parsing)&#46;

    3.  Remove the first <a id="the&#45;end&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element from the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;when&#45;the&#45;document&#45;has&#45;finished&#45;parsing&#45;4"></a>[list of scripts that will execute when the document has finished parsing](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#list-of-scripts-that-will-execute-when-the-document-has-finished-parsing) &#40;i&#46;e&#46; shift out the first entry in the list&#41;&#46;

6.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;global&#45;task"></a>[Queue a global task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-global-task) on the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) to run the following substeps&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;load&#45;timing&#45;info"></a>[load timing info](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#load-timing-info)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;dom&#45;content&#45;loaded&#45;event&#45;start&#45;time"></a>[DOM content loaded event start time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-content-loaded-event-start-time) to the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;current&#45;high&#45;resolution&#45;time"></a>[current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) given the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;2"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    2.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;end&#58;event&#45;domcontentloaded"></a><code>[DOMContentLoaded](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-domcontentloaded)</code> at the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; with its <a id="the&#45;end&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

    3.  Set the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;load&#45;timing&#45;info&#45;2"></a>[load timing info](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#load-timing-info)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;dom&#45;content&#45;loaded&#45;event&#45;end&#45;time"></a>[DOM content loaded event end time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-content-loaded-event-end-time) to the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;current&#45;high&#45;resolution&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) given the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;3"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    4.  Enable the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;dfn&#45;client&#45;message&#45;queue"></a>[client message queue](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#dfn-client-message-queue) of the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;serviceworkercontainer"></a><code>[ServiceWorkerContainer](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer)</code> object whose associated <a id="the&#45;end&#58;serviceworkercontainer&#45;service&#45;worker&#45;client"></a>[service worker client](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client) is the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#46;

    5.  Invoke <a id="the&#45;end&#58;webdriver&#45;bidi&#45;dom&#45;content&#45;loaded"></a>[WebDriver BiDi DOM content loaded](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-dom-content-loaded) with the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc)&#44; and a new <a id="the&#45;end&#58;webdriver&#45;bidi&#45;navigation&#45;status"></a>[WebDriver BiDi navigation status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status) whose <a id="the&#45;end&#58;navigation&#45;status&#45;id"></a>[id](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id) is the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;navigation&#45;id"></a>[during&#45;loading navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-document-navigation-id)&#44; <a id="the&#45;end&#58;navigation&#45;status&#45;status"></a>[status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status) is &#34;<a id="the&#45;end&#58;navigation&#45;status&#45;pending"></a><code>[pending](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-pending)</code>&#34;&#44; and <a id="the&#45;end&#58;navigation&#45;status&#45;url"></a>[url](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url) is the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;11"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)&#46;

7.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;spin&#45;the&#45;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[Spin the event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#spin-the-event-loop) until the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;set&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;as&#45;soon&#45;as&#45;possible"></a>[set of scripts that will execute as soon as possible](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#set-of-scripts-that-will-execute-as-soon-as-possible) and the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;list&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;will&#45;execute&#45;in&#45;order&#45;as&#45;soon&#45;as&#45;possible"></a>[list of scripts that will execute in order as soon as possible](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#list-of-scripts-that-will-execute-in-order-as-soon-as-possible) are empty&#46;

8.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;spin&#45;the&#45;event&#45;loop&#45;3"></a>[Spin the event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#spin-the-event-loop) until there is nothing that <a id="delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a><strong>delays the load event</strong> in the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;12"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#46;

9.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;global&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue a global task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-global-task) on the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;13"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;4"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) to run the following steps&#58;

    1.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;update&#45;the&#45;current&#45;document&#45;readiness&#45;2"></a>[Update the current document readiness](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#update-the-current-document-readiness) to &#34;<code>complete</code>&#34;&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;14"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc&#45;2"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc) is null&#44; then abort these steps&#46;

    3.  Let <var>window</var> be the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;15"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;5"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    4.  Set the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;16"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;load&#45;timing&#45;info&#45;3"></a>[load timing info](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#load-timing-info)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;load&#45;event&#45;start&#45;time"></a>[load event start time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#load-event-start-time) to the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;current&#45;high&#45;resolution&#45;time&#45;3"></a>[current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) given <var>window</var>&#46;

    5.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;end&#58;event&#45;load"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at <var>window</var>&#44; with <em>legacy target override flag</em> set&#46;

    6.  Invoke <a id="the&#45;end&#58;webdriver&#45;bidi&#45;load&#45;complete"></a>[WebDriver BiDi load complete](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-load-complete) with the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;17"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc&#45;3"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc)&#44; and a new <a id="the&#45;end&#58;webdriver&#45;bidi&#45;navigation&#45;status&#45;2"></a>[WebDriver BiDi navigation status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status) whose <a id="the&#45;end&#58;navigation&#45;status&#45;id&#45;2"></a>[id](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id) is the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;18"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;navigation&#45;id&#45;2"></a>[during&#45;loading navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-document-navigation-id)&#44; <a id="the&#45;end&#58;navigation&#45;status&#45;status&#45;2"></a>[status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status) is &#34;<a id="the&#45;end&#58;navigation&#45;status&#45;complete"></a><code>[complete](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-complete)</code>&#34;&#44; and <a id="the&#45;end&#58;navigation&#45;status&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[url](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url) is the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;19"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)&#46;

    7.  Set the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;20"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;navigation&#45;id&#45;3"></a>[during&#45;loading navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-document-navigation-id) to null&#46;

    8.  Set the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;21"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;load&#45;timing&#45;info&#45;4"></a>[load timing info](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#load-timing-info)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;load&#45;event&#45;end&#45;time"></a>[load event end time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#load-event-end-time) to the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;current&#45;high&#45;resolution&#45;time&#45;4"></a>[current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) given <var>window</var>&#46;

    9.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;22"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;page&#45;showing"></a>[page showing](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#page-showing) is false&#46;

    10. Set the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;23"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;page&#45;showing&#45;2"></a>[page showing](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#page-showing) to true&#46;

    11. <a id="the&#45;end&#58;fire&#45;a&#45;page&#45;transition&#45;event"></a>[Fire a page transition event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fire-a-page-transition-event) named <a id="the&#45;end&#58;event&#45;pageshow"></a><code>[pageshow](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-pageshow)</code> at <var>window</var> with false&#46;

    12. <a id="the&#45;end&#58;completely&#45;finish&#45;loading"></a>[Completely finish loading](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#completely-finish-loading) the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;24"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#46;

    13. <a id="the&#45;end&#58;queue&#45;the&#45;navigation&#45;timing&#45;entry"></a>[Queue the navigation timing entry](https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dfn-queue-the-navigation-timing-entry) for the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;25"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#46;

10. If the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;26"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;end&#58;print&#45;when&#45;loaded"></a>[print when loaded](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#print-when-loaded) flag is set&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;printing&#45;steps"></a>[printing steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#printing-steps)&#46;

11. The <a id="the&#45;end&#58;document&#45;27"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> is now <a id="ready&#45;for&#45;post&#45;load&#45;tasks"></a><strong>ready for post&#45;load tasks</strong>&#46;

When the user agent is to <a id="abort&#45;a&#45;parser"></a><strong>abort a parser</strong>&#44; it must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Throw away any pending content in the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;input&#45;stream"></a>[input stream](#input-stream)&#44; and discard any future content that would have been added to it&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;stop&#45;the&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[Stop the speculative HTML parser](#stop-the-speculative-html-parser) for this HTML parser&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;update&#45;the&#45;current&#45;document&#45;readiness&#45;3"></a>[Update the current document readiness](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#update-the-current-document-readiness) to &#34;<code>interactive</code>&#34;&#46;

4.  Pop <em>all</em> the nodes off the <a id="the&#45;end&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#46;

5.  <a id="the&#45;end&#58;update&#45;the&#45;current&#45;document&#45;readiness&#45;4"></a>[Update the current document readiness](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#update-the-current-document-readiness) to &#34;<code>complete</code>&#34;&#46;

#### <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing"></a>13&#46;2&#46;8 Speculative HTML parsing[](#speculative-html-parsing)

User agents may implement an optimization&#44; as described in this section&#44; to speculatively fetch resources that are declared in the HTML markup while the HTML parser is waiting for a <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;pending&#45;parsing&#45;blocking&#45;script"></a>[pending parsing&#45;blocking script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#pending-parsing-blocking-script) to be fetched and executed&#44; or during normal parsing&#44; at the time <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element&#45;for&#45;the&#45;token"></a>[an element is created for a token](#create-an-element-for-the-token)&#46; While this optimization is not defined in precise detail&#44; there are some rules to consider for interoperability&#46;

Each <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) can have an <a id="active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a><strong>active speculative HTML parser</strong>&#46; It is initially null&#46;

The <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a><strong>speculative HTML parser</strong> must act like the normal HTML parser &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; the tree builder rules apply&#41;&#44; with some exceptions&#58;

- The state of the normal HTML parser and the document itself must not be affected&#46;

  <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

  For example&#44; the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;next&#45;input&#45;character"></a>[next input character](#next-input-character) or the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) for the normal HTML parser is not affected by the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[speculative HTML parser](#speculative-html-parser)&#46;

- Bytes pushed into the HTML parser&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;input&#45;byte&#45;stream"></a>[input byte stream](#the-input-byte-stream) must also be pushed into the speculative HTML parser&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;input&#45;byte&#45;stream&#45;2"></a>[input byte stream](#the-input-byte-stream)&#46; Bytes read from the streams must be independent&#46;

- The result of the speculative parsing is primarily a series of <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;fetch"></a>[speculative fetches](#speculative-fetch)&#46; Which kinds of resources to speculatively fetch is <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined)&#44; but user agents must not speculatively fetch resources that would not be fetched with the normal HTML parser&#44; under the assumption that the script that is blocking the HTML parser does nothing&#46;

  <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

  It is possible that the same markup is seen multiple times from the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[speculative HTML parser](#speculative-html-parser) and then the normal HTML parser&#46; It is expected that duplicated fetches will be prevented by caching rules&#44; which are not yet fully specified&#46;

A <a id="speculative&#45;fetch"></a><strong>speculative fetch</strong> for a <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;mock&#45;element"></a>[speculative mock element](#speculative-mock-element) <var>element</var> must follow these rules&#58;

Should some of these things be applied to the document &#34;for real&#34;&#44; even though they are found speculatively&#63;

- If the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[speculative HTML parser](#speculative-html-parser) encounters one of the following elements&#44; then act as if that element is processed for the purpose of its effect of subsequent speculative fetches&#46;

  - A <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;base&#45;element"></a><code>[base](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-base-element)</code> element&#46;
  - A <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code> element whose <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;http&#45;equiv"></a><code>[http&#45;equiv](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-http-equiv)</code> attribute is in the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;http&#45;equiv&#45;content&#45;security&#45;policy"></a>[Content security policy](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-http-equiv-content-security-policy) state&#46;
  - A <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code> element whose <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;name"></a><code>[name](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-name)</code> attribute is an <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;meta&#45;referrer"></a><code>[referrer](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#meta-referrer)</code>&#34;&#46;
  - A <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;meta&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[meta](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-meta-element)</code> element whose <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;attr&#45;meta&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-meta-name)</code> attribute is an <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<code>viewport</code>&#34;&#46; &#40;This can affect whether a media query list <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;matches&#45;the&#45;environment"></a>[matches the environment](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#matches-the-environment)&#46;&#41; [&#91;CSSDEVICEADAPT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSDEVICEADAPT)

- Let <var>url</var> be the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) that <var>element</var> would fetch if it was processed normally&#46; If there is no such <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) or if it is the empty string&#44; then do nothing&#46; Otherwise&#44; if <var>url</var> is already in the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;list&#45;of&#45;speculative&#45;fetch&#45;urls"></a>[list of speculative fetch URLs](#list-of-speculative-fetch-urls)&#44; then do nothing&#46; Otherwise&#44; fetch <var>url</var> as if the element was processed normally&#44; and add <var>url</var> to the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;list&#45;of&#45;speculative&#45;fetch&#45;urls&#45;2"></a>[list of speculative fetch URLs](#list-of-speculative-fetch-urls)&#46;

Each <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> has a <a id="list&#45;of&#45;speculative&#45;fetch&#45;urls"></a><strong>list of speculative fetch URLs</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;url&#45;3"></a>[URLs](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#44; initially empty&#46;

To <a id="start&#45;the&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a><strong>start the speculative HTML parser</strong> for an instance of an HTML parser <var>parser</var>&#58;

1.  Optionally&#44; return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This step allows user agents to opt out of speculative HTML parsing&#46;

2.  If <var>parser</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) is not null&#44; then <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;stop&#45;the&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a>[stop the speculative HTML parser](#stop-the-speculative-html-parser) for <var>parser</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This can happen when <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;write"></a><code>[document&#46;write&#40;&#41;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-document-write)</code> writes another parser&#45;blocking script&#46; For simplicity&#44; this specification always restarts speculative parsing&#44; but user agents can implement a more efficient strategy&#44; so long as the end result is equivalent&#46;

3.  Let <var>speculativeParser</var> be a new <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;4"></a>[speculative HTML parser](#speculative-html-parser)&#44; with the same state as <var>parser</var>&#46;

4.  Let <var>speculativeDoc</var> be a new isomorphic representation of <var>parser</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#44; where all elements are instead <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;mock&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[speculative mock elements](#speculative-mock-element)&#46; Let <var>speculativeParser</var> parse into <var>speculativeDoc</var>&#46;

5.  Set <var>parser</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) to <var>speculativeParser</var>&#46;

6.  <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[In parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#44; run <var>speculativeParser</var> until it is stopped or until it reaches the end of its <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;input&#45;stream"></a>[input stream](#input-stream)&#46;

To <a id="stop&#45;the&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser"></a><strong>stop the speculative HTML parser</strong> for an instance of an HTML parser <var>parser</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>speculativeParser</var> be <var>parser</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser)&#46;

2.  If <var>speculativeParser</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Throw away any pending content in <var>speculativeParser</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;input&#45;stream&#45;2"></a>[input stream](#input-stream)&#44; and discard any future content that would have been added to it&#46;

4.  Set <var>parser</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;active&#45;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;4"></a>[active speculative HTML parser](#active-speculative-html-parser) to null&#46;

The <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;html&#45;parser&#45;5"></a>[speculative HTML parser](#speculative-html-parser) will create <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;mock&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[speculative mock elements](#speculative-mock-element) instead of normal elements&#46; DOM operations that the tree builder normally does on elements are expected to work appropriately on speculative mock elements&#46;

A <a id="speculative&#45;mock&#45;element"></a><strong>speculative mock element</strong> is a <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;struct"></a>[struct](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct) with the following <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;struct&#45;item"></a>[items](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item)&#58;

- A <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;string"></a>[string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string) <a id="concept&#45;mock&#45;namespace"></a><strong>namespace</strong>&#44; corresponding to an element&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;namespace"></a>[namespace](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-namespace)&#46;

- A <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;string&#45;2"></a>[string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string) <a id="concept&#45;mock&#45;local&#45;name"></a><strong>local name</strong>&#44; corresponding to an element&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name)&#46;
