- A <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;list&#45;2"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) <a id="concept&#45;mock&#45;attribute&#45;list"></a><strong>attribute list</strong>&#44; corresponding to an element&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;attribute&#45;list"></a>[attribute list](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attribute)&#46;

- A <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;list&#45;3"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) <a id="concept&#45;mock&#45;children"></a><strong>children</strong>&#44; corresponding to an element&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;tree&#45;child"></a>[children](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-child)&#46;

To <a id="create&#45;a&#45;speculative&#45;mock&#45;element"></a><strong>create a speculative mock element</strong> given a <var>namespace</var>&#44; <var>tagName</var>&#44; and <var>attributes</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>element</var> be a new <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;mock&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[speculative mock element](#speculative-mock-element)&#46;

2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;mock&#45;namespace"></a>[namespace](#concept-mock-namespace) to <var>namespace</var>&#46;

3.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;mock&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](#concept-mock-local-name) to <var>tagName</var>&#46;

4.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;mock&#45;attribute&#45;list"></a>[attribute list](#concept-mock-attribute-list) to <var>attributes</var>&#46;

5.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;concept&#45;mock&#45;children"></a>[children](#concept-mock-children) to a new empty <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;list&#45;4"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list)&#46;

6.  Optionally&#44; perform a <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;fetch&#45;2"></a>[speculative fetch](#speculative-fetch) for <var>element</var>&#46;

7.  Return <var>element</var>&#46;

When the tree builder says to insert an element into a <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;template&#45;contents"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents)&#44; if that is a <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;speculative&#45;mock&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[speculative mock element](#speculative-mock-element)&#44; and the <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;template&#45;contents&#45;2"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents) is not a <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;shadowroot"></a><code>[ShadowRoot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-shadowroot)</code> node&#44; instead do nothing&#46; URLs found speculatively inside non&#45;declarative&#45;shadow&#45;root <a id="speculative&#45;html&#45;parsing&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> elements might themselves be templates&#44; and must not be speculatively fetched&#46;

#### <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset"></a>13&#46;2&#46;9 Coercing an HTML DOM into an infoset[](#coercing-an-html-dom-into-an-infoset)

When an application uses an <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) in conjunction with an XML pipeline&#44; it is possible that the constructed DOM is not compatible with the XML tool chain in certain subtle ways&#46; For example&#44; an XML toolchain might not be able to represent attributes with the name <code>xmlns</code>&#44; since they conflict with the Namespaces in XML syntax&#46; There is also some data that the <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) generates that isn&#39;t included in the DOM itself&#46; This section specifies some rules for handling these issues&#46;

If the XML API being used doesn&#39;t support DOCTYPEs&#44; the tool may drop DOCTYPEs altogether&#46;

If the XML API doesn&#39;t support attributes in no namespace that are named &#34;<code>xmlns</code>&#34;&#44; attributes whose names start with &#34;<code>xmlns&#58;</code>&#34;&#44; or attributes in the <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;xmlns&#45;namespace"></a>[XMLNS namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace)&#44; then the tool may drop such attributes&#46;

The tool may annotate the output with any namespace declarations required for proper operation&#46;

If the XML API being used restricts the allowable characters in the local names of elements and attributes&#44; then the tool may map all element and attribute local names that the API wouldn&#39;t support to a set of names that <em>are</em> allowed&#44; by replacing any character that isn&#39;t supported with the uppercase letter U and the six digits of the character&#39;s code point when expressed in hexadecimal&#44; using digits 0&#45;9 and capital letters A&#45;F as the symbols&#44; in increasing numeric order&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; the element name <code>foo&#60;bar</code>&#44; which can be output by the <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#44; though it is neither a legal HTML element name nor a well&#45;formed XML element name&#44; would be converted into <code>fooU00003Cbar</code>&#44; which <em>is</em> a well&#45;formed XML element name &#40;though it&#39;s still not legal in HTML by any means&#41;&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

As another example&#44; consider the attribute <code>xlink&#58;href</code>&#46; Used on a MathML element&#44; it becomes&#44; after being <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;adjust&#45;foreign&#45;attributes"></a>[adjusted](#adjust-foreign-attributes)&#44; an attribute with a prefix &#34;<code>xlink</code>&#34; and a local name &#34;<code>href</code>&#34;&#46; However&#44; used on an HTML element&#44; it becomes an attribute with no prefix and the local name &#34;<code>xlink&#58;href</code>&#34;&#44; which is not a valid NCName&#44; and thus might not be accepted by an XML API&#46; It could thus get converted&#44; becoming &#34;<code>xlinkU00003Ahref</code>&#34;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The resulting names from this conversion conveniently can&#39;t clash with any attribute generated by the <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;4"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#44; since those are all either lowercase or those listed in the <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;adjust&#45;foreign&#45;attributes&#45;2"></a>[adjust foreign attributes](#adjust-foreign-attributes) algorithm&#39;s table&#46;

If the XML API restricts comments from having two consecutive U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS characters &#40;&#45;&#45;&#41;&#44; the tool may insert a single U&#43;0020 SPACE character between any such offending characters&#46;

If the XML API restricts comments from ending in a U&#43;002D HYPHEN&#45;MINUS character &#40;&#45;&#41;&#44; the tool may insert a single U&#43;0020 SPACE character at the end of such comments&#46;

If the XML API restricts allowed characters in character data&#44; attribute values&#44; or comments&#44; the tool may replace any U&#43;000C FORM FEED &#40;FF&#41; character with a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; and any other literal non&#45;XML character with a U&#43;FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER&#46;

If the tool has no way to convey out&#45;of&#45;band information&#44; then the tool may drop the following information&#58;

- Whether the document is set to <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;no&#45;quirks&#45;mode"></a><em>[no&#45;quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-no-quirks)</em>&#44; <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;limited&#45;quirks&#45;mode"></a><em>[limited&#45;quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-limited-quirks)</em>&#44; or <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;quirks&#45;mode"></a><em>[quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-quirks)</em>
- The association between form controls and forms that aren&#39;t their nearest <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element ancestor &#40;use of the <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) in the parser&#41;
- The <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;template&#45;contents"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents) of any <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The mutations allowed by this section apply <em>after</em> the <a id="coercing&#45;an&#45;html&#45;dom&#45;into&#45;an&#45;infoset&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;5"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#39;s rules have been applied&#46; For example&#44; a <code>&#60;a&#58;&#58;&#62;</code> start tag will be closed by a <code>&#60;&#47;a&#58;&#58;&#62;</code> end tag&#44; and never by a <code>&#60;&#47;aU00003AU00003A&#62;</code> end tag&#44; even if the user agent is using the rules above to then generate an actual element in the DOM with the name <code>aU00003AU00003A</code> for that start tag&#46;

#### <a id="an&#45;introduction&#45;to&#45;error&#45;handling&#45;and&#45;strange&#45;cases&#45;in&#45;the&#45;parser"></a>13&#46;2&#46;10 An introduction to error handling and strange cases in the parser[](#an-introduction-to-error-handling-and-strange-cases-in-the-parser)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

This section examines some erroneous markup and discusses how the <a id="an&#45;introduction&#45;to&#45;error&#45;handling&#45;and&#45;strange&#45;cases&#45;in&#45;the&#45;parser&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) handles these cases&#46;

##### <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i"></a>13&#46;2&#46;10&#46;1 Misnested tags&#58; &#60;b&#62;&#60;i&#62;&#60;&#47;b&#62;&#60;&#47;i&#62;[](#misnested-tags:-b-i-/b-/i)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

The most&#45;often discussed example of erroneous markup is as follows&#58;

``` text
<p>1<b>2<i>3</b>4</i>5</p>
```

The parsing of this markup is straightforward up to the &#34;3&#34;&#46; At this point&#44; the DOM looks like this&#58;

- <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 1
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
        - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 2
        - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code>
          - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 3

Here&#44; the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has five elements on it&#58; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#44; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>&#44; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>&#44; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code>&#46; The <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) just has two&#58; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> and <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code>&#46; The <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) is &#34;<a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34;&#46;

Upon receiving the end tag token with the tag name &#34;b&#34;&#44; the &#34;[adoption agency algorithm](#adoptionAgency)&#34; is invoked&#46; This is a simple case&#44; in that the <var>formattingElement</var> is the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element&#44; and there is no <var>furthest block</var>&#46; Thus&#44; the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) ends up with just three elements&#58; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#44; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>&#44; while the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) has just one&#58; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code>&#46; The DOM tree is unmodified at this point&#46;

The next token is a character &#40;&#34;4&#34;&#41;&#44; triggers the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[reconstruction of the active formatting elements](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; in this case just the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code> element&#46; A new <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code> element is thus created for the &#34;4&#34; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;4"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node&#46; After the end tag token for the &#34;i&#34; is also received&#44; and the &#34;5&#34; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;5"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node is inserted&#44; the DOM looks as follows&#58;

- <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;6"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 1
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
        - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;7"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 2
        - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code>
          - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;8"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 3
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;the&#45;i&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[i](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-i-element)</code>
        - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;9"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 4
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;i&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;i&#58;text&#45;10"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 5

##### <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p"></a>13&#46;2&#46;10&#46;2 Misnested tags&#58; &#60;b&#62;&#60;p&#62;&#60;&#47;b&#62;&#60;&#47;p&#62;[](#misnested-tags:-b-p-/b-/p)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

A case similar to the previous one is the following&#58;

``` text
<b>1<p>2</b>3</p>
```

Up to the &#34;2&#34; the parsing here is straightforward&#58;

- <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 1
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
        - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 2

The interesting part is when the end tag token with the tag name &#34;b&#34; is parsed&#46;

Before that token is seen&#44; the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has four elements on it&#58; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#44; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>&#44; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>&#46; The <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) just has the one&#58; <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>&#46; The <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) is &#34;<a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34;&#46;

Upon receiving the end tag token with the tag name &#34;b&#34;&#44; the &#34;[adoption agency algorithm](#adoptionAgency)&#34; is invoked&#44; as in the previous example&#46; However&#44; in this case&#44; there <em>is</em> a <var>furthest block</var>&#44; namely the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#46; Thus&#44; this time the adoption agency algorithm isn&#39;t skipped over&#46;

The <var>common ancestor</var> is the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element&#46; A conceptual &#34;bookmark&#34; marks the position of the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> in the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; but since that list has only one element in it&#44; the bookmark won&#39;t have much effect&#46;

As the algorithm progresses&#44; <var>node</var> ends up set to the formatting element &#40;<a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>&#41;&#44; and <var>last node</var> ends up set to the <var>furthest block</var> &#40;<a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>&#41;&#46;

The <var>last node</var> gets appended &#40;moved&#41; to the <var>common ancestor</var>&#44; so that the DOM looks like&#58;

- <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 1
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;4"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 2

A new <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element is created&#44; and the children of the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element are moved to it&#58;

- <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;5"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 1
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>

<!-- -->

- <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;6"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 2

Finally&#44; the new <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element is appended to the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#44; so that the DOM looks like&#58;

- <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;7"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 1
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
        - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;8"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 2

The <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element is removed from the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) and the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements)&#44; so that when the &#34;3&#34; is parsed&#44; it is appended to the <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element&#58;

- <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;9"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 1
    - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
        - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;10"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 2
      - <a id="misnested&#45;tags&#58;&#45;b&#45;p&#45;&#47;b&#45;&#47;p&#58;text&#45;11"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; 3

##### <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables"></a>13&#46;2&#46;10&#46;3 Unexpected markup in tables[](#unexpected-markup-in-tables)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

Error handling in tables is&#44; for historical reasons&#44; especially strange&#46; For example&#44; consider the following markup&#58;

``` text
<table><b><tr><td>aaa</td></tr>bbb</table>ccc
```

The highlighted <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element start tag is not allowed directly inside a table like that&#44; and the parser handles this case by placing the element <em>before</em> the table&#46; &#40;This is called <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;foster&#45;parent"></a><em>[foster parenting](#foster-parent)</em>&#46;&#41; This can be seen by examining the DOM tree as it stands just after the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element&#39;s start tag has been seen&#58;

- <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>

&#46;&#46;&#46;and then immediately after the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element start tag has been seen&#58;

- <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>

At this point&#44; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has on it the elements <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> &#40;in that order&#44; despite the resulting DOM tree&#41;&#59; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) just has the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element in it&#59; and the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) is &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34;&#46;

The <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> start tag causes the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element to be popped off the stack and a <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> start tag to be implied&#59; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> and <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code> elements are then handled in a rather straight&#45;forward manner&#44; taking the parser through the &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34; and &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34; insertion modes&#44; after which the DOM looks as follows&#58;

- <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>
      - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>
        - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code>

Here&#44; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has on it the elements <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code>&#59; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) still has the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element in it&#59; and the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) is &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intr&#45;2"></a>[in row](#parsing-main-intr)&#34;&#46;

The <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element start tag token&#44; after putting a <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code> element on the tree&#44; puts a <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) on the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) &#40;it also switches to the &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intd"></a>[in cell](#parsing-main-intd)&#34; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode)&#41;&#46;

- <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>
      - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>
        - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code>
          - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code>

The <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;2"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) means that when the &#34;aaa&#34; character tokens are seen&#44; no <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element is created to hold the resulting <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node&#58;

- <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>
      - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>
        - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code>
          - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code>
            - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; aaa

The end tags are handled in a straight&#45;forward manner&#59; after handling them&#44; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has on it the elements <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>&#59; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) still has the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element in it &#40;the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;concept&#45;parser&#45;marker&#45;3"></a>[marker](#concept-parser-marker) having been removed by the &#34;td&#34; end tag token&#41;&#59; and the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) is &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#45;2"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#46;

Thus it is that the &#34;bbb&#34; character tokens are found&#46; These trigger the &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intabletext"></a>[in table text](#parsing-main-intabletext)&#34; insertion mode to be used &#40;with the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;original&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[original insertion mode](#original-insertion-mode) set to &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#45;3"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#41;&#46; The character tokens are collected&#44; and when the next token &#40;the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element end tag&#41; is seen&#44; they are processed as a group&#46; Since they are not all spaces&#44; they are handled as per the &#34;anything else&#34; rules in the &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intable&#45;2"></a>[in table](#parsing-main-intable)&#34; insertion mode&#44; which defer to the &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;inbody"></a>[in body](#parsing-main-inbody)&#34; insertion mode but with <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;foster&#45;parent&#45;2"></a>[foster parenting](#foster-parent)&#46;

When <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;reconstruct&#45;the&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[the active formatting elements are reconstructed](#reconstruct-the-active-formatting-elements)&#44; a <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element is created and <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;foster&#45;parent&#45;3"></a>[foster parented](#foster-parent)&#44; and then the &#34;bbb&#34; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node is appended to it&#58;

- <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
      - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;text&#45;4"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; bbb
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>
      - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>
        - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code>
          - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code>
            - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;text&#45;5"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; aaa

The <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) has on it the elements <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>&#44; <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; and the new <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> &#40;again&#44; note that this doesn&#39;t match the resulting tree&#33;&#41;&#59; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements) has the new <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element in it&#59; and the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;insertion&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[insertion mode](#insertion-mode) is still &#34;<a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intbody&#45;4"></a>[in table body](#parsing-main-intbody)&#34;&#46;

Had the character tokens been only <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) instead of &#34;bbb&#34;&#44; then that <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) would just be appended to the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code> element&#46;

Finally&#44; the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> is closed by a &#34;table&#34; end tag&#46; This pops all the nodes from the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) up to and including the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; but it doesn&#39;t affect the <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; so the &#34;ccc&#34; character tokens after the table result in yet another <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> element being created&#44; this time after the table&#58;

- <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
      - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;text&#45;6"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; bbb
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>
      - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[tbody](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tbody-element)</code>
        - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tr](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-tr-element)</code>
          - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[td](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-td-element)</code>
            - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;text&#45;7"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; aaa
    - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
      - <a id="unexpected&#45;markup&#45;in&#45;tables&#58;text&#45;8"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; ccc

##### <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed"></a>13&#46;2&#46;10&#46;4 Scripts that modify the page as it is being parsed[](#scripts-that-modify-the-page-as-it-is-being-parsed)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

Consider the following markup&#44; which for this example we will assume is the document with <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;example&#46;com&#47;inner</code>&#44; being rendered as the content of an <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code> in another document with the <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;example&#46;com&#47;outer</code>&#58;

``` text
<div id=a>
 <script>
  var div = document.getElementById('a');
  parent.document.body.appendChild(div);
 </script>
 <script>
  alert(document.URL);
 </script>
</div>
<script>
 alert(document.URL);
</script>
```

Up to the first &#34;script&#34; end tag&#44; before the script is parsed&#44; the result is relatively straightforward&#58;

- <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>a</code>&#34;
      - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;text"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58;
      - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code>
        - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; var div &#61; document&#46;getElementById&#40;&#39;a&#39;&#41;&#59; ⏎ parent&#46;document&#46;body&#46;appendChild&#40;div&#41;&#59;

After the script is parsed&#44; though&#44; the <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> element and its child <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element are gone&#58;

- <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>

They are&#44; at this point&#44; in the <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> of the aforementioned outer <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;browsing&#45;context"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#browsing-context)&#46; However&#44; the <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) <em>still contains the <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> element</em>&#46;

Thus&#44; when the second <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element is parsed&#44; it is inserted <em>into the outer <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object</em>&#46;

Those parsed into different <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>s than the one the parser was created for do not execute&#44; so the first alert does not show&#46;

Once the <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> element&#39;s end tag is parsed&#44; the <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> element is popped off the stack&#44; and so the next <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element is in the inner <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#58;

- <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code>
      - <a id="scripts&#45;that&#45;modify&#45;the&#45;page&#45;as&#45;it&#45;is&#45;being&#45;parsed&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; alert&#40;document&#46;URL&#41;&#59;

This script does execute&#44; resulting in an alert that says &#34;https&#58;&#47;&#47;example&#46;com&#47;inner&#34;&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents"></a>13&#46;2&#46;10&#46;5 The execution of scripts that are moving across multiple documents[](#the-execution-of-scripts-that-are-moving-across-multiple-documents)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

Elaborating on the example in the previous section&#44; consider the case where the second <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element is an external script &#40;i&#46;e&#46; one with a <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src"></a><code>[src](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-script-src)</code> attribute&#41;&#46; Since the element was not in the parser&#39;s <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> when it was created&#44; that external script is not even downloaded&#46;

In a case where a <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element with a <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-script-src)</code> attribute is parsed normally into its parser&#39;s <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#44; but while the external script is being downloaded&#44; the element is moved to another document&#44; the script continues to download&#44; but does not execute&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In general&#44; moving <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> elements between <a id="the&#45;execution&#45;of&#45;scripts&#45;that&#45;are&#45;moving&#45;across&#45;multiple&#45;documents&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>s is considered a bad practice&#46;

##### <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>13&#46;2&#46;10&#46;6 Unclosed formatting elements[](#unclosed-formatting-elements)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

The following markup shows how nested formatting elements &#40;such as <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>&#41; get collected and continue to be applied even as the elements they are contained in are closed&#44; but that excessive duplicates are thrown away&#46;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE html>
<p><b class=x><b class=x><b><b class=x><b class=x><b>X
<p>X
<p><b><b class=x><b>X
<p></b></b></b></b></b></b>X
```

The resulting DOM tree is as follows&#58;

- DOCTYPE&#58; <code>html</code>
- <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
        - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;2"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
          - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
            - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;3"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
              - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;4"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
                - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
                  - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;text"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; X⏎
    - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;5"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
        - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
          - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;6"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
            - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;7"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
              - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
                - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; X⏎
    - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;8"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
        - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
