          - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;9"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
            - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;10"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
              - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
                - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
                  - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;classes&#45;11"></a><code>[class](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#classes)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>x</code>&#34;
                    - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code>
                      - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;text&#45;3"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; X⏎
    - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>
      - <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;text&#45;4"></a><code>[&#35;text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code>&#58; X⏎

Note how the second <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element in the markup has no explicit <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> elements&#44; but in the resulting DOM&#44; up to three of each kind of formatting element &#40;in this case three <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> elements with the class attribute&#44; and two unadorned <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> elements&#41; get reconstructed before the element&#39;s &#34;X&#34;&#46;

Also note how this means that in the final paragraph only six <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> end tags are needed to completely clear the <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;list&#45;of&#45;active&#45;formatting&#45;elements"></a>[list of active formatting elements](#list-of-active-formatting-elements)&#44; even though nine <a id="unclosed&#45;formatting&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;b&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[b](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-b-element)</code> start tags have been seen up to this point&#46;

### <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments"></a>13&#46;3 Serializing HTML fragments[](#serialising-html-fragments)

For the purposes of the following algorithm&#44; an element <a id="serializes&#45;as&#45;void"></a><strong>serializes as void</strong> if its element type is one of the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;void&#45;elements"></a>[void elements](#void-elements)&#44; or is <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;basefont"></a><code>[basefont](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#basefont)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;bgsound"></a><code>[bgsound](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#bgsound)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;frame"></a><code>[frame](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#frame)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;keygen"></a><code>[keygen](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#keygen)</code>&#44; or <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;param"></a><code>[param](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#param)</code>&#46;

The following steps form the <a id="html&#45;fragment&#45;serialisation&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>HTML fragment serialization algorithm</strong>&#46; The algorithm takes as input a DOM <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#44; or <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;documentfragment"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> referred to as <var>the node</var>&#44; a boolean <var>serializableShadowRoots</var>&#44; and a <code>sequence&#60;ShadowRoot&#62;</code> <var>shadowRoots</var>&#44; and returns a string&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This algorithm serializes the <em>children</em> of the node being serialized&#44; not the node itself&#46;

1.  If <var>the node</var> <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;serializes&#45;as&#45;void"></a>[serializes as void](#serializes-as-void)&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

2.  Let <var>s</var> be a string&#44; and initialize it to the empty string&#46;

3.  If <var>the node</var> is a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#44; then let <var>the node</var> instead be the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;template&#45;contents"></a>[template contents](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#template-contents) &#40;a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;documentfragment&#45;2"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> node&#41;&#46;

4.  If <var>current node</var> is a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;shadow&#45;host"></a>[shadow host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-shadow-host)&#58;

    1.  Let <var>shadow</var> be <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;shadow&#45;root"></a>[shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-shadow-root)&#46;

    2.  If one of the following is true&#58;

        - <var>serializableShadowRoots</var> is true and <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;shadow&#45;serializable"></a>[serializable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-serializable) is true&#59; or

        - <var>shadowRoots</var> contains <var>shadow</var>&#44;

        then&#58;

        1.  Append &#34;<code>&#60;template shadowrootmode&#61;&#34;</code>&#34;&#46;

        2.  If <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;shadow&#45;root&#45;mode"></a>[mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-mode) is &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#44; then append &#34;<code>open</code>&#34;&#46; Otherwise&#44; append &#34;<code>closed</code>&#34;&#46;

        3.  Append U&#43;0022 &#40;&#34;&#41;&#46;

        4.  If <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;delegates&#45;focus"></a>[delegates focus](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-delegates-focus) is set&#44; then append &#34;<code> shadowrootdelegatesfocus&#61;&#34;&#34;</code>&#34;&#46;

        5.  If <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;shadow&#45;serializable&#45;2"></a>[serializable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-serializable) is set&#44; then append &#34;<code> shadowrootserializable&#61;&#34;&#34;</code>&#34;&#46;

        6.  If <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;slot&#45;assignment"></a>[slot assignment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-slot-assignment) is &#34;<code>manual</code>&#34;&#44; then append &#34;<code> shadowrootslotassignment&#61;&#34;manual&#34;</code>&#34;&#46;

        7.  If <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;clonable"></a>[clonable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-clonable) is set&#44; then append &#34;<code> shadowrootclonable&#61;&#34;&#34;</code>&#34;&#46;

        8.  Let <var>shouldAppendRegistryAttribute</var> be the result of running these steps&#58;

            1.  Let <var>documentRegistry</var> be <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;document&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-custom-element-registry)&#46;

            2.  Let <var>shadowRegistry</var> be <var>shadow</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;shadow&#45;root&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-custom-element-registry)&#46;

            3.  If <var>documentRegistry</var> is null and <var>shadowRegistry</var> is null&#44; then return false&#46;

            4.  If <var>documentRegistry</var> <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;is&#45;a&#45;global&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[is a global custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#is-a-global-custom-element-registry) and <var>shadowRegistry</var> <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;is&#45;a&#45;global&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry&#45;2"></a>[is a global custom element registry](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#is-a-global-custom-element-registry)&#44; then return false&#46;

            5.  Return true&#46;

        9.  If <var>shouldAppendRegistryAttribute</var> is true&#44; then append &#34;<code> shadowrootcustomelementregistry&#61;&#34;&#34;</code>&#34;&#46;

        10. Append U&#43;003E &#40;&#62;&#41;&#46;

        11. Append the value of running the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;fragment&#45;serialisation&#45;algorithm"></a>[HTML fragment serialization algorithm](#html-fragment-serialisation-algorithm) with <var>shadow</var>&#44; <var>serializableShadowRoots</var>&#44; and <var>shadowRoots</var> &#40;thus recursing into this algorithm for that element&#41;&#46;

        12. Append &#34;<code>&#60;&#47;template&#62;</code>&#34;&#46;

5.  For each child node of <var>the node</var>&#44; in <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; run the following steps&#58;

    1.  Let <var>current node</var> be the child node being processed&#46;

    2.  Append the appropriate string from the following list to <var>s</var>&#58;

        <strong>If <var>current node</var> is an <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;element&#45;2"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code></strong>

        If <var>current node</var> is an element in the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;mathml&#45;namespace"></a>[MathML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#mathml-namespace)&#44; or the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;svg&#45;namespace"></a>[SVG namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#svg-namespace)&#44; then let <var>tagname</var> be <var>current node</var>&#39;s local name&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>tagname</var> be <var>current node</var>&#39;s qualified name&#46;

        Append U&#43;003C &#40;&#60;&#41;&#44; followed by <var>tagname</var>&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        For <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML elements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) created by the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) or <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;createelement"></a><code>[createElement&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-createelement)</code>&#44; <var>tagname</var> will be lowercase&#46;
        If <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value) is not null&#44; and the element does not have an <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;attr&#45;is"></a><code>[is](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-is)</code> attribute in its attribute list&#44; then append &#34;<code> is&#61;&#34;</code>&#34;&#44; followed by <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value) <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;escapingString"></a>[escaped as described below](#escapingString) in <em>attribute mode</em>&#44; and U&#43;0022 &#40;&#34;&#41;&#46;

        For each attribute that the element has&#44; append U&#43;0020 SPACE&#44; the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;attribute&#39;s&#45;serialised&#45;name"></a>[attribute&#39;s serialized name as described below](#attribute's-serialised-name)&#44; &#34;<code>&#61;&#34;</code>&#34;&#44; the attribute&#39;s value&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;escapingString&#45;2"></a>[escaped as described below](#escapingString) in <em>attribute mode</em>&#44; and U&#43;0022 &#40;&#34;&#41;&#46;

        An <a id="attribute&#39;s&#45;serialised&#45;name"></a><strong>attribute&#39;s serialized name</strong> for the purposes of the previous paragraph must be determined as follows&#58;

        <strong>If the attribute has no namespace</strong>

        The attribute&#39;s serialized name is the attribute&#39;s local name&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        For attributes on <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML elements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) set by the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) or by <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;setattribute"></a><code>[setAttribute&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-element-setattribute)</code>&#44; the local name will be lowercase&#46;
        <strong>If the attribute is in the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;xml&#45;namespace"></a>[XML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-namespace)</strong>

        The attribute&#39;s serialized name is &#34;<code>xml&#58;</code>&#34; followed by the attribute&#39;s local name&#46;

        <strong>If the attribute is in the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;xmlns&#45;namespace"></a>[XMLNS namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace) and the attribute&#39;s local name is <code>xmlns</code></strong>

        The attribute&#39;s serialized name is &#34;<code>xmlns</code>&#34;&#46;

        <strong>If the attribute is in the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;xmlns&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[XMLNS namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlns-namespace) and the attribute&#39;s local name is not <code>xmlns</code></strong>

        The attribute&#39;s serialized name is &#34;<code>xmlns&#58;</code>&#34; followed by the attribute&#39;s local name&#46;

        <strong>If the attribute is in the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;xlink&#45;namespace"></a>[XLink namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#xlink-namespace)</strong>

        The attribute&#39;s serialized name is &#34;<code>xlink&#58;</code>&#34; followed by the attribute&#39;s local name&#46;

        <strong>If the attribute is in some other namespace</strong>

        The attribute&#39;s serialized name is the attribute&#39;s qualified name&#46;

        While the exact order of attributes is <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined)&#44; and may depend on factors such as the order that the attributes were given in the original markup&#44; the sort order must be stable&#44; such that consecutive invocations of this algorithm serialize an element&#39;s attributes in the same order&#46;

        Append U&#43;003E &#40;&#62;&#41;&#46;

        If <var>current node</var> <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;serializes&#45;as&#45;void&#45;2"></a>[serializes as void](#serializes-as-void)&#44; then <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue) on to the next child node at this point&#46;

        Append the value of running the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;fragment&#45;serialisation&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[HTML fragment serialization algorithm](#html-fragment-serialisation-algorithm) with <var>current node</var>&#44; <var>serializableShadowRoots</var>&#44; and <var>shadowRoots</var> &#40;thus recursing into this algorithm for that node&#41;&#44; followed by &#34;<code>&#60;&#47;</code>&#34;&#44; <var>tagname</var>&#44; and U&#43;003E &#40;&#62;&#41;&#46;

        <strong>If <var>current node</var> is a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node</strong>

        If the parent of <var>current node</var> is a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;xmp"></a><code>[xmp](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#xmp)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;noembed"></a><code>[noembed](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#noembed)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;noframes"></a><code>[noframes](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#noframes)</code>&#44; or <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;plaintext"></a><code>[plaintext](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#plaintext)</code> element&#44; or if the parent of <var>current node</var> is a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code> element and <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script"></a>[scripting is enabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script) for the node&#44; then append the value of <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data) literally&#46;

        Otherwise&#44; append the value of <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data)&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;escapingString&#45;3"></a>[escaped as described below](#escapingString)&#46;

        <strong>If <var>current node</var> is a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;comment&#45;2"></a><code>[Comment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-comment)</code></strong>

        Append &#34;<code>&#60;&#33;&#45;&#45;</code>&#34;&#44; followed by the value of <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data&#45;3"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data)&#44; and &#34;<code>&#45;&#45;&#62;</code>&#34;&#46;

        <strong>If <var>current node</var> is a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;processinginstruction"></a><code>[ProcessingInstruction](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-processinginstruction)</code></strong>

        Append &#34;<code>&#60;&#63;</code>&#34;&#44; followed by the value of <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;pi&#45;target"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-pi-target)&#44; U&#43;0020 SPACE&#44; the value of <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data&#45;4"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data)&#44; and &#34;<code>&#63;&#62;</code>&#34;&#46;

        <strong>If <var>current node</var> is a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;documenttype"></a><code>[DocumentType](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documenttype)</code></strong>

        Append &#34;<code>&#60;&#33;DOCTYPE </code>&#34;&#44; followed by the value of <var>current node</var>&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;doctype&#45;name"></a>[name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-doctype-name) and U&#43;003E &#40;&#62;&#41;&#46;

6.  Return <var>s</var>&#46;

<a id="warning&#45;html&#45;serializer&#45;roundtrip"></a>

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

It is possible that the output of this algorithm&#44; if parsed with an <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#44; will not return the original tree structure&#46; Tree structures that do not roundtrip a serialize and reparse step can also be produced by the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;4"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) itself&#44; although such cases are typically non&#45;conforming&#46;

<a id="example&#45;html&#45;serializer&#45;roundtrip&#45;comments&#45;and&#45;script"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-html-serializer-roundtrip-comments-and-script)

For instance&#44; if a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code> element to which a <code>Comment</code> node has been appended is serialized and the output is then reparsed&#44; the comment will end up being displayed in the text control&#46; Similarly&#44; if&#44; as a result of DOM manipulation&#44; an element contains a comment that contains &#34;<code>&#45;&#45;&#62;</code>&#34;&#44; then when the result of serializing the element is parsed&#44; the comment will be truncated at that point and the rest of the comment will be interpreted as markup&#46; More examples would be making a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> element contain a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node with the text string &#34;<code>&#60;&#47;script&#62;</code>&#34;&#44; or having a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code> element that contains a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;ul&#45;element"></a><code>[ul](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ul-element)</code> element &#40;as the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;ul&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[ul](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-ul-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag"></a>[start tag](#syntax-start-tag) would imply the end tag for the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;p&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[p](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-p-element)</code>&#41;&#46;

This can enable cross&#45;site scripting attacks&#46; An example of this would be a page that lets the user enter some font family names that are then inserted into a CSS <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code> block via the DOM and which then uses the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;innerhtml"></a><code>[innerHTML](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-innerhtml)</code> IDL attribute to get the HTML serialization of that <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code> element&#58; if the user enters &#34;<code>&#60;&#47;style&#62;&#60;script&#62;attack&#60;&#47;script&#62;</code>&#34; as a font family name&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;innerhtml&#45;2"></a><code>[innerHTML](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#dom-element-innerhtml)</code> will return markup that&#44; if parsed in a different context&#44; would contain a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> node&#44; even though no <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> node existed in the original DOM&#46;

<a id="example&#45;html&#45;serializer&#45;roundtrip&#45;nested&#45;form"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-html-serializer-roundtrip-nested-form)

For example&#44; consider the following markup&#58;

``` text
<form id="outer"><div></form><form id="inner"><input>
```

This will be parsed into&#58;

- <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>outer</code>&#34;
      - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code>
        - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>inner</code>&#34;
          - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code>

The <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element will be associated with the inner <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element&#46; Now&#44; if this tree structure is serialized and reparsed&#44; the <code>&#60;form id&#61;&#34;inner&#34;&#62;</code> start tag will be ignored&#44; and so the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element will be associated with the outer <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element instead&#46;

``` text
<html><head></head><body><form id="outer"><div><form id="inner"><input></form></div></form></body></html>
```

- <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code>&#61;&#34;<code>outer</code>&#34;
      - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code>
        - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code>

<a id="example&#45;html&#45;serializer&#45;roundtrip&#45;foster&#45;parenting"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-html-serializer-roundtrip-foster-parenting)

As another example&#44; consider the following markup&#58;

``` text
<a><table><a>
```

This will be parsed into&#58;

- <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>
      - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>
      - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>

That is&#44; the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> elements are nested&#44; because the second <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element is <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;foster&#45;parent"></a>[foster parented](#foster-parent)&#46; After a serialize&#45;reparse roundtrip&#44; the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> elements and the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code> element would all be siblings&#44; because the second <code>&#60;a&#62;</code> start tag implicitly closes the first <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element&#46;

``` text
<html><head></head><body><a><a></a><table></table></a></body></html>
```

- <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>
  - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>
  - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code>
    - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>
    - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code>
    - <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-table-element)</code>

For historical reasons&#44; this algorithm does not roundtrip an initial U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41; character in <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;pre&#45;element"></a><code>[pre](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-pre-element)</code>&#44; <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;listing"></a><code>[listing](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#listing)</code> elements&#44; even though &#40;in the first two cases&#41; the markup being roundtripped can be conforming&#46; The <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;5"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) will drop such a character during parsing&#44; but this algorithm does <em>not</em> serialize an extra U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41; character&#46;

<a id="example&#45;html&#45;serializer&#45;roundtrip&#45;linefeed"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-html-serializer-roundtrip-linefeed)

For example&#44; consider the following markup&#58;

``` text
<pre>

Hello.</pre>
```

When this document is first parsed&#44; the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;pre&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[pre](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-pre-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) starts with a single newline character&#46; After a serialize&#45;reparse roundtrip&#44; the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;pre&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[pre](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-pre-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content) is simply &#34;<code>Hello&#46;</code>&#34;&#46;

<a id="attr&#45;is&#45;during&#45;serialization"></a>Because of the special role of the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;attr&#45;is&#45;2"></a><code>[is](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-is)</code> attribute in signaling the creation of <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;customized&#45;built&#45;in&#45;element"></a>[customized built&#45;in elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#customized-built-in-element)&#44; in that it provides a mechanism for parsed HTML to set the element&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value)&#44; we special&#45;case its handling during serialization&#46; This ensures that an element&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value) is preserved through serialize&#45;parse roundtrips&#46;

<a id="example&#45;html&#45;serializer&#45;roundtrip&#45;is&#45;attribute"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-html-serializer-roundtrip-is-attribute)

When creating a <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;customized&#45;built&#45;in&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[customized built&#45;in element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#customized-built-in-element) via the parser&#44; a developer uses the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;attr&#45;is&#45;3"></a><code>[is](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-is)</code> attribute directly&#59; in such cases serialize&#45;parse roundtrips work fine&#46;

``` text
<script>
window.SuperP = class extends HTMLParagraphElement {};
customElements.define("super-p", SuperP, { extends: "p" });
</script>

<div id="container"><p is="super-p">Superb!</p></div>

<script>
console.log(container.innerHTML); // <p is="super-p">
container.innerHTML = container.innerHTML;
console.log(container.innerHTML); // <p is="super-p">
console.assert(container.firstChild instanceof SuperP);
</script>
```

But when creating a customized built&#45;in element via its <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;custom&#45;element&#45;constructor"></a>[constructor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-element-constructor) or via <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;createelement&#45;2"></a><code>[createElement&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-createelement)</code>&#44; the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;attr&#45;is&#45;4"></a><code>[is](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-is)</code> attribute is not added&#46; Instead&#44; the <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value) &#40;which is what the custom elements machinery uses&#41; is set without intermediating through an attribute&#46;

``` text
<script>
container.innerHTML = "";
const p = document.createElement("p", { is: "super-p" });
container.appendChild(p);

// The is attribute is not present in the DOM:
console.assert(!p.hasAttribute("is"));

// But the element is still a super-p:
console.assert(p instanceof SuperP);
</script>
```

To ensure that serialize&#45;parse roundtrips still work&#44; the serialization process explicitly writes out the element&#39;s <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;is&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[<code>is</code> value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-is-value) as an <a id="serialising&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;attr&#45;is&#45;5"></a><code>[is](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-is)</code> attribute&#58;

``` text
<script>
console.log(container.innerHTML); // <p is="super-p">
container.innerHTML = container.innerHTML;
console.log(container.innerHTML); // <p is="super-p">
console.assert(container.firstChild instanceof SuperP);
</script>
```

<a id="escapingString"></a><strong>Escaping a string</strong> &#40;for the purposes of the algorithm above&#41; consists of running the following steps&#58;

1.  Replace any occurrence of &#34;<code>&#38;</code>&#34; character by &#34;<code>&#38;amp&#59;</code>&#34;&#46;

2.  Replace any occurrences of the U&#43;00A0 NO&#45;BREAK SPACE character by &#34;<code>&#38;nbsp&#59;</code>&#34;&#46;

3.  Replace any occurrences of the &#34;<code>&#60;</code>&#34; character by &#34;<code>&#38;lt&#59;</code>&#34;&#46;

4.  Replace any occurrences of the &#34;<code>&#62;</code>&#34; character by &#34;<code>&#38;gt&#59;</code>&#34;&#46;

5.  If the algorithm was invoked in the <em>attribute mode</em>&#44; then replace any occurrences of the &#34;<code>&#34;</code>&#34; character by &#34;<code>&#38;quot&#59;</code>&#34;&#46;

### <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments"></a>13&#46;4 Parsing HTML fragments[](#parsing-html-fragments)

The <a id="html&#45;fragment&#45;parsing&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>HTML fragment parsing algorithm</strong>&#44; given an <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> or <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;documentfragment"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code> <var>target</var>&#44; a string <var>input</var>&#44; an optional boolean <var>allowDeclarativeShadowRoots</var> &#40;default false&#41;&#44; and an optional <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;parser&#45;scripting&#45;mode"></a>[parser scripting mode](#parser-scripting-mode) <var>scriptingMode</var> &#40;default <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;inert"></a>[Inert](#scripting-mode-inert)&#41;&#44; is the following steps&#46; They return a <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;documentfragment&#45;2"></a><code>[DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment)</code>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Parts marked <a id="fragment&#45;case"></a><strong>fragment case</strong> in algorithms in the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) section are parts that only occur if the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is non&#45;null&#46; The algorithms have been annotated with such markings for informational purposes only&#59; such markings have no normative weight&#46; If it is possible for a condition described as a <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;fragment&#45;case"></a>[fragment case](#fragment-case) to occur even when the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) is null&#44; then that is an error in the specification&#46;

1.  <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>scriptingMode</var> is either <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;inert&#45;2"></a>[Inert](#scripting-mode-inert) or <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;fragment"></a>[Fragment](#scripting-mode-fragment)&#46;

2.  Let <a id="concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context"></a><strong><var>context</var></strong> be <var>target</var> if <var>target</var> is an <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;element&#45;2"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code>&#59; otherwise <var>target</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;documentfragment&#45;host"></a>[host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host)&#46;

3.  <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var> is non&#45;null&#46;

4.  Let <var>document</var> be a <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> node whose <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;type"></a>[type](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-type) is &#34;<code>html</code>&#34;&#46;

5.  Let <var>contextDocument</var> be <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context&#45;2"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

6.  If <var>contextDocument</var> is in <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;quirks&#45;mode"></a>[quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-quirks)&#44; then set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;mode"></a>[mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-mode) to &#34;<code>quirks</code>&#34;&#46;

7.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>contextDocument</var> is in <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;limited&#45;quirks&#45;mode"></a>[limited&#45;quirks mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-limited-quirks)&#44; then set <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[mode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-mode) to &#34;<code>limited&#45;quirks</code>&#34;&#46;

8.  Create a new <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) whose <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;allow&#45;declarative&#45;shadow&#45;roots"></a>[allow declarative shadow roots](#allow-declarative-shadow-roots) is <var>allowDeclarativeShadowRoots</var>&#44; and associate it with <var>document</var>&#46;

9.  Set the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) to <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context&#45;3"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var>&#46;

10. If <var>contextDocument</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script)&#44; then set <var>scriptingMode</var> to <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled"></a>[Disabled](#scripting-mode-disabled)&#46;

11. Set the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;scripting&#45;mode"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) to <var>scriptingMode</var>&#46;

12. Set the state of the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;tokenization"></a>[tokenization](#tokenization) stage as follows&#44; switching on <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context&#45;4"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var>&#58;

    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element"></a><code>[title](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-title-element)</code></strong>

    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-textarea-element)</code></strong>

    Switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;rcdata&#45;state"></a>[RCDATA state](#rcdata-state)&#46;
    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;style&#45;element"></a><code>[style](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-style-element)</code></strong>

    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;xmp"></a><code>[xmp](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#xmp)</code></strong>

    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code></strong>

    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;noembed"></a><code>[noembed](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#noembed)</code></strong>

    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;noframes"></a><code>[noframes](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#noframes)</code></strong>

    Switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;rawtext&#45;state"></a>[RAWTEXT state](#rawtext-state)&#46;
    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code></strong>

    Switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;script&#45;data&#45;state"></a>[script data state](#script-data-state)&#46;
    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code></strong>

    If <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[scripting mode](#scripting-mode) is not <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;scripting&#45;mode&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[Disabled](#scripting-mode-disabled)&#44; switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;rawtext&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[RAWTEXT state](#rawtext-state)&#46; Otherwise&#44; leave the tokenizer in the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;data&#45;state"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46;
    <strong><a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;plaintext"></a><code>[plaintext](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#plaintext)</code></strong>

    Switch the tokenizer to the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;plaintext&#45;state"></a>[PLAINTEXT state](#plaintext-state)&#46;
    <strong>Any other element</strong>

    Leave the tokenizer in the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;data&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[data state](#data-state)&#46;
    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    For performance reasons&#44; an implementation that does not report errors and that uses the actual state machine described in this specification directly could use the PLAINTEXT state instead of the RAWTEXT and script data states where those are mentioned in the list above&#46; Except for rules regarding parse errors&#44; they are equivalent&#44; since there is no <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;appropriate&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;token"></a>[appropriate end tag token](#appropriate-end-tag-token) in the fragment case&#44; yet they involve far fewer state transitions&#46;

13. Let <var>root</var> be the result of <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given <var>document</var>&#44; &#34;<code>html</code>&#34;&#44; the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; null&#44; null&#44; false&#44; and the result of <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;look&#45;up&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;registry"></a>[looking up a custom element registry](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#look-up-a-custom-element-registry) given <var>target</var>&#46;

14. <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) <var>root</var> to <var>document</var>&#46;

15. Set up the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;4"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](#stack-of-open-elements) so that it contains just the single element <var>root</var>&#46;

16. Let <var>fragment</var> be the result of <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;create&#45;a&#45;document&#45;fragment"></a>[creating a document fragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-document-fragment) given <var>target</var>&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

17. Set the parser&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;root&#45;insertion&#45;target"></a>[root insertion target](#root-insertion-target) to <var>fragment</var>&#46;

18. If <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context&#45;5"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var> is a <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;template&#45;element"></a><code>[template](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-template-element)</code> element&#44; then push &#34;<a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;parsing&#45;main&#45;intemplate"></a>[in template](#parsing-main-intemplate)&#34; onto the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;modes"></a>[stack of template insertion modes](#stack-of-template-insertion-modes) so that it is the new <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;current&#45;template&#45;insertion&#45;mode"></a>[current template insertion mode](#current-template-insertion-mode)&#46;

19. Create a start tag token whose name is the local name of <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context&#45;6"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var> and whose attributes are the attributes of <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context&#45;7"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var>&#46;

    Let this start tag token be the start tag token of <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context&#45;8"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var>&#59; e&#46;g&#46; for the purposes of determining if it is an <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;integration&#45;point"></a>[HTML integration point](#html-integration-point)&#46;

20. <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;reset&#45;the&#45;insertion&#45;mode&#45;appropriately"></a>[Reset the parser&#39;s insertion mode appropriately](#reset-the-insertion-mode-appropriately)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The parser will reference its <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;fragment&#45;context&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[fragment context element](#fragment-context-element) as part of that algorithm&#46;

21. Set the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;5"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser)&#39;s <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) to the nearest node to <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;frag&#45;parse&#45;context&#45;9"></a><var>[context](#concept-frag-parse-context)</var> that is a <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element &#40;going straight up the ancestor chain&#44; and including the element itself&#44; if it is a <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element&#41;&#44; if any&#46; &#40;If there is no such <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;form&#45;element&#45;pointer&#45;2"></a>[<code>form</code> element pointer](#form-element-pointer) keeps its initial value&#44; null&#46;&#41;

22. Place the <var>input</var> into the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;input&#45;stream"></a>[input stream](#input-stream) for the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;6"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) just created&#46; The encoding <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;concept&#45;encoding&#45;confidence"></a>[confidence](#concept-encoding-confidence) is <em>irrelevant</em>&#46;

23. Start the <a id="parsing&#45;html&#45;fragments&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;7"></a>[HTML parser](#html-parser) and let it run until it has consumed all the characters just inserted into the input stream&#46;

24. Return <var>fragment</var>&#46;
